fdroid:com.hydrohomie.app.name: Hydro Homie
fdroid:com.hydrohomie.app.summary: Simple, private drink tracker with a filling glass, streaks and reminders
fdroid:com.hydrohomie.app.description:
Hydro Homie helps you drink enough, without getting in your way.
Log a drink with one tap, or dial in an exact amount with the wheel (10 ml steps). The glass on the home screen fills up as you go, and a short confirmation shows that your entry was saved.
 Features 
• Quick-add buttons for water, tea, coffee, juice, soda and more – every drink counts with its own hydration factor
• Amount wheel in 10 ml steps
• History with a two-week chart and a three-month calendar
• Daily goal, streaks and achievements
• Extra water for physical activity and hot or cold weather
• Optional drink reminders with a soft water-drop sound
• Home-screen widget for one-tap water logging
• Light and dark theme, English and German
 Privacy 
No account, no ads, no analytics. Everything stays in a local database on your device. The app is offline by default; only if you switch on the optional "Fetch weather automatically" setting does it ask for coarse location and load the current temperature from Open-Meteo (coordinates rounded to ~10 km). The app is free software (GPL-3.0).

fdroid:com.mkulesh.onpc.name: Enhanced Music Controller Lite
fdroid:com.mkulesh.onpc.description:
This app allows remote control of a Network Player or a Network A/V Receiver via the local network.
The app supports Onkyo/Pioneer/Integra released in April 2016 or later and Denon/Marantz with build-in HEOS technology.
Some TEAC models like Teac NT-503 are also supported.
The two most popular features of the app are music playback and sound profile management.
Other benefits include:
* Maximum privacy: No ads, no trackers, no telemetry, no special permissions like GPS
* The modern Material design supports different color themes and works on smartphones and/or tablets in portrait and landscape mode
* One-click access to music playback actions
* One-click access to media items using shortcuts
* Full music playback control (play, stop, pause, track up/down, time seek, repeat and random modes)
* Full tone control (listening modes, bass, center, treble and subwoofer levels)
* Enhanced Play Queue support (add, replace, remove, remove all, change playback order)
* TuneIn Radio, Deezer, Spotify and Tidal streaming (if supported by receiver)
* DAB / FM / AM (if supported by receiver)
* Multi-zone support (if supported by receiver)
* Multi-room support: Allows control of groups of devices attached via FlareConnect (for Onkyo/Pioneer/Integra only). Ability to control FlareConnect without WiFi
* Control of devices attached via RI (for Onkyo/Pioneer/Integra only)
* Display device details and control device settings such as dimmer level, digital filter, auto power, and sleep timer
* Allows control of receivers over an OpenVPN connection (even over a cellular connection)
* Integration with "Tasker"
Known limitations:
* Please note that the app does not support the music streaming from your phone to the network player or the receiver
* In order to login into Deezer, Tidal, or Spotify, you need the official Onkyo/Denon app additionally to this app
* Pioneer models before year 2016 are NOT supported, for example: VSX-424, VSX-529, VSX-830, VSX-920K, VSX-923, VSX-924, VSX-1021, VSX-1121, SC-95, SC-LX79, N-50, N-50a, N-70A
* Following Denon models are not supported: AVR-X1000, DNP-730AE, Heos Link 2, Denon Home 150, Marantz n40
* Following models do not support "Play Queue" feature (that is a limitation of the Onkyo firmware): CR-N765, DTR-40.5, HM76, HT-R693, HT-R695, TX-8130, TX-8150, TX-NR626, TX-NR636, TX-NR646, TX-RZ900
At the moment, the app is tested and works with following devices:
* Onkyo: TX-L20D, TX-L50, TX-NR414, TX-NR509, TX-NR525, TX-NR535, TX-NR575E, TX-NR616, TX-NR636, TX-NR646, TX-NR656, TX-NR676E, TX-NR686, TX-NR696, TX-NR818, TX-RZ50, TX-RZ70, TX-RZ810, TX-RZ830, TX-RZ900, TX-RZ1100, TX-8130, TX-8150, TX-8250, TX-8260, TX-8270, TX-8390, TX-8470, R-N855, CS-N575D, CR-N755, CR-N765, CR-N775D, HT-S7805, NS-6130, NS-6170, NCP-302
* Integra: DTM-6, DRX-5.2, DTR 30.7, DTR 40.7
* Pioneer (models after 2016): VSX-LX101, VSX-LX103, VSX-LX104, VSX-LX302, VSX-LX303, VSX-LX503, VSX-LX504, VSX-S520D, VSX-831, VSX-832, VSX-932, VSX-933, VSX-935, VSX-1131, SC-LX701, SC-LX901, SX-N30, SX-S30DAB, NC-50DAB, N-50AE, N-70AE, XC-HM86D, MRX-3, MRX-5
* Teac: NT-503, AG-D500
* Denon with build-in HEOS: DRA-800H, AVR-S750H, AVR-S760H, AVR-X1500H, AVR-X1800H, AVR-X2400H, AVR-X2600H, AVR-X2700H, AVR-X2800H, AVR-X3700H, AVR-X3800H, AVR-X4300H, AVR-X4400H, AVR-X4500H, AVR-X6300H, AVR-X6400H

fdroid:com.pearlnode.name: Pearlnode
fdroid:com.pearlnode.summary: Control Shelly smart home devices on your local network. No cloud, no account.
fdroid:com.pearlnode.description:
Pearlnode lets you control Shelly smart home devices directly over your local Wi-Fi network. No cloud account, no internet connection, no data leaving your home.
FEATURES
- Auto-discovery via mDNS, IP range scan, and BLE (for devices in setup mode)
- Manual add by IP address
- Supports Gen1, Gen2, Gen3, and Gen4 Shelly devices
- Per-channel on/off control with live status polling
- Power monitoring (real-time wattage for Plug S, Plug M, and other metering devices)
- RGBW color picker and brightness control
- Dimmer brightness slider
- Relay pulse for door and gate openers
- Schedules: create, edit, enable/disable, and delete device schedules with day-of-week repeat
- Alarm Sync: automatically create device schedules relative to your phone alarm (configurable offset and action)
- Firmware updates: check, download, and upload firmware directly to the device
- Home screen widgets: multi-device toggle widget and single-device widget
- Credentials encrypted on-device with AES-256-GCM via Android Keystore
SUPPORTED DEVICES
Gen1: Shelly 1, 1L, 1PM, 2, 2.5, 4Pro, UNI, i3, Plug, Plug S, Plug US, Dimmer, Dimmer 2, Duo, Vintage, Bulb, RGBW2, EM, 3EM, H&T, Flood, Door/Window 2, Motion
Gen2/Gen3/Gen4: Plus 1, 1 Mini, 1PM, 1PM Mini, 2PM, 4PM, Plus Plug S/M, Plus Dimmer, Dimmer 10V, Wall Dimmer, Plus RGBW PM, Plus i4, Plus H&T, Plus Flood, EM Mini, Pro 1, 1PM, 2, 2PM, 3, 4PM, Pro EM, Pro 3EM, Pro Dimmer, Pro RGBW PM, Wall Display, and Gen3/Gen4 equivalents.
PRIVACY
All communication stays on your local network. The only external connection is an optional firmware update check to updates.shelly.cloud. No analytics, no tracking, no accounts.

fdroid:com.rtneg.foxappmemo.name: FoxAppMemo
fdroid:com.rtneg.foxappmemo.summary: Track, rate, and tag your Android apps with memos. No internet required.
fdroid:com.rtneg.foxappmemo.description:
FoxAppMemo is a fully offline app manager and memo tool. Browse your installed apps or enter any package name manually, then keep personal notes alongside a simple three-level rating, a status label, and free-form tags.
Features:
• Browse installed apps directly from the app and add them to your list in one tap
• Rich memos – attach a free-text note to any app
• Simple ratings – 自分向きじゃない / ふつう / 好き (Not for me / Normal / Like)
• App genre auto-detected from the OS and pre-filled as a tag
• Status labels – Trying / Main / Avoid / Blacklist / Reconsider
• Tag system – create tags on the fly and filter by multiple tags at once
• Powerful filters – search by name or package, filter by status, tags, and specific rating values
• Export your full memo list as a pretty-printed JSON file via the Storage Access Framework (you choose the save location)
• Swipe-to-delete with confirmation dialog
• Material You / Material 3 design with a warm fox-inspired colour palette
Privacy:
• No internet permission – the app never makes any network requests
• All data is stored locally in a Room (SQLite) database on your device
• The only permissions used are QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES (to list installed apps) and the implicit storage access granted by the system file-picker when you choose to export

fdroid:com.stoutner.privacycell.name: Privacy Cell
fdroid:com.stoutner.privacycell.summary: Verify that a phone is using the most secure cell protocols.
fdroid:com.stoutner.privacycell.description:
Privacy Cell is a small app that displays the cell phone protocol information.
At the time of this writing, many cell phone networks are switching from 4G (4th Generation) to 5G networks. The 5G network protocols were specifically designed to protect against some of the known insecurities of the older protocols, including those that allowed stingrays (IMSI catchers) to perform man-in-the-middle attacks on cell phone networks. To ease deployment and backwards compatibility, 4G and 5G networks can run together in what is known as 5G NR (New Radio) NSA (Non-Standalone) mode. This uses the 4G network for the control channel and the 5G network for the data communication. However, 5G NR NSA does not provide protection against stingrays. Android has access to all the information it needs to know if it is connected to a 5G NR NSA or a 5G NR SA (Standalone) network, but it doesn’t display that information to the user. The purpose of Privacy Cell is to make that information easy to access.
Privacy Cell can also warn you when you are connected to antiquated 2G and 3G networks.

fdroid:com.thirumalai.calllimiter.name: Call Limiter
fdroid:com.thirumalai.calllimiter.summary: Limit call duration per contact and automatically hang up when time is up
fdroid:com.thirumalai.calllimiter.description:
Call Limiter is a simple, open-source Android app that helps you take control of your phone calls. Set time limits for specific contacts and let the app automatically hang up when the limit is reached — making it easy to save time, avoid distractions, and manage conversations better.
 Features: 
 Per-Contact Call Limits: Define custom call durations for individual numbers.
 Automatic Hang-Up: Calls are disconnected when the chosen time is reached.
 Easy Time Selection: Choose limits using a bottom sheet scroll wheel for a smooth experience.
 Global Call Limit: Set default time limit for all contacts.
 Flexible Limit Scope: Choose between per-call limits (resets after each call) or daily limits
 Persistent Storage: Your limits remain saved until you decide to change or delete them.
 Flexible Editing: Update or remove call limits anytime with ease.
 Emergency Buffer: Add a few extra seconds for urgent or unexpected needs.
 Call Limit Warning Reminder: Get an in-call audio alert (supervisor tone) and haptic vibration when your remaining call time reaches your chosen threshold, with customizable reminder time (5s – 120s).
 Modern Theming: Supports both light and dark modes, adapting to your system theme.
 Privacy-Focused: Works entirely offline — no internet, no tracking, no data sharing.
Stay in control of your conversations with Call Limiter — lightweight, private, and designed to fit seamlessly into your daily calling habits.

fdroid:de.singular.looper.name: Rubber Ring
fdroid:de.singular.looper.summary: A looper for practicing song parts.
fdroid:de.singular.looper.description:
Rubber Ring is a tool for practicing song parts. Pick an audio file, mark a start/stop region on its waveform, and play it back in a seamless, gapless loop. It auto-detects tempo and beats to snap the loop markers to a beat grid, with full manual override.
Early-stage release — expect rough edges. Feedback and bug reports welcome via Issues.
Features:
* Import-and-own library — picked files are copied into app-private storage, so loops never break when the original is moved, renamed, or deleted.
* Library with search, sorting and stars — pull the list down to find a track by name, sort by recently used, name, length or date added, and star favourites to keep them at the top.
* Waveform region selection with gapless looping — drag start/stop handles to mark a section; the loop boundary wraps with zero audible gap or click.
* Automatic, hand-editable beat grid — a dependency-free estimator finds BPM and a downbeat, and handles snap to the beat grid.
* Chord detection with a hand-editable chord lane — chords are labelled over the waveform; tap to relabel, split or merge. Detection is tuned to the author's own material, so the lane is there to correct by hand, and can be turned off.
* Per-track audio normalization — boost a track that was mixed too quietly, by peak or by loudness; your original file is never altered.
* Adjustable playback speed — slow a tricky passage down (or speed it up) without changing pitch.
* Count-in — long-press Play to start after a metronome counts you in at the track's tempo.
* Saved loops and practice arrangements — capture named sections per track and chain them into a sequence, each repeated as many times as you set.
* Export a saved loop as a WAV file, at the current speed, for a DAW or to share.
* Backup & restore — export your whole library to a file and restore it after a reinstall.
* English and German, with optional German note names (H and B) for chords.
* Opens audio shared from other apps.
No ads, no trackers, no network access.
fdroid:de.singular.looper.category: Local Media Player, Multimedia, Music Practice Tool

 Extension support to add custom functionality

 commands and uses ~/.kube/config file by default.
 Flatpak adds wrapper for the aws , doctl , gke-gcloud-auth-plugin ,
 glab and kubelogin tools and runs them as a commands from the host system.
 The terminal uses /bin/sh by default, but it can be switched to, for example, /bin/bash 
 for sandboxed environment or /app/bin/host-spawn for a host environment.
 You can use flatpak-override to give access to the filesystem f.e. if you're missing
 .minikube certificates. flatpak override --user --filesystem=~/.minikube app.freelens.Freelens .

fedora-packages:fwknop/fwknop.name: fwknop
fedora-packages:fwknop/fwknop.description: fwknop implements an authorization scheme known as Single Packet Authorization (SPA) that requires only a single encrypted packet to communicate various pieces of information including desired access through an iptables policy and/or specific commands to execute on the target system. The main application of this program is to protect services such as SSH with an additional layer of security in order to make the exploitation of vulnerabilities (both 0-day and unpatched code) much more difficult. The authorization server passively monitors authorization packets via libpcap and hence there is no "server" to which to connect in the traditional sense. Any service protected by fwknop is inaccessible (by using iptables to intercept packets within the kernel) before authenticating; anyone scanning for the service will not be able to detect that it is even listening. This authorization scheme offers many advantages over port knocking, include being non-replayable, much more data can be communicated, and the scheme cannot be broken by simply connecting to extraneous ports on the server in an effort to break knock sequences. The authorization packets can easily be spoofed as well, and this makes it possible to make it appear as though, say, www.yahoo.com is trying to authenticate to a target system but in reality the actual connection will come from a seemingly unrelated IP. Although the default data collection method is to use libpcap to sniff packets off the wire, fwknop can also read packets out of a file that is written by the iptables ulogd pcap writer or by a separate sniffer process.

fedora-packages:ghc-lumberjack/ghc-lumbe.name: ghc-lumberjack

fedora-packages:ghc-lumberjack/ghc-lumbe.description: This is a logging facility. Yes, there are many, and this is the one with a beard, wearing flannel and boots, that gets the job done. It's not the fanciest, it doesn't have a cargo-van full of features. This logger is designed to be straightforward to use, provide a good set of standard features, and be useable across a broad set of code. * Logging itself is a monadic activity. This activity is most often performed in a monad stack with a MonadIO context to allow writing to files. * The specific logging action implementations are managed separately from the actions of logging messages in the target code. This allows logging to be configurable and the manner of logging to be specified at startup time without requiring changes in the code from which log messages are being generated. * The logging implementation code can use contravariant functors to adjust existing logging. * Main code will typically retrieve the logging actions from a Reader context in your monad stack. That said, Log actions are not tied to an enclosing Monad. There are helpers to support a Monad which can store Log actions, but Log actions can also be explicitly passed and used. * The prettyprinter package is used for formatting.

firefox-addons:3072684.name: VeeVee Video Downloader
firefox-addons:3072684.summary: Video Downloader VeeVee – download videos from the Internet. Detect media on supported websites, preview available files, choose the preferred quality, and save videos or audio directly to your device.
firefox-addons:3072684.description:
One of the most popular video saving tools for browsers.
VeeVee allows you to save videos in SD, HD, Full HD, 2K, and 4K formats from many popular video sites. It is simple, fast, and safe to use.
Add the extension to your browser in just one minute. Then click the extension icon on the target website and start saving your videos.
 Features 
 Save videos from supported website
 Retrieve HTML5 videos from almost any site
 High-quality saving options: 720p, 1080p, 2K, and 4K
 HLS stream support: detect M3U8 files, load TS segments, combine into MP4
 No registration required; completely free to use
 Built-in video preview player
 Copy media links to share with friends
 Play MP4 files on Chromecast or Google Home
 Scan QR codes to watch and save videos directly to your phone
 Batch download — select videos or audios to process
 Search by title, quality, type, and file size
 Light / dark theme
 Important 
VeeVee is a tool for saving and managing videos. It is designed to work only with legal, publicly accessible content. The extension does not provide access to copyrighted, premium, or restricted material and does not bypass DRM, paywalls, protected streams, or any technical protection measures.
VeeVee provides access solely to saving tools. It does not grant access to any content that the user does not already have lawful access to. Users are fully responsible for ensuring that any videos they save comply with copyright and intellectual property laws, as well as the terms of the websites they visit.
In accordance with US DMCA and EU copyright directives, VeeVee operates as a neutral technical tool and processes only the media that is already available to the user. VeeVee is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or associated with any third-party video hosting platforms or content providers.
Some websites may restrict saving due to their own policies. In certain cases, you may need to start playing the video so the extension can detect it. A new browser tab may open to process and save the file — this is expected behavior.
 How VeeVee Handles Website Data 
To detect downloadable media, VeeVee analyzes relevant page content and network requests on websites you visit.
For TikTok, Instagram, and X / Twitter, service-specific processing begins only after you provide permission through the extension’s consent window.
For TikTok, the video URL may be sent to third-party video-processing services, including tikwm.com and tiktokjs-downloader.vercel.app, solely to obtain video information and download links.
For Instagram and X / Twitter, the extension may use your current session data, such as cookies or service tokens, to request video information from those platforms or their embedded-content services.
This information is processed only to provide VeeVee’s video detection and saving features. VeeVee does not sell user data or use it for advertising. Additional details are available in our Privacy Policy.
 Copyright Holders 
If you believe that content available through VeeVee infringes your copyright, please contact us at info@veevee.app with your organization name, contact information, and proof of exclusive rights. Only the copyright owner or an authorized representative may submit a claim. We regularly review and exclude websites containing copyrighted or restricted content.
 Support 
If you encounter issues or videos that cannot be saved, please email us instead of leaving a negative rating. Help us improve the extension: info@veevee.app
 Privacy Policy 
VeeVee does not require registration and does not ask users to provide their name, email address, payment information, or other profile information.
To provide its video detection and saving features, the extension processes limited website and browsing data as described above. This may include page content, media URLs, network request information, service-specific session data, extension settings, and consent preferences.
Some information is processed locally in the browser. When required to provide a requested feature, limited information may be transmitted to the relevant website or disclosed third-party processing services.
VeeVee does not sell user data or use it for advertising, profiling, credit decisions, or purposes unrelated to the extension’s video-saving functionality.
Privacy Policy — https://veevee.app/privacy-policy 
Terms and Conditions — https://veevee.app/terms 
If you do not agree with our Privacy Policy, please remove the extension.

bluejetty:00085431:ios.name: Dental 99
bluejetty:00085431:ios.summary:
POWER TO THE PATIENTS

bluejetty:00085431:ios.description:
POWER TO THE PATIENTS
This is the dental healthcare app that’s going to save you money, time, and potentially a lot of pain too!
Dental 99 is a whole new way of looking at dentistry – one that is almost entirely from a patient’s point of view.
We have designed Dental 99 to deliver convenience, value, transparent pricing, and great dental care.
Using the app is simple:
1. Select your treatment. We offer three general dental treatments:
- Checkup & Clean
- Filling
- Toothache management (this is the one for you if one or more of your teeth is bothering you and the source of pain hasn't been diagnosed yet)
We also offer both in-clinic and take home whitening options, as well as a range of consultations with our Treatment Coordinators for common major dental treatments such as crowns, implants, and wisdom tooth extractions.
2. Use the app to find a time & clinic that suits you. 
For parents booking in kids, we'll claim the Medicare allowance for eligible kids on your behalf. And at our low prices, it's unlikely there'll be a gap payment.
3. Arrive for your appointment and be looked after by one of our qualified clinicians.
4. Your before/after photos, X-Rays, clinical notes, prescribed treatments, and aftercare notes will all be available in your app within a few minutes of your appointment finishing.
5. Depending on your appointment's treatments, we'll send you daily post appointment aftercare advice to help you understand the recovery process and recover more quickly.
We currently have several clinics in Sydney (NSW), Melbourne (VIC), and Brisbane (QLD). We’re constantly working to open new clinics so that we can make our affordable, high quality dental care available to more communities around Australia. If there isn’t a Dental 99 clinic in your area yet, please use the contact form on our website (https://dental99.com.au/) to let us know where you’d like us to open our next clinic!
It’s never too late to look after your teeth, so what are you waiting for? Download the app and your mouth will thank you. But in case you need more reasons to download Dental 99 now, read on…
- 40% of Australians avoid the dentist because of the cost
- 33% of Australians don’t go to the dentist at all (that’s not good; bad teeth can be linked to all sorts of serious health problems)
- 90% of Australians have some form of tooth decay (ouch! - see the previous point)
Convinced of the value of Dental 99? Good, we hoped you would be!

bluejetty:00089178:ios.description:
Manage your health care or health insurance from anywhere, at any time, with the HealthPartners app, formerly myHP. From finding a doctor to checking deductibles, it’s all in the palm of your hands. 
With the HealthPartners app, you can take your care or plan on the go: 
• Find doctors, clinics and hospitals nearby 
• View wait times at nearby urgent care clinics 
• Always have your member ID card in your pocket 
• See what’s covered by your plan and get cost estimates 
• Check your benefits and claims 
• Quickly refill prescriptions via mail or compare pharmacy prices 
• Review test results and health records 
• Check your deductible; spending; and FSA, HRA or HSA balances 
• Pay a clinic bill 
• Talk with HealthPartners experts no matter where you are 
• Build better habits with Living Well from fitness goals integrated with Apple Health to help making changes in your mental health and diet. 
Simply sign in with your HealthPartners online account username and password. If you’re a patient or member and don’t have an account yet, create one at healthpartners.com/signupnow. 
At HealthPartners, we’re committed to helping you live a healthier life with health care and insurance options that are simple and affordable, whether you have our insurance, see our doctors or both. 
We're the largest consumer governed nonprofit health care organization in the nation serving more than 1.8 million medical and dental health plan members - primarily in Minnesota, Wisconsin, Illinois, and Iowa. Our care system includes a multi-specialty group practice of more than 1,800 physicians that serves more than 1.2 million patients.

اپلیکیشن خبری رادیوفردا با هدف مقابله با سانسور خبری و فراهم کردن امکان دسترسی آزاد به اطلاعات، و نیز تأمین فض
bluejetty:00079408:ios.description:
برای دسترسی به خبرهای ایران و جهان، اپلیکیشن خبری رسمی و رایگان رادیوفردا را برای آیفون، آیپد یا آیپادهای لمسی خود دریافت کنید.
اپلیکیشن خبری رادیوفردا با هدف مقابله با سانسور خبری و فراهم کردن امکان دسترسی آزاد به اطلاعات، و نیز تأمین فضایی برای اطلاعرسانی و بحث آزاد میان مخاطبان ایرانی ارائه شده است. رادیوفردا بخشی از خانواده رادیو اروپای آزاد/ رادیو آزادی است؛ مجموعهای با بیش از ۱۷۰۰ کارمند یکی از جامعترین مأموریتهای خبری را در سراسر جهان ارائه میدهد.
علاوه بر زبان فارسی، اپلیکیشن رادیوفردا این امکان را میدهد که خبرها را در ۲۷ زبان دیگر در ۲۳ کشور در قارههای اروپا و آسیا پیگیری کنید که برای ۴۲ میلیون نفر در هفته برنامه پخش میکند.
با استفاده از این اپلیکیشن تازهترین خبرها، و خبرهای فوری را از طریق رادیوفردا و شبکه جهانی خبرنگاران ما دریافت کنید.
نکات برجسته:
• دریافت خبر به ۲۷ زبان مختلف
• پوشش خبری برای ۲۳ کشور مختلف
• امکان شخصیسازی خبرها و موضوعات خبری
• دریافت خبرها در قالب متن، صدا و تصویر
• پوشش همزمان و زنده خبری، تصویری و رادیویی
• امکان خواندن متون خبری همزمان با تماشای فایلهای ویدئویی یا شنیدن برنامههای رادیویی.
• امکان همخوان کردن محتوای مورد علاقه از طریق ایمیل، ایکس (توئیتر سابق)، فیسبوک و دیگر شبکههای اجتماعی
• امکان ارسال عکس، متن، صدا و فیلم به رادیو فردا
اگر در مورد کاربری اپلیکشین، پیشنهاد یا سؤالی دارید با میخواهید با گزارش کردن اشکال ما را در بهبود آن یاری دهید، نظرات خود را به این آدرس بفرستید: 
mobapps.rferl@gmail.com

bluejetty:00182933:ios.description:
We are - researchers, the small crew which seek for a sea adventures. Our route ran not far from the Cuba islands. Small, but cozy ship sailed along the waves with a favorable wind.
The aim of the crew was to solve the mystery puzzles that one of the scientists assigned to us. He talked about ancient maps, which were a puzzle. Professor unraveled on them an ship puzzle, in which it was told about the ancient genus of the Spaniards. Having transported ancient artifacts and treasures, these people had to constantly survive on the ship every time getting into the maelstrom of events, playing ship games and puzzles in real life. For us, this task was - the most difficult puzzle that we ever perform. There have been various mystery games, but today we were delighted in a double, were eager to move forward to new ship adventure and get into curise ship.
But in life there are different and you never know where your ship will lead next time to try your luck and possibly get into the most incredible adventure, survive at any cost. On our way, the captain and the ships ahead in the nearest radius reported that, according to the latest weather forecast, there were huge black storm clouds ahead of us, i.e. there is a storm.
The captain decided to do something like a puzzle to escape from a storm, that is, a maneuver, his skill was always at the level of aerobatics. To bypass the storm, then to return to our goal of following. As a result, the storm did not manage to bypass at all, the ship was damaged. It was necessary to be engaged in repair more likely, as such ships can not long go in such condition and can turn to the sunken ship. Repair of the ship, cost a small expense, you can say for free in Russian ("for free").
We were ready to go further, but the transmitter intercepted the distress signal, again the horror quest, escape the ship, which still could not bypass the elements and got into the very storm. Without hesitation, we went to the rescue. Already accustomed to get into the woes or marine adventure! What could fate bring to us again?
When they reached the crash site of the children who sent the SOS signal, it was already clear that no one could escape the cruise ship. There was a picture of floating rags of clothes, wreckage and several boxes. I had to feel the unpleasant feeling that this sunken terrible ship cast like peoples try escape from titanic.
Then something happened that you learn by playing this game ...
... the ship began to panic, riots. Several crew members escaped from the box on the lifeboats. We have suffered, it can be said, a collapse in full scale. It remains only you, around anyone, where all gone and what to do in this situation? Life turns into a quest for survival. You will have to go through the path of survival on the ship and get home alive. Erase this ship a ghost from your memory will not be so easy. Cursed ship, will dream for a long time ...
Play for free in English, as well as in other languages.
Main advantages:
- Excellent exciting story.
- Stylish graphics.
- Many puzzles (quests).
- An interesting original story with hidden objects.
- Puzzle games, play with your family!
- Suitable for adults and children of all ages.
- No time limits.
- Do not have Wi-Fi? Play offline!
- Continue on the same place if there is no time to play now.

ChessMovePro offers a wide
bluejetty:00071706:ios.description:
Introducing ChessMovePro, the all-new powerful move calculator that lets users find the best move in seconds! The app calculates the best lines using powerful dedicated servers running Stockfish 16 in the cloud.
ChessMovePro offers a wide variety of customizations that allow users to find the best move quickly. Users can set up their board by dragging and dropping pieces onto the setup board to match the app to their current board position. Next head over to the analysis screen where you can see the best moves and lines at a glance. Customize the engine preset in order to increase depth, get more lines, change the elo target or increase think time.
ChessMovePro allows users to use their camera to scan chess positions and find the best moves to play within seconds. The dedicated Stockfish servers ensure only the best moves are shown and that users can analzye games at the highest level. 
In the settings, users can customize the look of their app with various boards and app colors. Upgrade to ChessMovePro in order to unlock the full suite of customizations for the app and take your experience to the next level!
How do I use Chess Move Pro?
After opening the app users first have to setup their chess board. Take advantage of the apps scanning feature and pull out your camera to caputre the position or place the chess pieces in the correct squares.
Next hit the analyze button and Chess Move Pro will analyze your current chess position using cloud Stockfish 15.1 servers that will find the best next chess move for you to play. If you don't like the next chess move that the app suggests hit the re-calculate button in order to calculate a new best move for the current position.
Terms and Conditions: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00134704:ios.description:
Glucose Companion is a handy blood sugar and weight tracker.
Keeping track of blood sugar is a good habit to keep healthy, heredity, unbalanced diet, fat, lack of exercise, too much stress etc will lead to diabetic. If blood sugar is found abnormal, quick actions should be done to keep it from getting worse.
Use Glucose Companion now to monitor your blood sugar and share your measurements with your doctor, it will help greatly to your physician to diagnose and treat your diabetes.
Key Features:
⁃ Easily add and edit blood sugar, weight and test date.
⁃ Add note to the readings.
⁃ Track blood sugar and weight by chart.
⁃ Analyze times and percentage of each blood sugar range.
⁃ Show MAX, MIN and AVG number of readings by number and histogram.
⁃ Show statistics of measurement by day, week, month or year.
⁃ Create reminders for measuring Glucose, doctor visiting or anything else.
⁃ Calculate average blood sugar and weight.
⁃ Create unlimited reminders with different time to measure your blood suger, doctor visit or others.
⁃ Save snapshots to Photos. 
⁃ Export (Email) readings in format of CSV, HTML or PDF.
⁃ Custom date range of readings to be exported.
⁃ Custom your own color range.
⁃ Passcode function to protect your info.
⁃ Supports Touch ID as passcode.
⁃ Supports multi-users, track the blood sugar of yours and your family’s.
⁃ Supports mg/dL and mmoL/L, US and SI.
⁃ Clean and humanized interface.
⁃ Support WiFi backup and restore.
⁃ Supports iCloud backup & restore. 
⁃ Supports Dropbox backup and restore.
⁃ Supports AirPrint in app.
⁃ Supports transferring data to Health app.
⁃ Supports 3D Touch function.
⁃ Supports Apple Watch version.
⁃ Supports Universal version.
If you have any questions or suggestion, please mail to userfeed@vip.tom.com.

bluejetty:00147213:ios.description:
Get in the best shape of your life with 1-on-1 remote personal training and nutrition coaching from one of our expert personal trainers and registered dietitians. 
Our expert coaches will build you a customized exercise and nutrition program, guide you via live video sessions, and check in daily via text and video messages to keep you on track. Everything is done remotely, on your schedule. 
We are on a mission to increase access to elite training - we work hard to slash or even remove the cost of training. Clients with qualifying insurance pay only a copay - everyone else pays a low monthly subscription, fully HSA/FSA eligible.
HOW DO I GET STARTED?
1. Download the app and complete our short questionnaire to get matched with the perfect coach
2. Choose your subscription plan or enter your insurance information and complete purchase of subscription or any applicable copay (many clients have $0 copay)
3. Complete your first video call with your coach to dive deep and get to work.
4. Begin your daily custom workouts, personalized meal plans, and coaching support, with the option for weekly video calls.
WHY KICKOFF WORKS 
- The only affordable way to get daily support & accountability from an expert fitness and nutrition coach
- We take the time to understand your preferences, lifestyle, and goals to match you with the perfect coach
- An expert human coach is able to customize your fitness plan infinitely more than any automated app or online videos could
- Our coaches account for nutrition, sleep, stress management, and more in addition to exercise
- We're always just a text message away to help you overcome obstacles and stay on track
SUBSCRIPTION DETAILS:
- Copay or subscription payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase
- Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period
- Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period
- You may manage your subscription and turn off auto-renewal by going to your Apple Account Settings after purchase
- Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription
https://www.trainwithkickoff.com/terms

bluejetty:00045933:ios.description:
دىلكان فىلىم - شىركىتىمىز كۆڭۈل قويۇپ بەرپا قىلغان فىلىم سۇپىسى بولۇپ، ئابونتلارنى مول، كۆپ خىل، ئەلا سۈپەتلىك، ئېسىل فىلىم، پىروگرامما، سۈرئەتلىك ناخشا، ئىتوت قاتارلىق سەر خىل مەزمۇنلار بىلەن تەمىنلەيدۇ. لايىھەلىنىشى ئاددىي، ئىشلىتىشكە قولاي، سۈرئىتى تېز، يوقىرى ئېنىقلىقتا فىلىم قويۇشنى قوللايدۇ.
1. 【 كۆرۈنمە يۈز لايىھەسى 】
مۇرەككەپ ئېلېمېنتلار چىقىرىپ تاشلانغان، سىن مەزمۇنىنى ئىخچام كۆرسىتىشنى ئاساس قىلغان. مەشغۇلات قىلىشقا قولايلىق بولۇپ، راھەت كۆرۈش سېزىمى ئېلىپ كېلىدۇ.
2. 【 سەرخىل مەزمۇن 】
فىلىم مەنبەسى مول، يېڭىلىنىشى تېز. تاللانغان نەچچە مىڭ سائەتلىك نادىر كىنو، تىياتىر، پىروگرامما ھەرقانداق ئابونتنىڭ ئېھتىياجىنى قاندۇرىدۇ.
3. 【 كۆرۈش تەسىراتى 】
يوقىرى ئېنىقلىقتىكى ۋىدىئو بىلەن تەمىنلەيدۇ، كۆپ خىل ئېنىقلىق دەرىجىسىنى تاللاشقا بولىدۇ، ئىلغار تېخنىكىلارنى قوللىنىپ، يۈكلەش سۈرئىتى تېز، قويۇلۇشى راۋان، ئوخشىمىغان تور مۇھىتىغا ماسلاشتۇرۇلغان.
4. 【 ئىشلىتىش تەسىراتى 】
ئومۇمىي قۇرۇلمىسى ئېنىق، ئىقتىدار ئالماشتۇرۇش راۋان، مەشغۇلاتى ئاددىي.
5. 【 كېچە كۈندۈز ھالىتى 】
ئابونتلارنىڭ كېچىدە ئىشلىتىش ئېھتىياجىنى كۆزدە تۇتۇپ، ئاپتوماتىك ھالدا قېنىق رەڭلىك كۆرۈنمە يۈزنى تەڭشەپ، كۆزنىڭ غىدىقلىنىشىنى ئازايتقان. كېچىدە سىن قويۇش ئۈنۈمى ئەلالاشتۇرۇلغان.

Tired of financial worries? With MoneyLover, you’ll feel like you’ve hired your own personal finance manager — one that’s with you 24/7.

- Widget: Log transactions directly from your home screen — faster and easier than ever.
- Automatic bill reminders — no more late fees!
- Debt management — crush those debts with confidence.

- Unlock lifetime access to our Premium features — no monthly fees, just a one-time purchase (excluding Linked Wallet service).

- Keep track of your savings goals as they grow.

Calorie Counter: Food Tracker makes achieving your weight goals simple and effective.
Whether you want to lose weight, gain weight, or maintain a balanced diet, the app provides a personalized daily calorie allowance based on your height, weight, and goals. bluejetty:00177528:ios.description:
1, USB3.0 A, to connect to Mac or PC. In this way, iDiskk acts as a general USB drive. Users can manager files in it, copy, cut, past or delete, ect. Users can also browse files in it directly, including preview documents, playback music and movies.
2, Apple lightning connector, to connect to iOS device with lightning connector. With this app, iDiskk Player, users can manager files in it, copy, cut, past or delete, ect. Users can also browse files in it directly, including preview documents such as .txt, .doc, .pdf, playback music and movies.
(More information could be found on the website http://www.idiskk.com)
iDiskk Player is the App of the iDiskk drive, it supports the following features:
* Browse files in the iDiskk.
* Browse files in the app.
* Transfer files between the iDiskk and the app.

bluejetty:00041800:ios.description:
StartUp Business
Build your empire from zero, no waiting, no auto-play. Every decision, every trade, every hire is yours.
Step into the role of a modern CEO and create the company you've always envisioned. Hire the right people, run factories, manage logistics, and compete on global markets as your business evolves in a living economy shaped by real supply, demand, and strategy.
Build factories
Place factories anywhere on the world map and industrialize production. Choose locations strategically to cut costs and speed up delivery by staying close to resources and major markets.
Ship globally
Sign shipping contracts and move goods across continents. Connect factories, warehouses, and points of sale into a logistics network that keeps products flowing when competitors try to disrupt your supply chain.
Build your team
Hire employees with distinct skills, personalities, salaries, and moods. Assemble teams, appoint leaders, and manage productivity to unlock bonuses and support long-term growth.
Relocate your HQ
Move your headquarters to any city worldwide. Your location affects operating costs, access to opportunities, and how your brand shows up on the global stage.
Expand your empire
Upgrade your headquarters, rent warehouses, and manage space efficiently as you grow. Scale across multiple product lines and industries without losing control of performance.
Produce and sell
Turn raw materials into finished products and sell on a live global market. Prices shift in real time based on supply, demand, and player activity — every production decision can pay off or create risk.
Trade with players worldwide
Buy and sell resources directly with other players in a true multiplayer economy. Shortages, overproduction, and sudden demand can reshape markets and open new opportunities overnight.
Go public
List your company on the stock market and let others invest in your success. Manage reputation, growth expectations, and shareholder value as a public company.
Get AI-powered guidance
Unlock Board AI advisors for economy, wallet, warehouse, and supply chain decisions — built for players who want data-driven strategy, not guesswork.
Stay informed
Follow SBNews to track market changes, global trends, and emerging opportunities that can influence your next move.
Compete every week
Climb weekly leaderboards and earn exclusive rewards, including unique headquarters skins and premium boosts.
If you enjoy building, managing, trading, and watching a real economy respond to your decisions, StartUp Business is your world.
Ready to become the next global tycoon?
Download StartUp Business today and start building your empire.

bluejetty:00099321:ios.description:
Merge Battle Trains: Epic Idle War Adventure
Welcome to a 2D world where steel beasts ride the rails and rain fire upon their enemies! In this epic idle merge game, you are the commander of a powerful battle train. Assemble cars, merge weapons, and upgrade your armored convoy into an unstoppable force.
The war has begun. Are you ready to fight, shoot, and win?
GAMEPLAY THAT KEEPS YOU HOOKED
Tap, merge, and upgrade to build your train into a deadly shooter machine. Combine guns, turrets, and combat gear to increase firepower. Then roll your train down the railroad, blasting through waves of enemies and massive bosses in thrilling battles.
Every part of your train matters — from the freight cars you load to the guns you place. Create the best strategy to survive longer and achieve higher scores.
TOP FEATURES
Merge combat units
Start with basic guns
Merge them to create stronger, more advanced firepower
Discover special and unique combinations to boost your train’s attack
Epic shooting action
Enjoy satisfying shooter gameplay in a fun, simplified 2D style
Feel the blast as you hit enemies, destroy tanks, and tear through waves
Upgrade and build your base
Unlock new trains, weapons, and armor
Expand your railroad empire
Grow from a small station to a massive military base
Nuclear explosions & boss fights
Face giant bosses and enemy tanks in intense battles
Use nuclear attacks and powerful guns to dominate
Keep your train simulator running at full speed to survive
Explore the global battlefield
Travel through deserts, cities, and icy lands
Visit new stations and train locations
Fight on different tracks and become the best rail commander
PLAY SOLO OR WITH FRIENDS
Take on missions in single-player levels
Or connect with friends and partners to complete special objectives
Compare scores and see who commands the best battle train
DAILY REWARDS & BONUSES
Log in daily to collect free rewards
Open packs of weapons and gear
Earn currency and upgrade your army faster
A GAME OF STRATEGY AND SPEED
This isn’t just about tapping and watching explosions. You’ll need smart planning, fast reactions, and the ability to build a train that’s ready for any war. Think ahead, choose wisely, and control every shot fired from your guns.
Are you the commander this world needs?
BECOME A MERGE MASTER
Crush enemies in the most awesome train simulator ever
Rise through levels and unlock giant battle engines
Command a growing army of steel and firepower
Rule the global battlefield and earn your place as a legend
Whether you love idle games, shooting games, or unique merge experiences — this one brings it all on tracks. This is not just a game, it’s a thrilling adventure across rails where you create, learn, and destroy. No complex controls, just pure fun, explosive action, and strategic depth!
Ready to take command?
Start building your dream train army and jump into this epic ride today!

Shuttlers is a platform that allows professionals, companies, fun-seekers access comfortable, safe, efficient yet affordable transportation to & from work and around the city through bus-pooling!
Do you want to spend your commuting time productively rather than driving yourself through traffic, or standing in long bus queues or sitting on a very uncomfortable bus?

bluejetty:00015927:ios.description:
Why play just one backgammon game when you can play them ALL?
Why play only against the computer when you can play your FRIENDS from all over the world?
iTavli brings together 15 backgammon games in one app. Play against a friend, or challenge the computer at four levels of difficulty, including the new Expert level.
THE GAMES
• Modern Backgammon (with the Doubling Cube)
• Portes (Backgammon)
• LongGammon
• Plakoto (Blockgammon): land on your opponent's single checker to pin it
• Plakoto Express
• Fevga (Narde): you can't hit, so you have to block your opponent's way
• Russian Narde
• Khacapuri
• Gul Bara
• Acey Deucey (American)
• Acey Deucey (European)
• Nackgammon
• Tawla 31
• Gioul
• Moultezim
TOURNAMENTS
• Set a winning score and play a tournament against your opponent: Portes, Plakoto and Fevga, in that order
PLAY ONLINE
• Play with friends and players from all over the world
• Choose your opponent and the game you want to play
• Chat during the game
• Watch other players' games live
• Create or join a Private Room
• Get notified when your opponent goes offline or comes back online
• Online statistics
Visit www.itavli.com for instructions.
PLAY NEARBY
• Connect over Bluetooth and play with friends next to you
FEATURES
• Realistic 3D rolling dice
• Three ways to roll: auto-roll, tap to roll, or shake to roll
• Move checkers with a tap
• Unlimited undo for each turn
• Realistic sound
• Statistics for every game
• Save player names
• Choose your checker colors and your opponent's
• Left or right board layout

bluejetty:00118714:ios.name: mBank PL - Twój bank i finanse
bluejetty:00118714:ios.summary: Kontroluj swoje finanse, sprawdzaj historię transakcji i błyskawicznie wysyłaj przelewy online. Płać w sklepie lub internecie za pomocą BLIKA lub Apple Pay. Korzystaj ze swojej bankowości online o każdej porze dnia i nocy. Konto w mBanku za
bluejetty:00118714:ios.description:
Kontroluj swoje finanse, sprawdzaj historię transakcji i błyskawicznie wysyłaj przelewy online. Płać w sklepie lub internecie za pomocą BLIKA lub Apple Pay. Korzystaj ze swojej bankowości online o każdej porze dnia i nocy. Konto w mBanku założysz łatwo i wygodnie w aplikacji, teraz także z aplikacją mObywatel.
Co zyskasz z aplikacją mBanku?
Podróże z kartą Visa Świat Intensive albo Visa Podróże
• płać kartą w kraju i za granicą
• bez opłat za przewalutowanie, zawsze
• blokuj niechciane transakcje za granicą jednym kliknięciem
Bezpieczeństwo
W aplikacji znajdziesz narzędzia wspierające Twoje bezpieczeństwo w codziennym bankowaniu:
• bezpieczne logowanie i autoryzacja
• lista zaleceń bezpieczeństwa
• darmowy dostęp do specjalistów od bezpieczeństwa w sieci
• tymczasowa blokada lub zastrzeżenie karty w ciągu kilku sekund
• limity i powiadomienia push o transakcjach
• ukrywanie kwot na pulpicie
Finanse osobiste pod kontrolą
W każdym momencie sprawdzisz stan swojego konta bankowego, przejrzysz historię transakcji i zaplanowane płatności.
Menedżer finansów pomoże Ci zadbać o domowy budżet
• jednym kliknięciem sprawdzisz swoje wpływy i wydatki
• automatycznie je posegregujemy i przypiszemy do wybranej kategorii
• na przejrzystych wykresach zobaczysz swoje wpływy i wydatki, w podziale na lata lub miesiące
• ustawisz swój miesięczny budżet
Szybkie przelewy
• zamiast wysyłać znajomym numer konta, wyślij im kod QR
• skanuj dane do przelewu bez konieczności wprowadzania długich numerów kont
Wygodne płatności kartą
• płać kartą do konta w sklepie i internecie
• korzystaj z płatności zbliżeniowych
• dodaj kartę do płatności mobilnych Apple Pay i płać telefonem
Płatności BLIK
• płać za zakupy w internecie i sklepach stacjonarnych
• wypłacaj pieniądze z bankomatu
• płać zbliżeniowo BLIKIEM - wystarczy, że odblokujesz swój telefon i przyłożysz go do terminala
• przelewaj na numer telefonu - nie musisz znać numeru konta odbiorcy, wystarczy jego numer telefonu
• wysyłaj prośbę o przelew na telefon i rozliczaj się łatwo ze znajomymi
Oszczędności i inwestycje
Konto oszczędnościowe, lokaty, fundusze, giełda – znajdź swój sposób na odkładanie pieniędzy na małe i duże plany.
Ubezpieczenia
Skorzystaj z oferty naszych ubezpieczeń i chroń siebie, bliskich oraz swoje mienie. Przygotuj się na niespodziewane.
Elastyczne limity
Planujesz większy wydatek? Zmień jednym kliknięciem limity dla kart lub płatności BLIK.
Dopasuj aplikację do siebie
• utwórz skróty na pulpicie do ulubionych funkcji
• wybierz najwygodniejszy sposób logowania - odcisk palca, skan twarzy czy PIN
• ustaw produkty, które chcesz widzieć po zalogowaniu, np. konto, kartę kredytową, rachunek walutowy
• ukryj wszystkie kwoty na pulpicie
Mobilna autoryzacja
Szybko i bezpiecznie potwierdzaj swoje operacje, bez przepisywania haseł SMS. Dane operacji znajdziesz w powiadomieniu autoryzacyjnym w telefonie. Klikasz, zatwierdzasz i gotowe.
Powiadomienia push
Ustaw bezpłatne powiadomienia push i bądź zawsze na bieżąco, z tym co dzieje się na Twoim koncie. To Ty decydujesz, jakie powiadomienia chcesz otrzymywać.
mOkazje
Płać naszą kartą i odbieraj zwroty za wybrane zakupy - prosto na swoje konto.
Szybka pomoc i kontakt
Skorzystaj z intuicyjnej wyszukiwarki i znajdź szybko odpowiedzi na swoje pytania. Jeśli potrzebujesz pomocy naszego pracownika, napisz na czacie lub połącz się przez mLinię na klik. Wystarczy jedno kliknięcie. Bez dodatkowych haseł i kodów od razu będziemy wiedzieć, że to Ty!
Skorzystaj z dodatkowych usług w aplikacji:
• zapłać za parking
• wymieniaj waluty
• załatwiaj sprawy bankowe i urzędowe (np. wnioski 800+, 300+)
• doładuj telefon
• sprawdzaj stan konta przed zalogowaniem
• znajdź najbliższe bankomaty, wpłatomaty i placówki
Więcej informacji o aplikacji mobilnej znajdziesz na:
https://www.mbank.pl/pomoc/faq/bankowosc-mobilna/
Właścicielem aplikacji mBank PL - Twój bank i finanse jest:
mBank PL

00-850 Warszawa

bluejetty:00016241:ios.description:
CricClubs is the world’s most preferred cricket scoring app to score any type or size of cricket tournament or cricket match.   A free cutting edge tech platform, which not only allows you to get scores and updates of your own local leagues but also offers its viewers live ball-by-ball coverage of all international cricket matches and news ranging from match reports to juicy stories on cricket stars.
You can also share your thoughts, achievements and stories with your cricket loving peers.
CricClubs is every cricket lover’s one-stop shop for everything cricket. Did we mention, its FREE!
Features -   Ball by ball live cricket scores, domestic and international, for your favourite cricket matches.
• Create & build your own cricket profile just like an international cricketer. 
• Have you ever wanted to organise a cricket league and deliver the league to a wider audience without any hassle? If you are a league manager, manage your entire league absolutely FREE! Get a dedicated page, score card, points table, schedule, leaderboard, ball tracker, wagon wheel, Manhattan, Worm, Run rate graphs and much more. Create the tournament, add your team and boom! 
• Become a top notch cricketer by analysing your own and your competitor’s strengths and weaknesses.   Full cricket match scorecards, schedules, news and editorials
•Live stream your local cricket matches. Following live scores is fun but do you know what is more fun? Try beating the thrill of watching it live on your mobile screen.
• Relish cricket news, trivia’s, facts, quizzes, polls and more.   Cricket equipment and Merchandise - The one stop shop for all your cricketing needs – products & services.  CricClubs is an app for all those people who love, live, eat, sleep, pray Cricket around the globe.  CricClubs Insights  - Become a world-class cricketer with Insights  - Player Insights: Analyse yours and every other player’s profile. Compare yourself with other cricketers and see who wins in a head to head battle.  Cricketing Community  - A Social networking site for all cricket lovers where they can follow their friends, share, like, comment on their activities. - Explore cricket products and cricket leagues near your locations. - List your Cricket Ground, and Cricket leagues to manage it more professionally.
- Want to have a random discussion with your friend about that Kohli century or if CSK were wrong in their approach? Or what about a discussion on the bad off-side strategy your friend employed in one of the tournaments on CricClubs. Well, CricClubs provides you the opportunity to be your own expert and connect with your friends for a chat about it. 
 With millions of cricketers using CricClubs to live score their local cricket matches and tournaments, it is already the favourite Cricketing App of the die-hard cricket fans in the world. It is also the editor’s choice with more than 4.6 rating!
 Looking forward to having you on as an exclusive member of CricClubs and let us know your feedback and suggestions to improve the app. We are just one email away at support@criclcubs.com.

bluejetty:00031028:ios.name: Elite Picks: AI Sports Betting
bluejetty:00031028:ios.summary: Elite Picks runs advanced machine learning model projections on player props across NFL, NBA, MLB, and PGA, comparing every projection against live sportsbook lines and scoring each player from 0 to 100 so you can see at a glance where the
bluejetty:00031028:ios.description:
Elite Picks runs advanced machine learning model projections on player props across NFL, NBA, MLB, and PGA, comparing every projection against live sportsbook lines and scoring each player from 0 to 100 so you can see at a glance where the model disagrees with the book with our proprietary models.
FEATURES
- AI Agent: an automated slate builder that scans the full board each day and sends its selections by push notification
Player Prop Projections: machine learning models covering NFL, NBA, MLB, and PGA
- Parlay Builder: construct same game and cross sport parlays, with correlation accounted for
- Sportsbook Deep Linking: send a selection straight into your sportsbook app with the bet slip partly generated, so you only confirm the stake
- Estimated Profit: view the probability distribution of outcomes for a given slate before placing bets
- Track Record: complete history of every pick and result, permanently public
- EP Academy: a 10 issue curriculum covering line shopping, closing line value, bankroll management, and prop modeling
- News and Injuries: lineup changes and late scratches as they are reported
WHO IT'S FOR
Elite Picks is a modeling and research tool rather than a tip service. It assumes some familiarity with line shopping, closing line value, and expected value, and it is built for bettors who want to see the reasoning behind a projection rather than just a list of plays.
SUBSCRIPTION
Elite Picks Pro is available at $69.99 per month or $499.99 per year.
Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase
Subscriptions renew automatically unless auto renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period
Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period
Subscriptions can be managed and auto renewal turned off in your Account Settings after purchase
Terms of Use: https://elitepicks.ai/terms
Privacy Policy: https://elitepicks.ai/privacy-policy
Must be 21 or older. Please bet responsibly. If you or someone you know has a gambling problem, call 1-800-GAMBLER.

bluejetty:00083866:ios.description:
Go for a run with voice navigation along the way, explore like a local when you travel, find a runner-friendly hotel, or take on an audio-guided race.
RunGo is the app that gives directions.
We call it "navigation beyond maps."
Looking to find or create and follow a running route?
Hands down, the easiest way to stay on track and enjoy your run is customized, turn-by-turn voice navigation.
RunGo is the most popular running app featuring turn-by-turn voice navigation, with over a million routes worldwide across 171 countries, including thousands of verified routes, like race courses, hotel tours, audio-guided mindful walks, city tours, unique adventures, and virtual races.
Stay engaged with voice messages about landmarks you pass, local stories, or an encouraging reminder that you're halfway there.
Turn any route in an engaging, voice-guided tour!
You're probably beyond trying to memorize every turn, printing out maps, checking your phone’s map every block, or never doing anything new!
RunGo also tracks your run stats like time, pace, distance, elevation, and estimated finish time.
We proudly include no ads in the app, and a paid premium upgrade is available for additional features.
Featured by Apple to "Run New Routes Wherever You Are,” “Walk to Get Fit,” “Run Your First 5K,” and "Unleash the Power of Apple Watch."
WHAT PEOPLE LIKE YOU SAY
“Only running app with turn-by-turn directions… 30+ turns on new roads that I wasn’t about to memorize.” -iPhone user review
“RunGo was a great way to get a feel of the areas and feel more secure running by myself.” -Jess
WHEN YOU TRAVEL
Running is the best way to explore a city when you travel! With routes around the world, curated by passionate locals showing off the best of their city and by RunGo’s hotel partners, you can enjoy your run at your own pace with voice navigation to keep you on track. Find your next runner-friendly hotel to visit.
WHY VOICE NAVIGATION?
Voice navigation allows you to follow complex routes effortlessly. Explore routes with clear voice directions as you approach each turn, and get notified when you go off route. RunGo is Accessible and supports VoiceOver for visually impaired users.
BUILD YOUR OWN ROUTES
Map out custom routes right on your iPhone, or import a GPX file to RunGo. Create basic routes on your phone, while the full customization is on our web route creator. Any routes you create on the web route creator will also appear on your iPhone.
LIVE TRACKING
RunGo Live lets friends and family track your runs and races in real time on any web browser.
APPLE WATCH
With RunGo’s Apple Watch app, get turn-by-turn directions and haptic notifications on your wrist, and run complex routes without needing your iPhone.
RunGo uses HealthKit for Heart Rate data with the Apple Watch and to record workout data to the Health app.
You can subscribe and pay through your iTunes account. Payment is charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Account is charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period at the initial monthly or annual cost. Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription, where applicable. More information at rungoapp.com/legal
* Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.

listings.name: RunGo - The Best Routes to Run
listings.description:
Go for a run with voice navigation along the way, explore like a local when you travel, find a runner-friendly hotel, or take on an audio-guided race.

RunGo is the app that gives directions.

We call it "navigation beyond maps."

Looking to find or create and follow a running route?
Hands down, the easiest way to stay on track and enjoy your run is customized, turn-by-turn voice navigation.

RunGo is the most popular running app featuring turn-by-turn voice navigation, with over a million routes worldwide across 171 countries, including thousands of verified routes, like race courses, hotel tours, audio-guided mindful walks, city tours, unique adventures, and virtual races.

Stay engaged with voice messages about landmarks you pass, local stories, or an encouraging reminder that you're halfway there.

Turn any route in an engaging, voice-guided tour!

You're probably beyond trying to memorize every turn, printing out maps, checking your phone’s map every block, or never doing anything new!

RunGo also tracks your run stats like time, pace, distance, elevation, and estimated finish time.

We proudly include no ads in the app, and a paid premium upgrade is available for additional features.

Featured by Apple to "Run New Routes Wherever You Are,” “Walk to Get Fit,”  “Run Your First 5K,” and "Unleash the Power of Apple Watch."

WHAT PEOPLE LIKE YOU SAY
“Only running app with turn-by-turn directions… 30+ turns on new roads that I wasn’t about to memorize.” -iPhone user review
“RunGo was a great way to get a feel of the areas and feel more secure running by myself.” -Jess

WHEN YOU TRAVEL
Running is the best way to explore a city when you travel! With routes around the world, curated by passionate locals showing off the best of their city and by RunGo’s hotel partners, you can enjoy your run at your own pace with voice navigation to keep you on track. Find your next runner-friendly hotel to visit.

WHY VOICE NAVIGATION?
Voice navigation allows you to follow complex routes effortlessly. Explore routes with clear voice directions as you approach each turn, and get notified when you go off route. RunGo is Accessible and supports VoiceOver for visually impaired users.

BUILD YOUR OWN ROUTES
Map out custom routes right on your iPhone, or import a GPX file to RunGo. Create basic routes on your phone, while the full customization is on our web route creator. Any routes you create on the web route creator will also appear on your iPhone.

LIVE TRACKING
RunGo Live lets friends and family track your runs and races in real time on any web browser.

APPLE WATCH
With RunGo’s Apple Watch app, get turn-by-turn directions and haptic notifications on your wrist, and run complex routes without needing your iPhone.

RunGo uses HealthKit for Heart Rate data with the Apple Watch and to record workout data to the Health app.

You can subscribe and pay through your iTunes account. Payment is charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Account is charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period at the initial monthly or annual cost. Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription, where applicable. More information at rungoapp.com/legal

* Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.

bluejetty:00122352:ios.description:

bluejetty:00089321:ios.description:
Introducing the smartest, most effortless way to scan and digitize documents on iPhone. ScannerKit is the document and PDF scanner that transforms physical papers into perfectly organized digital files - so you can focus on your work while our AI handles the perfect capture, enhancement, and organization of every document.
Whether you're capturing multi-page contracts or quickly digitizing receipts, ScannerKit's intelligent scanning technology handles the hard work. Just point your camera and watch as it automatically detects edges, corrects perspective, and enhances readability. Every scan becomes a crisp, professional PDF ready to store, sign, or share.
SCANNERKIT'S DOCUMENT & PDF SCANNER FEATURES
INTELLIGENT AUTO-CAPTURE
Point and scan. Our AI detects document edges and captures the perfect shot automatically - no tapping or adjusting needed.
MAGICALLY SCAN-HANCE™ EVERY DOCUMENT 
One tap transforms your scans with advanced enhancement filters, perfecting brightness, contrast, and text clarity instantly.
UNLIMITED MULTI-PAGE SCANNING
Capture documents of any length. Combine pages, reorder them, and create organized PDF files with perfect consistency.
SIGN AND SHARE INSTANTLY
Add signatures to any document right on your phone. Share professional PDFs without ever needing a printer.
ADD ANYTHING FROM YOUR CAMERA ROLL 
Turn photos into high-quality scans by importing directly from your camera roll. Whether it’s a receipt or whiteboard, enhance, edit, and share with precision—keeping your content organized in one place.
NO CROPPING NECESSARY 
Easily frame your scans with preset crop options. Perfectly align anything–forms, notes, business cards, and images–in seconds for a professional finish every time.
Every feature in ScannerKit is designed to save you time and deliver perfect results. Stop dealing with poor quality scans, complicated apps, and disorganized files. Join the professionals who trust ScannerKit to handle their document scanning needs with unmatched speed and precision.
SCAN SMARTER, NOT HARDER 
• Scan anything, anywhere. From receipts to contracts, whiteboards to books—capture it all in perfect clarity.
• Professional-quality results. Every scan is automatically enhanced for crisp, clear, ready-to-use documents.
• Smart organization. Intelligent filing and auto-detection make your scans instantly useful.
• Seamless integration. Share your scans directly with Google Drive, Dropbox, and other platforms you use daily.
• Multi-page mastery. Handle multi-page documents with ease—perfect for contracts, reports, and lengthy paperwork.
• Import existing photos. Transform any photo from your camera roll into a high-quality scan with powerful enhancement tools.
ScannerKit is free to download. A subscription is required to use the service, but you can try it out completely free. Once the trial ends, your subscription will automatically renew and you'll be billed. You can cancel your subscription at any time by contacting Apple Support.

Privacy Policy:    https://scannerkit.com/privacy

bluejetty:00179173:ios.summary:

• Get information about discounts, new products, current Superpoint offers and digital coupons befo
bluejetty:00179173:ios.description:
The Coop online supermarket app offers a comprehensive package of functions that makes your shopping experience as comfortable as possible:
• Get information about discounts, new products, current Superpoint offers and digital coupons before every shop.
• Create your shopping list conveniently while on the go.
• Have day-to-day products, food and beverages delivered when you want. 
• Store your Coop Supercard in the app and take advantage of many other benefits.
Download the supermarket app for Coop Switzerland now and enjoy a new way to shop online!
BUY FOOD CONVENIENTLY ONLINE WITH THE APP
Coop's online food shop gives you direct access to our diverse range of products. Take advantage of our food and beverage delivery service and choose a delivery time that suits you.
DISCOVER A HUGE RANGE OF PRODUCTS
In addition to a wide range of fresh foods and a large selection of wines and beverages, you will also find numerous day-to-day items in Coop's online supermarket – including household, baby & child care and cosmetic products.
WINES FROM AROUND THE WORLD
Discover a selection of wines from around the world in Coop's online supermarket and enjoy some great bottles from Switzerland, France, Italy and Spain. Whether you're looking for sparkling champagne or aromatic red wines – with the Coop app, you can have your favourites delivered conveniently to your home.
SUPERMARKET OFFERS & NEW PRODUCTS
Stay informed about weekly special offers and new products in your Coop supermarket. The Coop app displays all of the offers relevant to your shop, ensuring you get the best value when buying your groceries.
MANAGE SHOPPING LISTS
Here's how online shopping is done today: create your next shopping list from the comfort of your sofa to order your favourite food and beverages in the online supermarket quickly and easily.
SPECIAL OFFER ALERT
Never miss another special offer on your favourite products: choose up to 20 products and a push notification will tell you about current offers once a week!
FLEXIBLE DELIVERY OPTIONS
Decide for yourself how you would like to receive your online grocery order. Choose from either convenient delivery to your home or collection from your preferred Coop store.
DIGITAL COUPONS & COLLECTION PASSES
Cash in with exclusive digital coupons that you can redeem directly in the app. Save money on selected products and enjoy additional benefits. What's more, every purchase you make in the Coop supermarket app contributes to your digital collection passes. Collect points and secure attractive rewards!
MAKING SHOPPING EASIER IN STORE
Shopping is made even easier in Coop stores, too: create a shopping list and vary the order of items within the list to conveniently give you the best route through the store. The app will take you to the items on your list step by step.
SUPERCARD FUNCTIONS
Store your Coop Supercard in the app to be able to use all of the benefits of your customer card. Next time you shop, simply scan the QR code in the app at the checkout to collect your points and activate your personal discounts. You can also view your points balance at any time in the app.
LOCATION SEARCH & ROUTE PLANNER
Find the nearest Coop store in your area quickly and easily. Use the integrated location search in the Coop supermarket app and it will show you the best route to the store.
Do you have any suggestions for the Coop online shop, or are you experiencing problems when downloading or using the app? We look forward to receiving your feedback – please send it by e-mail to feedback-app@coop.ch.

bluejetty:00096225:ios.description:
Vegas Scratch Jackpot showcases a deep navy blue color scheme, crafted to deliver an authentic scratch card experience. Each swipe across the screen captures the distinct texture of physical scratch cards, letting you revisit the classic joy of scratch games in a virtual space.
Core Features
Diverse Gameplay, Rich Experience
Alongside the beloved classic scratch card format, the game includes engaging modes like spinning wheels. This variety breaks through monotony, catering to different preferences and ensuring there’s always a way to enjoy yourself while uncovering new delights.
Exquisite Audio and Visuals, Immersive Atmosphere
Boasting intricate graphics and thoughtfully designed effects, every detail is refined with care. Paired with immersive sound—from the subtle scratch of the screen to dynamic winning melodies—it creates a vivid atmosphere that makes you feel part of a lively gaming moment.
Simple Operation, Sustained Fun
Controls are intuitive, allowing even new players to start easily. The blend of scratch card styles ensures lasting engagement, letting you chase virtual prizes with a steady sense of achievement and novelty.
Regular Updates, Endless Surprises
The development team continues to roll out new content, adding fresh gameplay elements and scene details. Ongoing optimizations mean long-term play brings new challenges and joys, making each launch something to look forward to.
Download Vegas Scratch Jackpot to start your scratch card adventure and savor the enduring appeal of classic games!

KEY FEATURES 
▶
bluejetty:00045170:ios.description:

CasaVista can remodel your living room, bedroom, kitchen, garage, or any other space in your home. Now you can see how your space looks with different walls, new furniture, or an all-new floor color.

Your own design project is ready literally a minute after you upload a photo of your space. CasaVista is always on your phone to instantly design any room you want. Use it for inspiration, design moodboards, fresh ideas, and new makeover plans. 
▶ Try an AI home design app for everyone 
Interior designers no longer need to get stuck on design mockups. CasaVista helps them quickly generate fresh ideas, just like the homeowners looking for renovation inspiration. Real estate agents can benefit from CasaVista too - using the app on a client appointment to visualize how they can transform this space into the one they’ve always dreamt of. 
Let your redesign vision come to life in a moment 
Try CasaVista to discover new levels of how perfect your home can be.

• Annual Subscription

bluejetty:00070558:ios.description:
Con l’app Alfabeto Banking porti la tua banca sempre con te. L’app semplice e completa per essere utilizzata in totale comodità.
Con la nuova app Alfabeto Banking puoi gestire tutte le operazioni bancarie in qualsiasi momento, ovunque ti trovi. Accedi con il pin, con l’impronta digitale o con il riconoscimento del viso e hai subito la tua banca a disposizione. 
Con la nuova app Alfabeto Banking puoi: 
- visualizzare il saldo e i movimenti di conti e carte, controllare ed analizzare l’andamento delle tue spese;
- gestire le carte di credito, di debito e prepagate e le carte virtuali, configurare i limiti e le modalità di utilizzo all’estero, collegare le tue carte ai servizi di pagamento digitale;

Passa dall’app Banking alle app Trading e Patrimonio con un tap.

bluejetty:00038118:ios.name: Green P
bluejetty:00038118:ios.summary: The newest release of Toronto's only official "Green P App" from the Toronto Parking Authority makes parking easier and faster than ever. Available for on-street parking, all non-gated off-street carparks, and now at participating gated car
bluejetty:00038118:ios.description:
The newest release of Toronto's only official "Green P App" from the Toronto Parking Authority makes parking easier and faster than ever. Available for on-street parking, all non-gated off-street carparks, and now at participating gated carparks. Skip fumbling for change or waiting at a machine by using the app to pay for parking in seconds.
With this update, you can now start and pay for gated parking sessions by simply scanning a QR code at the entry gate. When you’re ready to leave, the app will automatically calculate your total and let you exit seamlessly, all without needing a paper ticket.
Set up your profile quickly and pay using Apple Pay, PayPal, or your credit card. Plus, the app will notify you when your parking time is about to expire, so you can extend it remotely if needed.
Key Features:
- Pay for parking in on-street, non-gated, and participating gated carparks
- Enter and exit gated carparks using QR codes
- Use your credit card, Apple Pay, or PayPal account for payment
- Receive reminders when your parking session is about to expire
- Extend your parking session remotely from your phone
- Use the Green P Locator to find carparks by GPS, address, or landmark
- Get parking receipts emailed directly to your inbox
- View your complete parking transaction history
You can learn more about our exciting mobile parking program at http://mobilepay.greenp.com/
For app support, email: mobilepay@greenp.com. We cannot respond to comments left in reviews.
Keep in mind, the Toronto Parking Authority reminds you that using your mobile phone (or any handheld device) while driving is unsafe and illegal in Ontario. Pull over or have a co-pilot do the navigating.
Powered by Passport – a leading provider of mobile payment technologies.

Calçados femininos 
Nossos sapatos e sandálias femininas, que são feit
bluejetty:00093718:ios.description:
Conheça os nossos calçados femininos que levam conforto, cor e a bossa carioca para os pés de mulheres independentes, que não se amarram a modismos e sabem onde pisam! 
Calçados femininos 
Nossos sapatos e sandálias femininas, que são feitos à mão, levam brasilidade e alta qualidade para seus pés. Com a Soulier, não te faltará bem-estar ao caminhar durante o dia. Cada detalhe é pensado no melhor para sua experiência. 
Aqui na Soulier, nós oferecemos sapatos femininos confortáveis que vão ser seus maiores aliados na rotina. Você pode encontrar em nossas coleções sapatilhas, mocassins e scarpins que oferecem um estilo mais clássico até o tênis e botas que representam um look mais despojado.
Já para você que prefere calçados mais frescos e leves, não deixe de conferir nossas sandálias femininas. Nós temos uma variedade de modelos de Anabelas, Meia Pata, Rasteiras e Saltos.
Seja para eventos mais formais ou aquelas ocasiões casuais no fim de semana, a Soulier tem a solução para compor o seu look com os melhores calçados femininos.
Acessórios femininos 
Além disso, temos acessórios disponíveis para você. Bolsas femininas, carteiras, cintos e até óculos para compor seu look e te ajudar a brilhar! 
Bolsas femininas 
Nossas bolsas são itens essenciais no guarda-roupa de qualquer mulher. Seja bolsa pequena, média ou grande, esse item sempre é um acessório essencial para carregar seus pertences importantes para os passeios. Além disso, se você precisar de mais espaço, pode contar com nossas mochilas de alta qualidade e seguras.
E se você precisar de um acessório para carregar sua comida durante sua rotina de trabalho, conte com as nossas bolsas térmicas. Sua comida será armazenada corretamente, com segurança e estilo. 
Se você é uma pessoa que gosta de se organizar, não esqueça de conferir nossas necessaires. Veja nossos diversos modelos com compartimentos extras e variedade de tamanhos para você levar seus itens pessoais que são necessários durante o dia.
Carteiras Femininas 
Todo mundo precisa de uma boa carteira, não é mesmo? É nesse acessório tão essencial que levamos dinheiro, cartões e documentos que não podemos andar sem. 
Confira nossos modelos exclusivos e escolha sua carteira feminina favorita para combinar com sua personalidade ou com a bolsa que você carrega durante a rotina. 
Óculos
Aqui na Soulier, nós temos óculos de sol exclusivos que refletem o melhor estilo dos dias quentes. Confira nossos modelos e adquira agora aquele que vai te acompanhar nas manhãs na praia ou naquele dia de piscina. 
Veja agora novidades e promoções exclusivas que a Soulier tem para te oferecer! 
Mais sobre a Solier: 
Fundada em 1982, a Soulier começou sua história como fábrica, com foco no mercado atacadista. Nessa época, produzia bolsas, sapatos e acessórios para grandes compradores em todo o país.
Em outubro de 2003, a marca estreou no varejo e abriu sua primeira loja em Ipanema, no Rio de Janeiro. 
Atualmente, estamos no mercado de calçados marcando nossos passos com qualidade e levando nosso espírito familiar para todo nosso público.
