bluejetty:00157215:ios.description:
Meet Class Keeper® — the easiest way to organize your child’s photos, artwork, school memories, and keepsakes all in one secure place.
Feeling overwhelmed by overflowing storage bins, thousands of photos on your phone, or the pressure to create the “perfect” scrapbook? Class Keeper® helps busy parents save the moments that matter — without the clutter, stress, or guilt.
Create a digital memory book for each child and preserve every stage of their journey from preschool through college.
Features parents love:
Unlimited Child Profiles
Create a personalized memory space for every child in your family.
Safe & Secure Photo Storage
Store and organize your child’s favorite memories in one secure place so they’re always easy to access and cherish.
Save Stories & Quotes
Capture funny sayings, milestone moments, and special memories in the Keepers section before they’re forgotten.
First & Last Day Highlight Reels
Automatically collect first-day and last-day school photos into one beautiful timeline so you can watch your child grow year after year.
Digitize Artwork & Keepsakes
Snap a photo of artwork, awards, crafts, and school projects to keep the memory without filling your home with bins and boxes.
Private Family Sharing
Invite grandparents and loved ones to view your child’s profile while staying in full control of access and privacy.
Organized School-Year Memories
Track milestones, memories, and photos from preschool to graduation in one easy-to-navigate app.
Class Keeper® is designed for parents who want to hold onto the memories — not the mess.

bluejetty:00127784:ios.description:

bluejetty:00131649:ios.summary:
A trusted reference for ultrasound-guided regional anesthesia, used by anesthesiologists and pain specialists worldwide.
The app supports clinical preparation and learning across a wide range of regional anesthesia techniques. Covering ne
bluejetty:00131649:ios.description:
A trusted reference for ultrasound-guided regional anesthesia, used by anesthesiologists and pain specialists worldwide.
The app supports clinical preparation and learning across a wide range of regional anesthesia techniques. Covering nerve block procedures from head and neck to upper and lower extremities, thoracic, and abdominal wall blocks, it brings structured guidance and clear anatomy into one focused reference.
Commonly performed techniques such as TAP (Transversus Abdominis Plane) block, ESP (Erector Spinae Plane) block, Interscalene Brachial Plexus Block, and Popliteal Sciatic Nerve Block are presented alongside many other approaches, each with ultrasound-focused visuals, functional anatomy, and step-by-step preparation.
Designed for everyday use, the app combines sonoanatomy, patient positioning, and block-specific considerations to support confident decision-making before and during clinical practice.
Developed by NYSORA, a global educational organization dedicated to advancing regional anesthesia through structured, practice-focused education.

NEED A SECOND PHONE NUMBER FOR PRIVATE CALLS AND TEXTS?
The Second Phone Number app offers a convenient way to acquire a second phone number for your personal needs without the need for an extra SIM card. This app also enables international calling and texting. You can select a second phone number and make calls without revealing your real number.
Maintain your international number for as long as you wish, and add more minutes and SMS to your Second Phone Number balance. Enjoy the cheapest rates for in-app credits to make calls worldwide from your second phone number!
Transform your phone into a full-featured business phone with the Second Phone Number App, providing:
• Choose any number from almost all area codes across the U.S. or Canada.
• Get a second phone number for calls and texting.
• Make calls to 100+ countries.
• Use the second number to send MMS
• Send SMS and view text message history.
• Select your second phone number from the list of available numbers.
• Access your contacts list and synchronize it with the app.
• International calling and messaging using 2nd line.
• Support for multiple phone numbers.
Note: Some features such as obtaining a second number, international calling, sending SMS/MMS, and multiple numbers require a paid subscription or in-app purchase.
With Second Phone Number's multiple number features, you can get an additional 2nd line for various situations:
A Dedicated Number for:
• Buying or selling on local e-commerce platforms. Use a second number for ads and calls.
• Dating. Give a second number to new acquaintances from dating apps.
• Signing up online. Keep your private number private with a second number.
Share your personal number only with trusted contacts. For everyone else, there's Second Phone Number!

- Purchase one phone number: Auto-renewal (Monthly $9.99 or Yearly $49.99) starts after a 3-day free trial. Additional numbers at $9.99 per month.
- Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account upon confirmation of purchase.
- Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage subscriptions in your iPhone settings.
- Unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited upon subscription purchase.

EULA: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00121549:ios.name: LayR-Multi Timbral Synthesizer
bluejetty:00121549:ios.summary:
LayR is a massively polyphonic, multi-timbral synthesizer for iOS devices, optimized for modern 64 bit CPUs and capable of delivering up to 256 voices of rich, multi-layered and textured sounds. 
LayR's primary sound components are called
bluejetty:00121549:ios.description:
LayR is a massively polyphonic, multi-timbral synthesizer for iOS devices, optimized for modern 64 bit CPUs and capable of delivering up to 256 voices of rich, multi-layered and textured sounds. 
LayR's primary sound components are called Performances where a Performance is a set of Instruments and each Instrument is a set of Layers and each Layer is a complete synthesizer. A performance can consist of any number of instruments each with its own MIDI channel and crossfading keyboard span. Each Instrument can consist of any number of Layers to a maximum of 128.
Each Layer has a dual oscillator that can morph with modulation between two shapes and phase states, two rich and warm state variable filters, a wave folder and a mixing section to blend oscillators and filters in any serial/parallel combination. 
For modulation (frequency, amplitude and phase) there are two Low Frequency Oscillators ranging from DC to audio frequency switchable to optionally follow keyboard pitch and restart phase when a note is started. Two loopable ADSR envelopes ranging from fractions of a second to over 100 seconds, an amplitude ADSR and a random number generator with a smoothing filter. With stereo delay, reverb and EQ on the output section LayR excels at not only emulating normal analog synth sounds but also at creating massive pads and huge spacy ambient textures with extremely long evolution cycles. 
Focused at keyboard players looking for a mobile synth that can be reliably used live on stage LayR is equally at home in the studio. An extensive selection of usable instrument and performance presets are included which can be loaded using MIDI bank select and program change messages in the same manner as hardware synths. 
LayR sports almost unparalled and extremely flexible MIDI control. Every parameter in the synth engine can be assigned to any MIDI Control Change number and parameters spread across multiple Layers can be grouped and controlled by a single MIDI cc with assignable range and direction.
There is also an 8 track, 16 step Arpeggio Sequencer which can be used to create all sorts of exciting polyrhythmic looped patterns or even ambient generative music. Each track can have it's own speed, playback mode and length. 
On top of all that LayR has a MIDI Controller Mixer that can be used during performance to control the synth engine in real time and can also transmit MIDI cc's from LayR's output port to other destinations.
Full IAA, Audiobus, Audio Unit and Link compatibility means LayR can be used with all hosts and other music apps on iOS and desktop DAWs.

bluejetty:00016130:ios.description:
Play as Molli Pop as you fend off hordes of adorable ghosts in a twisted mansion forever haunted by the Phantom King! Power-up Molli with new flashlights and abilities as you level up - and team up with ghostly pups and other spectral creatures as you work together to clear the mansion of its sugar-craved evil!
Features:
- Vaporize ghosts with a wide array of different, upgradeable flashlights; from cursed lanterns to magical beam swords, each flashlight provides a different way to play!
- Need an edge to help overcome a difficult stage? Players can equip Charms to their flashlights, enhancing Molli with a multitude of different abilities and power-ups! Some charms even provide Molli with companions to aid her on her ghost-stomping adventure!
 - Upon completing a stage, players can choose from a randomized set of candies and curses that will provide permanent power bonuses for the remainder of that run. Will you restore all of your hearts hoping to last longer before an untimely demise? Or will you sacrifice defense for ultimate power? The choice is yours!
- Visit 6 different regions of the Phantom King's mansion, each teeming with a variety of dangerous ghosts and ghouls. And be prepared to face-off against a mighty boss at the end of each stage!
- Participate in Daily Challenges that offer various rewards!
- Enjoy beautiful, hand-crafted pixel art with fluid animation that oozes ghostly charm
Controls: Control Molli by swiping the screen. Molli runs in one direction automatically, and swiping left or right makes her change direction. Swiping up or down will make her jump between floors. Certain flashlights you can use offer slightly different control schemes.
Twitter: @takoboystudios

- Need an edge to help overcome a difficult stage? Players can equip Charms to their flashlights, enhancing Molli with a multitude of different abilities and power-ups! Some charms even provide Molli with companions to aid her on her ghost-stomping adventure!

 - Upon completing a stage, players can choose from a randomized set of candies and curses that will provide permanent power bonuses for the remainder of that run. Will you restore all of your hearts hoping to last longer before an untimely demise? Or will you sacrifice defense for ultimate power? The choice is yours!

- Visit 6 different regions of the Phantom King's mansion, each teeming with a variety of dangerous ghosts and ghouls. And be prepared to face-off against a mighty boss at the end of each stage!

- Participate in Daily Challenges that offer various rewards!

- Enjoy beautiful, hand-crafted pixel art with fluid animation that oozes ghostly charm

Controls: Control Molli by swiping the screen. Molli runs in one direction automatically, and swiping left or right makes her change direction. Swiping up or down will make her jump between floors. Certain flashlights you can use offer slightly different control schemes.

Are you finding it difficult to connect with a sports partner, organize a game, or gather players for your team? ConnectPlayers is here to make your sports journey exciting! Whether you’re exploring a new sport, enhancing your fitness, or planning a family-friendly activity - we’ve got you covered.
·Can't find a badminton, Tennis or Pickleball buddy nearby?
·Tired of Hiking, Walking, Jogging or Running Alone?
·Want to try a new Sport?
·Want to create your own group and invite people to join?
·Share your pictures/videos and motivate others.
·Need more players for your sports group?
·Want to start a running club or find family-friendly events?
We Connect You to:
·Playmates and Groups
·Organisers and Events
Key Features:
Find Local Players
Find the perfect sports partner based on your favorite games and location. Whether you're a tennis enthusiast, a basketball player, or a weekend golfer, ConnectPlayers connects you with nearby athletes who share the same passion.
Real-Time Live Chat
Stay connected with your sports partners in real-time! Communicate instantly with potential opponents or teammates via direct live chat. You can discuss match details, strategies, and join local sports clubs securely.
Effortless Match Scheduling
Coordinating game times with friends or teammates can be a hassle, but ConnectPlayers makes it simple. Choose your preferred times, send invitations, and get reminders. The easy-to-use scheduling feature helps you organize games smoothly.
Personalized Reminders
Stay on top of your game with personalized match notifications. Whether you’re setting up a game or simply looking for an opponent, the app will send timely reminders to help you stay organized.
Celebrate Your Wins
Boost and celebrate your performance and see how you’re improving over time. ConnectPlayers helps your wins, losses, and overall match stats. With each game, you can evaluate your skills and keep pushing to become the best version of yourself.
Be a Part of Sports Clubs
ConnectPlayers isn’t just about playing sports – it’s about building a local sports club. You can meet new friends, join local sports leagues, or enjoy a friendly match and share your valuable feedback!
Different Sports, One App
Whether you're into team sports or solo activities, ConnectPlayers covers a wide range of sports to cater to every athlete. Discover games like golf, basketball, tennis, badminton, football, and more.
With ConnectPlayers, you'll easily find a sports partner nearby for any game, whether it's for fun or competitive play. Download the app now and connect with local sports enthusiasts today!
How Does it Work?
Search for Players
Browse through local players based on the sport you’re interested in. The app provides personalized recommendations for your location and preferences, making it easy to find the right people for your next match.
Connect & Chat
Once you’ve found someone, it’s time to connect! Start a live chat to discuss match details, arrange a time, and build your relationship beyond just a game. Whether you’re talking strategy or just sharing sports stories.
Schedule Matches
Once you've connected, scheduling your match is a breeze. Use the app to choose an ideal time, send invites, and make sure everyone is on the same page. It’s never been easier to get a group together for a friendly game!
Play & Boost Your Wins
Get out there and play! Whether you're improving your tennis serve or practising your basketball shots, ConnectPlayers boosts your victories in the game. Celebrate wins, and learn from losses.
Why Choose ConnectPlayers?
·Instant Connection: Find players quickly based on your sport and location.
·Live Chat: Communicate with ease in real-time.
·Scheduling Made Simple: Plan your games and stick to your schedule.
·Build Your Sports Club: Meet new friends and build lasting connections.
Start Your ConnectPlayers Journey Today!

Multiplayer online games. At PlayJoy you can make new friends, chat and enjoy the best online classic games. Ludo, Bingo, Dominoes and many more. 
BINGO
Do you like playing bingo? Enjoy the legendary multiplayer online bingo. Choose from different themed rooms and select the online bingo cards you want to play. Give bingo cards to your friends and win the jackpot of the best free bingo. Sign up for online bingo!

VIDEOSLOTS
You can play online slots with different themes, bonuses and incredible graphics. We release a new slot machines every few days. Play for fun and enjoy the excitement of slots.
Many more coming soon! Write to us to vote for your favorite games.

Turn everyday moments into beautiful sketches.
Give your photos a hand-drawn look with Pencil Sketch. Choose between Pen and Pencil styles, then adjust the intensity to create the look you love.

TRY IT FOR FREE
• Explore Pen and Pencil styles using the included demo image.
• Adjust the intensity—each style remembers its own setting.
• Save your edited demo image without a watermark.
CREATE MORE WITH PRO
• Edit your own photos (Pro Required)
Choose a picture from your photo library and turn it into a sketch.
• Preview sketches with the live camera (Pro Required)
See the effect as you frame your shot, switch between front and rear cameras, and capture the result.

• Save your creations (Pro Required)
Save watermark-free results to your photo library.
For best results, start with a clear, well-lit photo.
Download Pencil Sketch and discover your favorite look.

bluejetty:00135137:ios.description:
Esti is an app that makes creating beautiful, visually consistent content simple and efficient. It provides essential tools for creating appealing photos and videos with minimal effort.
If you want your social profiles or blog to have consistent and attractive visuals without spending a lot of time on editing, Esti offers practical tools designed to streamline the process and help you create refined content.
With features such as batch editing, preset creation, and a selection of filters and film effects, Esti supports efficient content creation with a focus on visual consistency.
FEATURES
► BATCH EDITING: Apply the same edits to multiple photos at once.
► FILTERS: Adjust colors easily with filters designed for different visual styles.
► FILM EFFECTS: Give photos extra character with effects inspired by Polaroid, VCR, Kodak, Super8, and Fuji.
► ADJUSTMENTS: Fine-tune light, color, and details using tools such as HSL, Grain, and Blur.
► TOUCH UPS: Make small appearance adjustments such as skin tone or hair volume.
► OVERLAYS: Add depth using manually designed textures like dust, paper, plastic, and light leaks.
► PRESETS: Save your preferred edits as presets for future use.
► VIDEOS: Apply filters, effects, and adjustments to videos as well.
Subscription
► Esti Pro may offer different subscription plans. Depending on the subscription plan chosen, subscriptions may be billed weekly, monthly or annually.
► Subscription for Esti Pro auto-renews at the cost of the chosen subscription plan unless cancelled 24 hours in advance prior to the end of the then-current subscription term. Unless you cancel the subscription before the billing date, you will be automatically charged the subscription fee for the next billing cycle in accordance with the conditions of the subscription plan chosen.
Subscription Policy - https://esti.app/subscription-policy
Privacy Policy - https://esti.app/privacy-policy
Terms of Use - https://esti.app/term-of-use
Help Center - https://estiapp.zendesk.com/hc/en-us

bluejetty:00154989:ios.description:
Westchester County Parks, it is our mission to create life-enriching experiences at safe, clean, affordable parks and preserve our natural resources through responsible leadership.
Throughout the year, we host hundreds of sports, entertainment, educational and community events on our more than 18,000 acres of parkland, which include more than 50 great facilities ranging from golf courses, pools and beaches, parks, to trail ways and nature centers. We even have an amusement park, a working farm, historic sites, an arboretum complete with a conservatory, and the Westchester County Center, the county’s best known and largest event and entertainment space.
We think our parks system is one of the best in the country, and so does the prestigious National Recreation and Parks Association, which has awarded us with national accreditation five times. In fact, we are the only accredited park system in New York State. Don’t forget many of our parks are open from dawn to dusk 365 days a year.
APPLE HEALTHKIT
We also use HealthKit to allow users to share their activity and workout data with the app. This data is used to incentivise users to stay active.

bluejetty:00096260:ios.summary:
■ A War Between Order and Instinct
Discover the continent of Ardeal, a land of beasts. Here, disciples dedicated to the goddess of light defend order, while those sworn to the goddess of shadows prize instinct. Safety for those caught their
bluejetty:00096260:ios.description:
■ A War Between Order and Instinct
Discover the continent of Ardeal, a land of beasts. Here, disciples dedicated to the goddess of light defend order, while those sworn to the goddess of shadows prize instinct. Safety for those caught their struggle is fleeting, and open war is ever on the horizon.
"What is your wish?"
The goddess of shadows can grant any wish, but her price is servitude. To become her disciple is to become a monstrous beast, bound to obey her every command.
■ Light and Shadow
Each character has two forms. Often, they appear as human. But when they submit to the shadow, the power of their bestial self comes forth.
"Which will you choose, the light or the shadow?"
■ Deduction and Intrigue
A traitorous shadow has infiltrated the ranks. Now, no one can be trusted and everyone is a suspect.
Experience two sides to each story: see through the eyes of those serving the light, and venture with those sworn to the shadow. Only together can the full story be told.
■ Rich Support Conversations
Unlock support conversations—personal moments between characters who appear in the story—providing a glimpse into their lives.
■ Intuitive Battle System
During battle, characters move on their own. Simply drag and drop to target and use your many skills.
Wield an arsenal of skills including attacks, recovery spells, buffs, debuffs, and movement abilities. Keep a sharp eye on the battle and cast wisely!
■ Observe and Discover
Each battle has two phases: the Sun Room and the Moon Room.
In the Sun Room, three players work together to drive back the monsters. But beware! One of you is secretly a traitor.
Did an ally act strangely? Whose spells hindered more than helped? Watch closely to spot the traitor.
■ A Climactic Head-to-Head Battle
In the Moon Room, the traitor takes on their beast form for a final head-to-head battle against their former allies.
Identifying the traitor beforehand grants added strength. But the disciple of shadow is very powerful, and if they win, their victory will be final. Successful deduction or deception swings the tide of battle!
■ Test Your Mettle
Take on a unique battle system! Enjoy introductory battles against computer-controlled foes, easing you into the game and its mechanics.
■ Characters from Across Fire Emblem's History
Characters from other Fire Emblem titles, such as the heads of house from Fire Emblem: Three Houses, are added monthly.
* Free to start; optional in-game purchases available. Persistent internet and compatible smart device required. Data charges may apply.
* You must be at least 13+ to use this game with a Nintendo Account.
* We permit our third-party partners to collect data from this app for analytical and marketing purposes. For more information about our ads, please see the "How we use your information" section of the Nintendo Privacy Policy.
* Variations in individual device specifications and other applications being run on a device may affect normal operation of this application.
* May include advertising.

bluejetty:00160551:ios.description:
Introducing AI Identify Anything - the ultimate app for identifying and learning about various objects, from plants, insects, and rocks to birds, coins, and even food ingredients. With cutting-edge image recognition technology, this mobile scanner swiftly analyzes photos to provide detailed information about the object's characteristics and properties.
Easy to use, just point your camera at the object you want to identify or measure, and our AI technology will do the rest, delivering accurate and reliable results every time. Whether you encounter unfamiliar items while shopping or curious creatures while traveling, AI Identify Anything will be your trusty companion.
Best For Identifying Everything:
Food:
- Uncover the secrets of your meals by scanning for ingredients and nutrition value. Use the app in cafes and restaurants to recognize dishes from the menu effortlessly.
Plants:
- Embark on a journey to explore the wonders of nature. Upload a picture or use the real-time camera to get in-depth information about a vast array of plants, flowers, and herbs.
Insects:
- Delve into the fascinating world of insects. Capture a picture of the insect that piques your interest, and the app will identify it while providing intriguing facts. Become an instant insect expert!
Goods:
- Identify objects on the go. Encountered something interesting at the shop? Snap a picture and get a comprehensive description right on your phone, saving time and effort.
AI Search:
- Enjoy the convenience of an all-in-one solution with the latest AI technology. Scan and recognize objects like plants, insects, fish, birds, rocks, coins, and food ingredients, all with lightning-fast accuracy.
AI Features:
- Accurate image recognition: Trust in precise and reliable object identification.
- Instant object detection: Receive results in no time.
- Real-time searching: Get immediate information while using the camera.
- Up-to-date information: Stay informed with the latest data.
- Search by taking or uploading a photo: Flexibility in capturing objects.
- Ask AI for more information and interesting facts: Enhance your knowledge with extra details.
- Save your results: Keep a record of your findings for future reference.
- Mark favorites: Easily access and revisit your most important identifications.
- AI Object Identifier is your go-to app for gaining insights into the world around you. Whether you're a nature enthusiast, a curious traveler, or just someone who loves to learn, this app will enrich your experiences and make you an expert at identifying everything in your path. Download now and unlock the wonders that await!
What is this? Identify Anything has the answer! No need to search the internet, just point your phone camera at the object you want to identify and get an accurate result in seconds!

bluejetty:00086867:ios.summary: In this game, you will run a super large shopping mall, with more than 32 stores waiting for you to manage, recruit store managers, train shopping guides,Start from scratch and build a fashion-filled commercial street in the prime location
bluejetty:00086867:ios.description:
In this game, you will run a super large shopping mall, with more than 32 stores waiting for you to manage, recruit store managers, train shopping guides,Start from scratch and build a fashion-filled commercial street in the prime location of the city, managing a variety of high-end fashion stores, designing unique shopping experiences, and attracting countless fashion enthusiasts!
Upgrade your stores and unlock different commercial facilities, from luxury brand flagship stores to trendy cafes—everything is under your control.
The gameplay is diverse and full of challenges. Not only do you need to plan the commercial layout, but you must also adjust operational strategies based on customer needs, host fashion shows, and launch promotional events to boost mall popularity.
In fierce business competition, cleverly manage your resources, expand your store sizes, and build your own fashion empire.
Features:
· Stunning 3D graphics that realistically capture the bustling scenes of a fashionable street district.
· Instant revenue generation, even when you’re offline, as your stores continue to operate and help you profit effortlessly.
· Multiple business strategies, with a variety of store types and fashion elements waiting for you to unlock.
· Customizable store layouts, allowing you to create your own trendy hotspot.
· Challenge tasks and achievement systems that help you quickly raise your street's global reputation.
Become the top fashion mall operator, lead global fashion trends, and showcase your business talents!

bluejetty:00171064:ios.description: MyCHOP is the online patient health portal for patients and families of Children's Hospital of Philadelphia (CHOP). Schedule appointments with your child’s pediatrician, or schedule in-person or video visits with a growing list of pediatric specialists. Use your phone’s camera to attend video visits with your child’s provider. Send messages to your child’s provider and request prescription refills and referrals. You can also access a current list of your child’s medications, immunizations, allergies, physician-released test results, growth charts, as well as a health summary and your account billing summary. Complete history Questionnaires. Track My Health features allow patients enter data manually onto the MyCHOP app through Apple HealthKit. Data is not received through Apple Health and wearable devices.

bluejetty:00160642:ios.description:
KDE Connect provides a set of features to integrate your workflow across devices:
- Shared clipboard: copy and paste between your devices.
- Share files and URLs to your computer from any app.
- Virtual touchpad and keyboard: Use your phone screen as your computer's touchpad or keyboard
- Remote presentation remote: control a laser pointer on the screen of your computer by moving your phone around.
- Remote commands: run commands on your computer from your phone.
- End-to-end TLS encryption: your information is safe.
Please note you will need to install KDE Connect on your other computers/phones/tablets and keep the version up-to-date for the latest features to work.
This app is part of an open source project and it exists thanks to all the people who contributed to it. Please visit the KDE Connect website to grab the source code.

Updated annually, this comprehensive resource contains detailed monographs that include dosage, administration, contraindications, precautions, interactions, antidotes, and more. This app helps nurses, nursing students, and health professionals avoid errors by using the built-in calculator to determine precise dilution and rate of administration. Download this app to see how it will build confidence and help you provide better patient care with its intuitive, quick-access format. 
Features of Intravenous Medications include:
• 400+ detailed generic and trade name IV drug monographs
• Annual updates
• New monographs featuring recently FDA approved drugs
• Helpful calculator and charts for dilution and rate of administration
• Black Box Warnings highlighting critical information
• Blue-screened text call attention to important circumstances that may not warrant Black Box Warnings.
• Life-stage dosage variances for geriatric, pediatric, infant, and neonatal patients
• Updated drug interactions, precautions, alerts, and patient teaching instructions for all IV drugs
• Dilution and dosage charts within monographs provide quick access to essential clinical information
• Advanced Search help you find terms fast
• “Favorites” for bookmarking important entries
• Personalize your app with notes and highlights
FREE 14-DAY TRIAL: WHAT TO EXPECT
• First-time users can access Unbound's complete IV Medications mobile app free for 14 days
• After 14 days, your iTunes account will be charged $49.99 for a one-year subscription unless you have turned off auto-renew at least 24 hours before the free trial ends.
• To manage your subscriptions, open Apple's “Settings” app and tap on the “iTunes & App Store" entry. Tap your Apple ID at the top of the screen and login. Tap subscriptions, then tap the subscription you wish to manage. 
• NOTE: If you choose not to purchase a subscription, content will no longer be viewable after the free trial period. 
iTunes automatic renewal feature: Your subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off 24 hours prior to the conclusion of your current 12 month period. Your iTunes account will automatically be charged the current renewal rate ($49.99) within 24 hours prior to the end of the subscription period. This will ensure you receive all updates and continued web access for the following year. If you choose not to renew, you will be able to use the app, however will not receive updates.

Publisher: Elsevier
Powered by: Unbound Medicine

bluejetty:00100085:ios.description:
Solitaire Word Quest offers a refreshing twist on both card and word puzzle games. It’s not just about matching or guessing words – it’s about exploring how words connect through meaning, logic, and intuition. Every move you make blends the strategy of solitaire with the creativity of language puzzles, creating a truly one-of-a-kind experience.
In this game, traditional playing cards are replaced by word and category cards. Your task is to analyze the board, draw cards from the deck, and decide where each one belongs. To complete a set, you’ll first place a category card, then discover all the word cards that belong to it. The more accurately you sort the words, the closer you are to clearing the level. But think carefully — every decision counts, and running out of moves means starting over.
Each level in Solitaire Word Quest is a small logic challenge that tests both your vocabulary and strategic thinking. Some associations are straightforward, while others are hidden and unexpected. As you advance, you’ll begin to notice patterns and connections that make you think differently about the language itself.
What makes this game truly stand out is its calm and thoughtful pace. There’s no timer or pressure to rush — only you, your cards, and the quiet satisfaction of figuring things out one step at a time. Whether you’re playing during a short break or winding down at night, it’s the perfect way to relax while keeping your brain active.
Game Features:
A fresh and original blend of solitaire mechanics and word puzzles.
Hundreds of handcrafted levels with increasing complexity.
No time limits — play at your own rhythm, without stress.
Simple to learn but deeply rewarding to master.
A perfect balance between challenge and relaxation.
Expands your vocabulary and strengthens logical thinking.
Solitaire Word Quest is designed for anyone who loves clever, meaningful puzzles. Whether you’re a fan of classic solitaire, word associations, or brain teasers, this game will surprise you with its creativity and depth.
Dive into the world of words, connections, and strategy — where every card tells a story, and every match brings you closer to mastering the art of association.
Solitaire Word Quest — relax your mind, train your brain, and rediscover the joy of language.

bluejetty:00179410:ios.description:
纯单机策略游戏，免费玩，支持自建武将、DIY剧本！
操作界面专为iPhone、iPad量身定制，支持双人模式，指点江山，尽在掌中！
《霸王卧龙传》是一款单机深度策略游戏，决策纵深达四个层面：
一、战略，俯瞰大陆，发展民生、招揽英杰、强军备战、合纵连横、攻城略地⋯⋯
二、战场，平原、林地、山岳、水域、沙漠等地形中，行军用计，出奇制胜⋯⋯
三、战斗，排兵布阵、白刃相接，猛将冲锋陷阵、一骑当千⋯⋯
四、单挑，狭路相逢，纵马对决，温酒斩华雄、斩颜良、诛文丑，酣畅淋漓⋯⋯
游戏版图：
根据东汉十三州，东起辽东、西止永昌、北抵五原、南达交州
东都洛阳、西京长安
青、冀、幽、并
衮、徐、豫、扬
荆、交、益、凉
共计三十一座城池
游戏剧本：
189年 董卓废帝
208年 赤壁之战
220年 三足鼎立
251年 英雄集结（幻想大乱斗）
可选势力：
1、董卓
2、袁绍
3、曹操
4、孙坚
5、刘备
6、刘焉
7、马腾
8、刘表
9、袁术
10、陶谦
11、张鲁
12、公孙瓒
13、严白虎
14、孟获
15、公孙康
16、韩玄
17、刘度
18、士燮
19、彻里吉
20、轲比能
21、司马懿
22、吕布
23、张济
24、韩遂
25、张角
26、刘繇
27、王朗
《霸王卧龙传》不以简单的兵力多寡定胜负，突出体现武将能力对战局的影响：
诸葛亮、周瑜、司马懿等略施妙计，谈笑间敌军灰飞烟灭⋯⋯
吕布、张飞、马超等勇冠三军，百万军中取上将首级，如探囊取物⋯⋯
赵云、关羽、张辽等智勇双全、攻守兼备，堪当重任⋯⋯
限量神器：
青龙偃月刀 关羽建业可购
丈八蛇矛 张飞涪陵可购
狼牙枪 猛将凉州战场可购
圣者之衣 德高者永昌战场可购
青釭剑 单挑马腾必得
倚天剑 单挑曹操几率可得
七星宝剑 一、二级武将单挑董卓必得
龙鳞铠 单挑刘备必得
龙牙刀 单挑其他君主几率可得
战场计策：
火计
陷阱
虚兵
要击
乱水
火箭
伪击转杀
共杀
笼络
落石
十面埋伏
连环
连弩
水攻
劫火
奇门遁甲
战斗阵型：
长蛇阵 (一字排开，看似无奇，偶有妙用)
鹤翼阵 (适合骑兵侧翼包抄)
锥形阵 (适合全军中路突击)
鱼鳞阵 (适合保护主将)
阵而后战，兵法之常，运用之妙，存乎一心。
战斗指挥：
前进 (骑兵面对弓兵，进攻就是最好的防守)
包围 (可抓捕敌将，配合束缚更佳)
待机 (徐如林，守城必备)
后退 (逃离战场，可能遭到追击伤害)
战斗战术：
束缚 (禁止敌将移动，抓捕必备，可能失败)
单挑 (挑衅敌将独斗，可能失败)
强弩 (弓兵射程数回合提高)
士气向上(全军攻击力数回合提升)
火矢 (弓兵攻击力数回合大幅提升)
爆炎 (智将投掷爆弹，终极大杀器)
单挑动作：
轻击 (精准命中，伤害低)
重击 (伤害较高，可能失手)
舍命一击 (极高伤害，命中低，失手反受其害)
说服 (晓之以理，劝降劝退)
退却 (好汉不吃眼前亏，走为上计)
投降 (留得青山在，不怕没柴烧)
游戏目标：选贤任能、结束战乱、统一中原！
游戏结局：武将、城池的属性将决定最终统一度。
游戏上架只是起点，我们致力于持续完善发展！
请留下您的肺腑之言，鞭策我们奋进！
欢迎交流：
百度贴吧 霸王卧龙传

Welcome to Conveyor Rush: Idle Food Games!
Step into the bustling world of working games and culinary delights with Conveyor Rush! In this thrilling hypercasual idle game, you'll embark on a culinary adventure like no other as you manage your very own kitchen empire! Run your snack bar with the upmost efficiency and make sure all customers are satisfied in this restaurant game!
Set in a bustling kitchen environment, Conveyor Rush: Idle Food Games combines the thrill of working games, delivery games, and restaurant management games into one addictive package. Your mission? To get your pizza ready, burgers delivered and satisfy the hunger pangs of hungry customers!
In Conveyor Rush: Idle Food Games the kitchen never sleeps, and neither do you! Keep those conveyor belts moving and those orders flowing to keep your customers happy and your profits soaring.
-Rush against the clock: Feel the adrenaline of restaurant games as you keep pace with the fast-paced conveyors, each specializing in crafting a variety of mouthwatering treats! From fluffy donuts to cheesy good pizza, savory burritos, and juicy burgers, there's something to satisfy every craving!
-Satisfy hungry customers: Serve up your freshly prepared culinary creations to a diverse array of customers, each with their own unique tastes and preferences. Keep them happy and coming back to your snack bar for more to earn lucrative rewards!
-Expand your kitchen empire: Start small and work your way up as you strategically invest in new conveyors, one by one. Upgrade your equipment, unlock exciting ingredients, and customize your snack bar to optimize production and maximize profits in working games!
-Idle gameplay: Even when you're not actively playing, your kitchen continues to churn out delectable treats! Return to collect your earnings, manage your restaurant games empire, and watch as your culinary empire flourishes!
So what are you waiting for? Join Conveyor Rush: Idle Food Games and see if you have what it takes to become the ultimate food tycoon. Order please, get the pizza ready, and the snack bar is open for business!

bluejetty:00160173:ios.description:
How long have you been telling yourself you'll learn English? Spanish? French?
Let's make this the year it actually happens. Not from 400 owl reminders. Not from tapping pictures of fruits and animals. From real conversations — from your very first day.
You'll be speaking with confidence in weeks, not years. Just 10 minutes a day with me.
You speak or type. I match your level in real time. Use your target language, your native language, or a mix of both as you get more comfortable.
MISTAKES ARE WELCOME
It's actually how we learn.
Make all your mistakes with me first. Then you won't have to make them with real people.
When you slip up, I don't shame you. No red Xs. No buzzers. I give you real-time feedback on grammar, pronunciation, and word choice.
I use a three-step method I call the Lily Method: I nudge, then I hint, and only then do I give you the answer.
Learners fix their own mistakes 46% of the time with this method (Lyster & Ranta research). Other apps just feed you the correct answer — so you learn nothing. With me, you learn it because YOU found the answer.
The biggest mistake you can make is being afraid to make one. Duolingo punishes you for mistakes — I reward you for making them.
LET'S TALK ABOUT WHAT YOU LIKE
Whatever you want to talk about — I'm like a friend who happens to speak 50+ languages.
The movie you watched last weekend. Your day at work. The trip you're planning. Your favorite K-drama. The book you can't put down. The song stuck in your head.
Personal conversations stick. Generic lessons don't.
Pack me for the trip. I'll be your travel buddy who already speaks the language.
Want to practice a specific moment — ordering at a Parisian café, checking into a Tokyo hotel, meeting your partner's parents? Just ask me to roleplay it.
I REMEMBER YOU
Other apps forget you the moment you close them. I don't.
I remember the word you stumbled on last Tuesday. I remember your sister's wedding next month. I remember you work in marketing and your dog's name is Bean. Session 100 with me is smarter than session 1 — because I've been paying attention.
You told me in onboarding you have a trip to Italy? Today let's talk about what you're packing. You mentioned you're nervous about a presentation? Walk me through it — I'll help you fix the rough spots.
EARN STREAKS FOR REAL PRACTICE
Streaks earned by real messages, not by tapping a button to keep a number alive. All the motivation. None of the guilt trips. No hearts. No leaderboards. No "you broke your streak!" notifications.
50+ LANGUAGES, NATIVE ACCENTS
English, Spanish, French, German, Japanese, Korean, Chinese, Italian, Portuguese, Arabic, Russian, Hindi, Turkish, Dutch, Swedish, Polish, Thai, Vietnamese, Indonesian, Greek — and 40+ more.
Each with native accent variants (British or American English, Latin American or European Spanish, etc.) — so you sound like you actually live there, not like a textbook.
STOP STUDYING. START SPEAKING.
Babbel scripts you. ChatGPT forgets you. A human tutor costs $30-60 an hour and needs scheduling.
I'm available 24/7. I'm 50× cheaper than a private tutor. I remember every word you've ever said to me. And I'll never make you feel stupid for not knowing something — that's the whole reason you're here.
Five minutes on your coffee break. Thirty on the train home. I fit your day, not the other way around.
Open the app. Say hi. I'll take it from there.
— Lily

bluejetty:00029927:ios.summary:
All basic features are available for free!
The ideal app for team managers and anyone who needs to measure several times at once!
With support for iPad multitasking and built-in timers, you can use it for training, studying, cooking, and m
bluejetty:00029927:ios.description:
All basic features are available for free!
The ideal app for team managers and anyone who needs to measure several times at once!
With support for iPad multitasking and built-in timers, you can use it for training, studying, cooking, and many other everyday tasks!
The photo finish feature is recommended when you need accurate timing and cannot afford mistakes!
As a runner myself, I often wished for an app like this. It is built from the perspective of runners and team managers.
■ Used across many fields
Multi-Timer is used to time athletics, swimming, keirin, car and motorboat races, games, and multiple workplace tasks. It is also widely deployed on organization-managed devices (MDM).
■ Multiple stopwatches and saved results
• Run 20+ stopwatches at once, depending on your device.
• A lap is the time for one segment; a split is the total time from the start.
• Change each stopwatch's name and color, and choose how many appear on screen.
• Rearrange stopwatches manually or sort them automatically by rank.
• Group stopwatches to start, stop, or record laps together.
• Save results and revisit them in the calendar.
• Edit times, share CSV files or images, and copy results for use in Excel or Google Sheets.
• Enable volume button controls to start or stop stopwatches in sequence with the volume down button.
■ Online Timer: synchronized timing across devices
Share a room ID to link stopwatches on different devices. Useful when the start and finish are far apart or several people help with timing. A stable internet connection is required.
■ NoLook Timer: record laps without watching the screen
Tap as athletes pass, then assign recorded marks to athletes or adjust their times afterward. Lap times are calculated automatically, helping you record several athletes passing in quick succession.
Use the volume down button to start timing or record a lap.
■ Photo finish: timing linked to video
Synchronize the stopwatch with video playback. Use slow motion, fast-forward, and pause to inspect finishes or swimming touches. Pause the video to manually record times for multiple athletes.
■ Timer For Daily Use: separate countdowns for everyday tasks
Manage cooking, study, or other tasks with multiple countdowns. Set each timer's name, color, sound, and repeat option.
On iOS 26 or later, allow alarms to hear the timer end while the app is in the background or the screen is locked, including in Silent mode or Focus. When regular notifications are used, sound behavior depends on notification settings.
■ Timer For Training: repeat work and rest intervals
Add intervals, set each duration, and repeat the sequence up to 9,999 times. Useful for Tabata, HIIT, and circuit training. Save your settings to reuse them later.
Keep the app open to follow interval changes and hear alerts. Background sounds and notifications are not supported in this mode. Use the sound button to toggle audio; change vibration in Settings.
■ Recommended for
• Coaches and team managers timing multiple athletes
• Runners, swimmers, and cyclists recording training or races
• PE teachers and fitness trainers planning exercise and rest
• People recording laps in cycling or motorsport
• Students managing study sessions and cooks using several timers
• Anyone who wants to save, share, and review timing results
■ How to use
Swipe horizontally to switch modes. Control stopwatches with START, STOP, LAP, and RESET. Open DATA, choose the save action, and enter a title. Revisit saved results in the calendar.
■ Purchases and ads
Photo finish, Online Timer, and NoLook Timer are additional features, each available as a one-time in-app purchase. Temporary access by watching an ad may also be offered. Ad removal is a separate one-time purchase.
Sound effects: OtoLogic

bluejetty:00076668:ios.name: CoachCat
bluejetty:00076668:ios.summary:
Tell CoachCat what you want to get out of your riding and how many hours you have. Get a training plan built around both, starting today.
FasCat has coached endurance cyclists for 20+ years, from first-time gravel riders to national champi
bluejetty:00076668:ios.description:
Tell CoachCat what you want to get out of your riding and how many hours you have. Get a training plan built around both, starting today.
FasCat has coached endurance cyclists for 20+ years, from first-time gravel riders to national champions. We invented Sweet Spot training, the method that made structured base building work whether you have 6 hours a week or 16. CoachCat puts that coaching on your phone.
// WHAT COACHCAT DOES 
• Builds your plan around you• 
Training for a race, chasing a fitness number, or just want to get stronger on the bike. Tell CoachCat the goal and the hours you actually have, and it builds the plan. Not sure what your goal is? Answer a few questions and CoachCat will tell you what to work on. Road, gravel, mountain bike, cyclocross, multisport and more. Unlimited access to FasCat's 5-star plan library, with Sweet Spot base, intervals, strength training and everything in between.
• Adjusts the plan as your life changes• 
Miss a week. Travel. Get sick. Change your goal. CoachCat reworks the plan instead of leaving you to catch up on your own. This is where most training plans fall apart, and it is the reason people quit them.
• Tells you what to do today• 
Open the app and your workout is there, with the reason behind it. No deciding, no guessing, no building your own week. Just ride what it says.
• Coaches you after every ride• 
Upload a ride and ask anything. Why your power faded in hour 3. Whether that interval set did what it was supposed to. What to change on Saturday. You get a straight answer built on your data, not a generic article.
• Knows when to push and when to back off• 
CoachCat pulls sleep and HRV from your wearable and scores your recovery every morning. Green means go. Red means rest. Your plan responds to that instead of ignoring it.
• Handles the fueling• 
FuelTrix™ reads the duration and intensity of every workout on your calendar and gives you a carbohydrate target in grams per hour, then converts it to bottles and gels. Plus meal plans and recipes for the eating you do off the bike.
• Shows you whether it is working• 
Fitness, fatigue and form over time. Your FTP. Your consistency. The numbers that tell you the training is doing something.
// WHO IT IS FOR
Riders with a race on the calendar. Riders who just want to be faster, fitter and stronger on the bike. Riders who want real structure without a 1-on-1 coaching budget. Riders who would rather be told what to do than build their own training week. Riders who have started a plan before and quit because life happened and nothing adjusted.
// WORKS WITH YOUR GEAR
Apple Health, Garmin, Wahoo, Strava, Zwift, Hammerhead, Whoop, Oura, Rouvy, Fitbit and more.
// TRY IT FREE
First week free. No credit card required. After that, $34.99 per month, or $210 for the year, which works out to $17.50 per month.
// 6-WEEK IMPROVEMENT GUARANTEE
Train with CoachCat for 6 weeks and hit 80% green days. If you have not improved, we refund you in full and set you up with a complimentary consultation with a FasCat coach.
// SUBSCRIPTION
CoachCat is available as a monthly subscription at $34.99 or an annual subscription at $210.
Payment is charged to your Apple Account upon purchase co. Subscriptions renew automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the current period ends. Manage or turn off auto-renew in your Account settings at any time after purchase.
// APPLE HEALTH
CoachCat reads sleep, heart rate variability and workout data from Apple Health to score your daily recovery and adjust your training. Your health data is never sold or shared with advertisers.
Train smarter. Recover better. Ride faster.
Terms of Use: https://fascatcoaching.com/pages/terms-of-service
 Privacy Policy: https://fascatcoaching.com/pages/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00159900:ios.summary:
Ringwalks - Boxing’s Most Useful App
NEVER MISS A FIGHT AGAIN
Ringwalks is the ultimate companion for every boxing fan. Get notified when your selected fighters begin their ring walk so you never miss the action. Whether you are staying up
bluejetty:00159900:ios.description:
Ringwalks - Boxing’s Most Useful App
NEVER MISS A FIGHT AGAIN
Ringwalks is the ultimate companion for every boxing fan. Get notified when your selected fighters begin their ring walk so you never miss the action. Whether you are staying up late or waking up early for a fight, Ringwalks lets you tune in at exactly the right moment. No more waiting through undercards or guessing start times. Just add fights to your personal list and receive a notification when it is time.
DESIGNED FOR BOXING FANS
Ringwalks combines a clean and modern design with powerful features, all built with the boxing community in mind. The interface is intuitive and distraction-free. The app is free to use, with optional PRO features for users who want more control and insight.
MMA COVERAGE
In addition to boxing, Ringwalks now includes all major MMA events, so you can follow your favorite fighters across both sports with the same level of precision and convenience.
CREATE YOUR ACCOUNT
By creating a free account, you can personalize your experience. Choose your own avatar, keep track of your prediction history, and access exclusive features that help you engage more deeply with the sport.
COMPETE AND WIN REWARDS
With Ringwalks PRO, you receive unlimited fight notifications and can compete in the official leaderboard. Make predictions on upcoming fights and earn points based on accuracy. At the end of each leaderboard period, top performers receive real rewards. This is your chance to prove yourself as a true combat sports expert.
MULTIPLE LANGUAGES
Ringwalks supports multiple languages to make the app accessible to boxing and MMA fans around the world.
EASY TO USE
The app includes a step-by-step tutorial that shows you exactly how to use each feature. Whether you are a new user or a seasoned fan, Ringwalks is ready when you are.
BUILT BY FANS, FOR FANS
Ringwalks is developed and maintained by BLLN Sports Group LP, driven by a passion for combat sports and a commitment to delivering a reliable, user-friendly experience.
Subscription terms:
- The subscription auto-renews at the end of each term.
- Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
- The subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
- Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period.
- You may manage your subscription and turn off auto-renewal by going to your Account Settings after purchase.
Terms of Use: https://ringwalks.com/terms-of-use/
Privacy Policy: https://ringwalks.com/privacybeleid/

bluejetty:00039671:ios.description:
AfricaWeather smarter weather insights, built for Africa.
The all new AfricaWeather app gives you accurate, easy-to-read weather for your location and anywhere else you care about. Check the conditions before you head out, plan your week around the 10 day outlook, or dig into the hourly detail. No account, no subscription just download it and go.
KEY FEATURES
Current conditions with feels like temperature, daily high and low
10 day forecast with daily highs, lows and conditions at a glance
24 hour forecast with hourly temperature and chance of rain
Wind speed and direction on a live compass
Humidity and dew point
Visibility with hourly trends
Atmospheric pressure
Sunrise, sunset and total daylight hours
Moon phase, illumination, moonrise and moonset
Tap any metric for a full breakdown with hourly charts
Save multiple locations and switch between them instantly
DATA SOURCES
Data used within the AfricaWeather app comes from a range of sources, including observations from automated weather stations and airports, and forecasts generated by industry-leading ensembles that draw on all major global weather models to produce the most accurate forecast available.
ABOUT AFRICAWEATHER
AfricaWeather is Africa's leading commercial weather information provider, serving the agriculture, mining, construction, education and consumer markets. We serve over a million Africans through our website and mobile applications, interpreting weather information and making it relevant to your day.
Visit www.africaweather.com for more information.

bluejetty:00173111:ios.name: Idle Cutter: Wood Slice
bluejetty:00173111:ios.summary:
Welcome to Idle Cutter Island, the land of peace and joy! Slice and dice into paradise with one of the most satisfying games!
We’ve designed this new game for your satisfying experience, without any interruptions and long to-do lists. Just
bluejetty:00173111:ios.description:
Welcome to Idle Cutter Island, the land of peace and joy! Slice and dice into paradise with one of the most satisfying games!
We’ve designed this new game for your satisfying experience, without any interruptions and long to-do lists. Just focus on making perfect cuts to chop away the stress!
Our sim blends the intuitive mechanics of cutting games with the visual ASMR effects. Dive into this awesome mix to slice through the wood at your own tempo and build the great lumber empire without haste!
Slice It All 
Cut the logs to progress in one of the most engrossing and satisfying games. Combine the lumber to create a unique wood species and earn more with every slice. Match up as much wood as possible to get more cash and unusual logs!
Upgrade For Perfect Cuts
With the money you earn from slicing, sharpen your saw knife to slice faster than ever before. Upgrades will keep your saw running smoothly and increase its speed. Maximize the cut power to progress efficiently even when you're not playing.
Unlock Bonus Levels
In addition to regular logs, sometimes you'll get watermelon or avocado-like wood carving, or even soap cutting! Slice and dice each unique log and find out—will it crush easily or you’ll have to show your slicing skills to cut it?
Build Your Lumber Town
In our wood-mowing game, you can chop to set up your city! Crush logs and harvest timber to build a house or a bank. Activate the flying cut mode on your knife-machine to slice through logs faster and collect enough materials! 
Cut All Stress Away
Our simulator stands out from other satisfying games as it helps you unwind with its visual ASMR and haptic feedback with every cut. Explore soap cutting and wood carving while you're on the go, waiting for an order, or simply looking for a way to pass the time! These engaging cutting games are sure to keep you hooked for hours!
All the ingredients of an awesome free new game for your phone are here:
Simple one-finger mechanics: tap to slice, hold to build, and cut to unwind.
Satisfying gameplay: crush the logs and harvest timber to enjoy yourself.
Soothing experience: build your lumber empire without any rush in this knife game.
Colorful visuals: enjoy a cartoonish world and cool logs, such as melon or watermelon.
Easy goals: play our log-mowing game to build the great lumber empire.
Out of all the satisfying games you’ve ever played, this one will be your fav! Download Idle Cutter now to chop up some wood and unwind! Switch your saw to flying cut mode and slice it all in our free knife game!

bluejetty:00135649:ios.description:
"Scanner App makes my operations with documents much faster and easier."
— Feedback from one of our first users.
Turn your iPhone into a powerful portable scanner with Scanner App: Documents to PDF!
Scanner App is a versatile scanner app for documents and images that instantly converts paper documents into high-quality digital files. Whether you're scanning personal notes, business papers, or photos, you can do it quickly and effortlessly.
Need to scan a QR code or barcode? Just point your iPhone’s camera at the code and let the app do the rest — what happens next depends on what’s inside. Open a link, view the text, or pull up the details behind the code, all in a couple of taps.
Scan QR codes and barcodes on:
• Posters and flyers
• Product packaging and labels
• Business cards
• Tickets and receipts and much more!
Perfect for scanning:
• Paper notes and sketches
• IDs and passports
• Agreements and contracts
• Book pages
• Business cards
• Receipts and much more!
If you're running a business or simply want to stay organized, this PDF scanner app is a must-have on your smartphone.
Our application includes free features and features available for users with the subscription.
Enjoy the following free features:
• Scan Everything: Digitize documents, IDs, and passports in seconds.
• Import & Organize: Easily import documents and images from your gallery, rename files, and search by document name.
• Professional Editing: Filter, rotate, straighten, and crop your scans for the perfect look.
• Tools: Highlight key details, erase imperfections, and lock confidential documents.
Unlock the following features with the subscription:
• Text Recognition (OCR): Recognize text from documents to copy and edit.
• E-Signature: Sign documents directly on your device.
• Advanced Export: Share your scans, print documents, or convert them to Word.
• Document Editing: Add pages, insert text or images, and apply custom watermarks.
Why choose Scanner App?
Because it's one of the most useful tools you can have on your phone, helping you manage documents quickly, efficiently, and anywhere you need.
Don't wait — download Scanner App now and make scanning and managing documents easier than ever!
Privacy Policy: https://pp.scannerapp.online/
Terms of Use: https://tou.scannerapp.online/

bluejetty:00178398:ios.description:
*** Featured on TV & loved by millions around the world! ***
Explore the fun with Dog Whistler! It's not just for training your dog anymore. It’s the perfect playful companion for kids and fun lovers, letting you pull pranks and create high-pitched sounds for all kinds of amusing reactions!
**Key Features**
**Whistle Slider & Frequency Input**
Easily choose the desired frequency using the built-in slider or by manually inputting the frequency.
**Diverse Sound Patterns**
Choose from multiple amusing sound patterns:
- Tone
- Short/Long Beeps
- Variety of Oscillations
- Static
** Dog Clicker **
For those animals that don't respond to whistles, give the clicker a try! Just tap on the dog icon to get a clicker sound that will surely get his attention.
**Create Your Ringtones**
Transform any frequency into a ringtone and share your creations!
**Share the Fun**
Share your favorite frequencies and pranks via Facebook, Twitter, or Email and find out what worked best for fun dog training or testing your friends’ hearing!
**Advanced Alarm Features**
Use the innovative alarm for your pets’ training or to prank your friends with its repeat mode and motion detection.
 **Versatile Uses**
- Dog training companion
- Simple hearing test
- A tool to amuse and annoy!
 **Interactive Fun for Kids**
It’s not just a dog whistle. It’s a gateway to fun-filled moments, pulling pranks, and sharing laughter! Perfect for kids and those young at heart!
**Learn More**
For more about dog whistles, visit [Wikipedia](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dog_whistle).
**Note:** Please use the app responsibly and ensure its content is appropriate for the target audience, especially kids.

bluejetty:00160894:ios.description:
**Buy, sell and bid on classic cars, used cars and modern classics; all in one place.**
Car & Classic is Europe's largest marketplace for car enthusiasts, offering thousands of cars for sale, daily car auctions, and a trusted platform to buy cars, sell cars, and discover rare vehicles; from Aston Martin icons to modern performance cars. Trusted by enthusiasts worldwide.
**LIVE CAR AUCTIONS - BIDDING FROM ANYWHERE**
Join live car auctions every single day, so there's always something worth bidding on. Chase a Porsche 911, an Aston Martin DB5 or a barn find Jaguar E-Type. Get outbid alerts in real time and bid from wherever you are.
Fully integrated escrow on every auction, your money is protected until the car is in your hands.
**40,000+ CLASSIC CARS, USED CARS & MODERN CLASSICS**
From pre-war veterans to 1980s icons, and from Bentley grand tourers to modern performance cars, Car & Classic carries the full spectrum.
Classic cars. Used cars. Modern classics and youngtimers. Western and European cars, American muscle, European icons and rare barn finds from around the world.
Browse listings from private sellers, trusted dealers and verified sources, filter by make, model, era or condition.
**MAKE AN OFFER**
Not every car goes to auction. Browse thousands of classic cars and used cars for sale and make an offer directly to the seller, your chance to secure the car you want, on your terms.
**FULL CAR DETAILS - EVERYTHING YOU NEED TO BUY WITH CONFIDENCE**
Before you bid or buy, you'll know exactly what you're getting. Every listing includes high-quality images, videos, full technical specifications and history papers where available; so you can make the right call with total confidence.
**NEVER MISS THE ONE**
Save your searches. Build your dream garage. The moment a matching car is listed — whether it's a barn find Triumph, a classic Jaguar or a rare muscle car — you'll know first.
Instant notifications. Real-time alerts. Your hunt, automated.
**SELL CARS TO EUROPE'S BIGGEST AUDIENCE**
Reach the largest community of classic car buyers in Europe. List your classic car, used car or modern collectible and connect with enthusiasts who know exactly what it's worth, and are ready to buy.
**CLASSIC CAR INSURANCE**
Protect your pride and joy. Car & Classic offers classic car insurance tailored for enthusiasts covering everything from weekend classics to show-condition collector cars.
**BUILT ON TRUST**
Our secure payment platform and escrow service protect every transaction — for buyers and sellers alike. Buy with confidence. Sell without worry.
Join millions of enthusiasts. Free to download.

bluejetty:00021486:ios.description:
PRETTY MUSCLES — Workout & Meal Plan App
Erin Oprea is a former U.S. Marine and one of fitness's most trusted coaches — having trained everyday women, some of country music's most recognizable names, and herself for over two decades. She knows firsthand what works at 25, 35, 45, and beyond — and she's built PRETTY MUSCLES around that reality.
This isn't a one-size-fits-all app. It's a smarter way to train — built for real life, real bodies, and every stage of womanhood.
BUILD STRENGTH & DEFINITION, ANYWHERE
- Workouts you can do at home or the gym with minimal equipment
- Programs for every fitness level — beginner to advanced
- Exercise videos with guided voiceovers so you always know what you're doing
- Fun formats including Erin's favorite card game and Tabata-style training
- Built-in Tabata timer, right in the app
EAT CLEAN WITHOUT THE CONFUSION
- Hundreds of energizing, hormone-friendly recipes
- Curated weekly meal plans that take the thinking out of it
- Personal macro calculator built for your goals
- Grocery list generator and meal delivery integration
TRAINING BUILT FOR THE LONG GAME
Balance. Sustainability. Lasting habits. Erin's approach has always been about strengthening your body so you feel great in it — especially as life changes. No crash diets. No burnout. Just a way of training that keeps working for you, wherever you are right now.
The best thing you can wear is your confidence. Try PRETTY MUSCLES free for 14 days and let's build it together.
SUBSCRIPTION INFO
Your first 14 days are free. After your trial, subscriptions are billed through your Apple ID. Your subscription automatically renews unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in your Apple ID Account Settings. Refunds are not provided for unused portions of an active term.
Privacy Policy: https://prettymuscles.plankk.com/privacy
Terms of Use: https://prettymuscles.plankk.com/tos

bluejetty:00092003:ios.description:
Smarter lighting, right at your fingertips. The Deako App makes smart lighting simple. Whether you’re setting the mood for movie night, waking up gently to a scheduled sunrise, or ensuring your home looks lived-in while you’re away, Deako adapts to the way you live.
With the Deako App, you can:
- CONTROL FROM ANYWHERE: Forgot to turn the lights off? No problem. The Deako App lets you control your lights from anywhere in the world using your smartphone. Whether you're upstairs or out of town, your lighting is always in your hands.
- SET SCHEDULES & TIMERS: Create recurring schedules to automatically turn lights on or off at specific times. Wake up to a well-lit kitchen, or ensure the porch light is always on after sunset. 
- CREATE CUSTOM SCENES: Set the mood in seconds. With scenes, you can control multiple lights at once to match any activity or time of day — movie night, dinner, bedtime, and more. 
- MANAGE WHOLE-HOME LIGHTING: Organize your switches by room or zone for easier access. Turn off the whole house with a single tap or manage just the lights in one room or floor.
- BREEZE THROUGH SETUP: Configure your Deako smart devices with just a few taps. The app walks you through every step, making installation fast and frustration-free — no hubs, no headaches.
- INTEGRATE SEAMLESSLY: Connect to your preferred smart home platform for voice and home automation control.
To learn more, visit deako.com.

In Tile Mansion, join our lovable main character Anna who's sprucing up an old mansion she inherited from her uncle. But that’s not all! Along the way, Anna makes new friends (and maybe some enemies) as she builds a new life and uncovers the mansion's secrets. How do you play?
- Tapping tiles adds them to your stack
- Find three matching tiles to clear them from the stack
- Keep matching tiles until the entire board is cleared
- Be warned: Your stack only holds 7 tiles. Exceed the limit and fail!

- Intriguing stories and characters

- Get involved in the narrative
- Show off your creativity
- Earn powerful bonuses

bluejetty:00031108:ios.description:
Cross-platform player for VOD sources.
# Show and Episodes
- Seamless play experience
- Native app UI/UX, optimized for iPhone, iPhone Duo, iPad, Apple TV and Vision Pro
- Display shows in grid or list
- Browse show details including actors and descriptions
- Quickly navigate to an episode with segment or season selection
- Sort episodes alphabetically or in reverse order
# Play experience
- Playback speed adjustment
- AirPlay, Picture in Picture, SharePlay
- Auto-play next episode
- Pan horizontally to adjust playback progress
- Pan vertically to adjust brightness and volume
- Skip intro and outro with manual configuration
- Auto-playback from last seen timestamp
- tvOS/visionOS: Next episode button in info view
# Search
- Aggregate search
- Search history
- Option to enable exact match
# Manage my stuff
- Favorite
- Watch history
- Navigate to show from history
# Source management
- Manage multiple sources
- Edit, delete or sort sources
- Hide certain sources
- Import sources from JSON
- Export sources to JSON
- Manually add source
# Apple feature integration
- iCloud sync across all platforms (can be disabled)
- tvOS TopShelf
Icon Attribution: Television icons created by Freepik - Flaticon https://www.flaticon.com/free-icons/television
Disclaimer: This app doesn't provide, contain or distribute any VOD or video sources. All sources are provided and entered by the users. Users must provide copyright-free contents or ensure they have acquired the copyrights to play videos in CMSPlayer.

bluejetty:00120484:ios.name: PlayKids Learning Games
bluejetty:00120484:ios.summary:
Learning games, educational videos and creative activities for kids aged 0-8. 100% ad-free, works offline, trusted by over 70 million families since 2014.
PlayKids Learning brings 18,000+ videos and 150+ learning games into one safe, ad-f
bluejetty:00120484:ios.description:
Learning games, educational videos and creative activities for kids aged 0-8. 100% ad-free, works offline, trusted by over 70 million families since 2014.
PlayKids Learning brings 18,000+ videos and 150+ learning games into one safe, ad-free app. Your child learns the alphabet, counts, solves puzzles, draws, paints, listens to stories and watches educational cartoons - while you get parental controls, screen-time limits and complete peace of mind.
WHAT YOUR CHILD LEARNS
- Alphabet and phonics: letters, sounds and first words
- Numbers and math: counting, shapes and early problem solving
- Logic and focus: puzzles, memory games and challenges
- Drawing and coloring: creative activities that build fine motor skills
- Stories and reading: interactive books that grow with your child
- Kindness and teamwork: social-emotional learning in every episode
WHY PARENTS CHOOSE PLAYKIDS
- 100% ad-free: no ads, no pop-ups, no links out of the app
- kidSAFE certified and COPPA compliant
- Offline access: download videos and games for the car, the plane or anywhere without Wi-Fi
- Parental controls for content filters and screen time
- Works on every device in the house, for every child in the family
- Built by specialists in early-childhood education and pedagogy
- Recognized by Parents' Choice, NAPPA Awards and the Michael Cohen Group
MADE FOR EVERY AGE
- Babies and toddlers (0-2): songs, colors, first words and simple touch games
- Preschool (3-5): alphabet, numbers, shapes, drawing and early reading
- Kindergarten and up (5-8): math, logic, reading and creative projects
SHOWS AND CHARACTERS KIDS LOVE
Original PlayKids series including I Love to Learn, Junior on the Job, Kantala, SuperHands, ABC, Tiny Balloon and Lupi Club, plus favorite characters: Baby Shark, Talking Tom, Pocoyo, Masha and the Bear, Numberblocks, Hot Wheels and Bob Zoom.
BEYOND THE SCREEN
PlayKids encourages off-screen play too, with DIY projects, dancing and family activities, so learning does not stop when the app closes.
SUBSCRIPTION DETAILS
PlayKids Learning is a subscription that unlocks every video, game and activity.
- Choose a monthly or annual plan
- Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase
- Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period
- Manage or cancel anytime in your Apple Account settings
- Any unused portion of a free trial is forfeited when a subscription is purchased
Privacy Policy: policies.playkidsapp.com/en/privacy
Terms of Service: policies.playkidsapp.com/en/tos
Help Center: help.playkids.com
Content availability may vary by country.

bluejetty:00030855:ios.description:
Smart Vehicle Management App, Infocar 
Manage your vehicle smarter with Infocar, from vehicle diagnostics to driving style analysis!
■ Vehicle Diagnostics 
* Check your vehicle's condition yourself! 
 Inspect ignition systems, exhaust systems, electronic circuits, and more to detect any faults. 
* Fault Code Descriptions 
 Understand problems easily with fault codes categorized into three levels. Use the deletion feature to clear fault codes stored in the ECU effortlessly. 
■ Manufacturer Data 
* Experience diagnostic results 99% identical to those from repair shops. 
* Manage your vehicle more accurately with over 2,000 manufacturer-specific sensor data points tailored to each vehicle model. 
* View detailed diagnostic results by control unit (ECU).
■ Real-Time Monitoring 
* Access real-time data from over 800 OBD2 sensors! 
* Visualize data with graphs to understand your vehicle’s status at a glance.
■ Dashboard 
* View all the essential data you need while driving in one place! 
* Optimized for convenience 
 Customize the display to your preferences and easily monitor real-time fuel efficiency and remaining fuel levels. 
* HUD (Head-Up Display) 
 Stay informed about speed, RPM, mileage, and more while driving, with data reflected onto your windshield for safer driving.
■ Driving Style Analysis 
* Check your safety and eco-driving scores 
 Analyze your driving habits with Infocar’s algorithm and discover your unique driving style. 
* Continuously improve with statistical graphs and driving records.
■ Driving Records 
* Track every drive! 
 Record your driving distance, time, average speed, fuel efficiency, and more. View warnings for overspeeding, rapid acceleration, sudden braking, and sharp turns on a map. 
* Driving Replay 
 Review speed, RPM, and acceleration data by time and location. 
* Download your driving logs as an Excel file for detailed analysis.
■ Vehicle Management 
* Manage maintenance schedules effortlessly 
 Keep track of recommended replacement intervals and maintenance schedules based on your vehicle's mileage. 
* Expense Tracker 
 Organize your expenses and review them by category or date to plan your budget effectively.
■ Compatible OBD2 Devices 
* Infocar supports various devices based on the international OBD2 protocol. 
 However, it is optimized for Infocar devices, and some features may be limited when using third-party products.
■ Required and Optional Permissions 
* Location: For driving records and parking location tracking. 
* Bluetooth: For connecting to the scanner. 
* Microphone: For voice recording with the dashcam feature. 
* Camera: For capturing videos with the dashcam feature. 
*Note: You can use the app’s main features without granting optional permissions.*
■ Support and Inquiries 
* Having trouble with Bluetooth or vehicle registration? 
 Go to Settings > FAQ > 1:1 Inquiry in the Infocar app to send us an email, and we’ll assist you promptly. 
* [Terms and Conditions](https://infocarmobility.com/sub/service_lang/en)
■ Subscription and In-App Purchases 
Infocar is free to use, but some features require a subscription or in-app purchase. 
* Subscriptions are billed to your Apple account and automatically renew unless auto-renewal is disabled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. 
* You can manage or cancel your subscription anytime through your account settings. 
* Deleting the app does not automatically cancel your subscription, so please cancel it manually if needed.
Start your journey to smarter vehicle management with Infocar!

bluejetty:00086984:ios.summary:
Monitoring your health and making the right lifestyle choices can be repetitive, confusing, and even stressful.
Developed with healthy adults, chronic patients, nutritionists, doctors, researchers, and lifestyle coaches, Elfie is the world
bluejetty:00086984:ios.description:
Monitoring your health and making the right lifestyle choices can be repetitive, confusing, and even stressful.
Developed with healthy adults, chronic patients, nutritionists, doctors, researchers, and lifestyle coaches, Elfie is the world's first application that rewards you for tracking your vitals and symptoms, and making the right lifestyle choices.
KEY FEATURES
The Elfie app is a wellness application with the following features:
Lifestyle monitoring:
1. Weight management
2. Smoking cessation
3. Step tracking
4. Calorie burn and physical activity 
5. Sleep management 
6. Women's health 
Digital pillbox:
1. 4+ million medications
2. Intake & refill reminders 
3. Adherence statistics by therapeutic areas
Vital monitoring, trends and guidelines:
1. Blood pressure
2. Blood glucose and HbA1c
3. Cholesterol levels (HDL-C, LDL-C, Triglycerides)
4. Angina (chest pain)
5. Heart failure 
6. Symptoms 
GAMIFICATION
Mechanics:
1. Each user gets a personalized self-monitoring plan adjusted to their lifestyle objectives and diseases (if any)
2. Each time you add a vital, follow your plan, or even read articles or answer quizzes, you will earn Elfie coins.
3. With those coins, you can claim amazing prizes (up to $2000 and more) or make donations to charities
Ethics:
1. In sickness and in health: each user, healthy or not, can earn the same amount of coins each month by completing their plan.
2. Medicated or not: users on medication don't earn more coins and we do not incentivize any type of medication. If you are medicated, we reward you for telling the truth equally: taking or skipping your medication will earn you the same amount of coins.
3. In good times and bad times: you will get the same amount of coins for entering a good vital or a bad one. What matters is that you keep monitoring your health.
DATA PROTECTION & PRIVACY
At Elfie, we are extremely serious with data protection and your privacy. As such, regardless of your country, we decided to implement the most strict policies from the European Union (GDPR), the United States (HIPAA), Singapore (PDPA), Brazil (LGPD) and Turkey (KVKK). We appointed an independent Data Privacy Officer and multiple data representatives to monitor our actions and protect your rights.
MEDICAL AND SCIENTIFIC CREDIBILITY
Elfie content is reviewed by doctors, nutritionists, researchers, and is endorsed by six medical associations. 
NO MARKETING
We don't sell any products or services. We don't allow advertising either. Elfie is financially supported by employers, insurers, laboratories, hospitals to reduce the cost of chronic diseases on private and public healthcare systems.
DISCLAIMERS
Elfie is intended to be a wellness application aiming at encouraging the users to track metrics relating to their health and to receive general information for a healthy lifestyle. It is NOT intended to be used for a medical purpose, and notably to prevent, diagnose, manage, or monitor diseases. Please refer to the terms of use for more details.
If you feel unwell, experience drug-related side-effects, or seek medical advice, please contact your doctor as Elfie is not the right platform to do so.
Wishing you good health.
The Elfie Team
