Unlike other betting platforms, on Kutt you always see who
bluejetty:00146924:ios.description:
Kutt is a skill-based peer-to-peer (P2P) social betting app that allows friends and strangers to wager directly against each other on the outcome of sports and user-created events.
Unlike other betting platforms, on Kutt you always see who you're betting against. So stop letting your friends and social media warriors flake on their bets against you!
Kutt's betting platform is a next-level game of skill where you can compete against your friends and other users by correctly predicting the outcome of sporting events and events created by the community. Competition is so much more fun when it's social. On Kutt, everyone has a user profile, so you always know exactly who you are competing against (and can always send that person a personalized message telling them just how much more you know about the game than they do). With detailed record-keeping, Kutt provides a fun way to track your performance against your competitors, and the Leaderboard showcases the users in the community with the best prediction record.
Other features that make for a fun experience include:
- Kutt's Social Feed shows you what events other people are betting on
- Select your favorite teams, and create groups of users who like the same teams
- The ability to create your own bet and your own odds if you don't like what you're seeing from the community
Kutt is… Social.
Kutt is… Competition.
Kutt is… FUN.
Join the Kutt community today for the most fun you can possibly have with friends and other sports fans.
Must be 18+ to play. Deposit with card, Apple Pay, or Cash App Pay.

bluejetty:00041306:ios.description:
Druno turns the world's best nonfiction books into short, animated book summaries you can watch in minutes. Get the big ideas from bestsellers on habits, money, psychology, productivity, leadership and personal growth, told as cinematic stories that actually stick.
WHY DRUNO
• Animated book summaries: every book becomes a short film with characters, not a wall of text.
• Learn in minutes: each book starts with a 30-second opening, then short chapters you can watch anywhere.
• 100+ bestselling books: The Psychology of Money, Sapiens, Thinking, Fast and Slow, Rich Dad Poor Dad, Never Split the Difference, The Subtle Art of Not Giving a F*ck and many more, with new books added all the time.
• Goodreads ratings on every book, so you know what readers think before you press play.
FIND YOUR NEXT BIG IDEA
• Discover by mood: Feel Calmer, Be More Productive, Grow Your Money, Lead Better, Connect With People, Get Through Hard Times and more.
• Shelves for every subject: self-improvement, psychology, business, money, communication, health and big ideas about the world.
• Book of the day: one handpicked book every day.
• Search by title, author or topic.
MADE FOR BUSY PEOPLE
• Watch on your commute, on a break or before bed.
• Pick up where you left off; members can keep listening with the screen off.
• Save books and key moments to your library.
• Daily streaks and gentle reminders to keep learning.
• Available in 30 languages.
REQUEST A BOOK
Members can request the books they want next and follow them in line until they are ready.
MEMBERSHIP
The opening of every book is free to watch. A Druno membership unlocks every chapter of every book. Monthly and yearly plans are available, with introductory offers for eligible new members shown before you pay. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period; manage or cancel anytime in your store account settings.
Privacy policy: https://msa-stories.com/mobile-app/privacy-policy
Terms of use: https://msa-stories.com/mobile-app/terms
Support: contact@herogram.app

Just place your device against two surf
bluejetty:00136623:ios.description:
Digital Angle Finder is an app for precise measurement of angles, simply by moving your device. The "Digital Angle Finder" app measures the angle of the device, using the accelerometer and gyroscope.
Just place your device against two surfaces in turn and "Digital Angle Finder" will give you the angle between them. In the protractor mode you can also determine the angle between lines on a plane: in order to do so align the edge of your device alternately against the sides of the angle.
The accuracy of angles measurement is rather high: the error is only one degree!
You'll appreciate the ability to save the measurement by taking a photo with the measured angle recorded on it. We are sure that you will like the design of this app.
Digital Angle Finder is an app that adds a new feature to your device which you have never imagined!

Baseball for MLB Superfans! Follow every score and every pitch with lightning-fast updates, immersive pitch-by-pitch coverage, complete player and team stats, instant alerts, news, standings, odds, injuries, confirmed lineups, and much more.
Our clean, intuitive design is lightweight, fast, and fully customizable. Enjoy every MLB game - without the clutter.
Go beyond the box score with pregame analysis, starting pitcher matchups, bullpen availability, win probabilities, and game recaps.
MLB Scores, Play-by-Play and Alerts
• Lightning-fast MLB scores for every game, every day
• Track every pitch, big swing, pitching change, and momentum shift
• Instant alerts for scores, close games, extra innings and more
• Track standings, wild card races, and the postseason picture
• A daily scoreboard built for the full slate, with every live game easy to scan
Game Analysis
• Pregame analysis that shows what could decide the matchup
• Starting pitcher analysis with recent form, matchup edge, and key trends
• Bullpen availability, late-inning pressure points, and arms that can swing the game
• Win probabilities, lineup edges, and weather impact before first pitch
• View game odds, including moneylines, run lines, and totals
• Game recaps that capture the biggest moments, key performances, and what comes next
Injuries and Lineup News
• Know who is in, who is out, and which injuries could change the matchup
• Confirmed lineups and late scratches before first pitch
• See how injuries and lineup changes shift each game
MLB Stats and Box Scores
• Player stats, game logs, career numbers, and season leaders
• Box scores that bring every inning, run, and stat into focus
• League leaders for home runs, RBIs, strikeouts, saves, and more
• Postgame stats that show how each game was decided
Schedules, Standings and Team News
• Latest MLB news for every team
• Probable pitchers, TV listings, and radio broadcasts for every game
• Full MLB schedule: filter by team, division, or league
• Everything for your team: news, schedules, stats, lineups, and roster updates
• Follow the postseason, from the Wild Card Series to the World Series
Everything you need to follow MLB baseball, from first pitch to the final out. Fast scores, detailed stats, in-depth analysis, and complete game coverage - all without the clutter.
This is baseball for superfans.
Download now.

bluejetty:00019536:ios.name: ASICS Runkeeper—Run Tracker
bluejetty:00019536:ios.summary: Reach your running goals with the ASICS Runkeeper™ app. Track exercise, set measurable goals and see progress along the way—whether you’re just getting into running, training for a race or trying to reach a new personal record, we can help.
bluejetty:00019536:ios.description:
Reach your running goals with the ASICS Runkeeper™ app. Track exercise, set measurable goals and see progress along the way—whether you’re just getting into running, training for a race or trying to reach a new personal record, we can help.
MOTIVATION TO MOVE
•Guided Workouts: Whether you’re a beginner or an experienced runner, our ASICS Running coaches push you to reach your fitness goals through a variety of audio-guided workouts that complement your fitness journey
• Track workouts: Record activities like running, walking, biking, hiking and more manually or with GPS. 
• Set goals: Maybe you want to get faster, run farther or lose a little weight. No matter your goal, we’ll help you reach it.

bluejetty:00069076:ios.name: Spelling Bee Games & Tests
bluejetty:00069076:ios.summary:
• Help your child to learn
Help your child with spelling and times tables. Enter kids’ weekly spelling homework lists from school. The newly added feature of taking photo of spelling word list and converting to a spelling test within second
bluejetty:00069076:ios.description:
• Help your child to learn
Help your child with spelling and times tables. Enter kids’ weekly spelling homework lists from school. The newly added feature of taking photo of spelling word list and converting to a spelling test within seconds, makes it extremely fast to enter your child's custom weekly spelling words and create a spelling test. Alternatively enter spelling lists manually. Say the spelling homework words and put them into sentences. Both are recorded and can be played back when your student is being tested. Correct spelling is still important in early education.
Download this app if you want your child to become a great speller. 
Great spelling bee practice! Standard spelling word lists, Preschool to Grade 6, are also provided but you can make up your own word lists as well as the kids’ spelling homework provided from school. This spelling app for kids is a spelling teacher. You can also link with your class teacher and email your kids spelling and times tables results to them. This app can help improve your kids spelling and times tables test results. The app keeps track of spelling test and times tables results.
• Bonus Maths Practice
As a bonus we also include times table practice. Your child can practice the basic tables from the 2 times table to the 12 times tables. There is also practice for 13 times, 25, 75, 125 and 175 times tables. Learning these will improve mental maths agility for adults as well as kids. Improve your Spelling and Times Tables all in one app. This app has maths tables, addition and subtraction practice.
• Fun learning
Spelling and math games have been included to help with learning spelling lists and times tables. You can now play Word Searches, Crosswords, Pop the Balloons, fill in the blank or multiple choice with your provided grade or custom spelling word and maths tables.
• A tool for busy parents
So Spelling Bee Games & Tests is an app for the busy parent and busy kids to help with school spelling words lists, times tables, addition and subtraction tests. This app also includes 1000 plus grade appropriate spelling words to get your child to the top of the class. Useful for primary or grade school children and time poor mums and dads. You can enter each weekly spelling homework list as it comes home, recording the word and then the word in a sentence (making it humorous, if you like) and it keeps a record of the lists that have been completed successfully. Timed multiplication, addition and subtraction table tests keep a record of which tables have been completed and time it took. Print out child's spelling homework list results or email straight to teacher. Great when in the car on the way to sports, shopping and school. Put it on your child's device or your own. Downloading this app can also help your child's word knowledge and maths ability. 
A recently added feature us the ability to download themed spelling lists such as adverbs or “ght” words from our website. These spelling word lists will be added to regularly.
This spelling and times tables app has recently been 5-star certified by teachers from the educational app store.
This app gives you access to all premium features for 7 days, to see if it fits your needs after which time you will need to purchase to continue using. To find out more about in app subscriptions please visit https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
New Feature
This app can now be used in English, Swedish, French, Spanish and German to help your child with learning new languages.

bluejetty:00177368:ios.description:
Slither your way out through the extreme obstacle course in this fascinating snake run game! Ready, set, go! 
Try speedy racing and winning the fun run race 3d in our awesome casual game!
Remember the old snake quest? The main difference of our snake race is that this one has high-quality and vivid graphics, gripping gameplay, and plenty of other slithering snakes! It will be your best option from all the running games you've ever played before! 
Our endless runner will become your savior in long lines, during boring or sleepless hours at home or on a bus, train, airplane, etc. Just join the epic race 3D to have some fun! Get into the crazy rush of 3d racing filled with awesome challenges and colorful levels to brighten up your humdrum routine! 
MERGE THE SNAKES
You’re not alone in the crazy rush! There are other snakes on your way to victory. Eat them to prolong and pass levels in your run race 3D quest! Be careful and don’t aim for the serpents longer than you. This will only lead to the restart of your racing. Calculate your moves in this crazy run to finish it!
OBSTACLE COURSE
There will be plenty of challenges on your way in the 3d racing. Go through all of them to win this fun race 3d! Dodge the various hurdles, avoid your enemies, and get to the end of your snake race safe and sound!
CRAZY RUN THROUGH TRAILS
Let destiny run its course and lead you to the title of the racing champion! But don’t just hope for luck—put your skills to the test to prove you can be the best in this fun run 3d! Think fast but act even faster in your fun race 3D to become the legend of all running racing games!
With this epic race 3D simulator, you will def forget about other fun run 3d games! 
- Simple gameplay. Merge the snakes, avoid barriers, and finish your destiny run to show you are the best in this run race 3d game!
- Bright visuals. You’ll love this endless runner for its beautiful serpents and cartoonish graphics!
- Relaxing fun race 3d. You don’t have to think much in your crazy run. Just join the epic race 3d to have some rest!
- One of the most fun running games! Our crazy rush will steal the heart of every person thanks to its mind-blowing 3d racing and obstacle course!
- Thrilling challenges. Are you ready to go down in the history of fun run 3d games? Then complete all the levels of our endless runner!
- Nostalgic fun race 3D! The crazy rush will be special for those players who were truly in love with the old snake race from their childhood!
It’s time you start your destiny run to prove you’re the true master of our amazing endless runner! Go through the obstacle course to be remembered in one of the most popular running games!

bluejetty:00152942:ios.description:
Sensi Master is the sensitivity app for players who want more aiming precision right on their phone. Pick your device model, apply the sensitivity and get more control over your aim.
Every phone responds differently. That is why Sensi Master brings together sensitivity and aim settings organized by brand and model, so you do not waste time testing settings on your own.
WHAT YOU WILL FIND IN THE APP
• Sensitivities by phone: search for your device and see the suggested values.
• Aim settings: separate values for general, red dot and zoom scopes, so you can train your own play style.
• Quick search: type the phone or sensitivity name and find it in seconds.
• Share your sensitivity: publish the setup that works for you and see what other players are using.
• Best of the week: check the sensitivities and plays that are trending in the community.
• Comments and likes: tell others if a sensitivity worked on your device and help other players.
• Frequent updates: new sensitivities and devices are added regularly.
WHY USE IT
• Less time tweaking, more time playing.
• Steadier aim and more controlled movement.
• Values designed for different screens and performance levels, from entry-level to flagship phones.
• Simple interface, easy to use between matches.
HOW IT WORKS
1. Open Sensi Master and search for your phone.
2. Pick a sensitivity from the list.
3. Copy the values and apply them in your game settings.
4. Test, adjust to your taste and share with your friends.
IMPORTANT NOTICE
Sensi Master is an independent helper app and is not affiliated with, associated with, authorized by, sponsored by or endorsed by any game developer or publisher. All names and trademarks mentioned belong to their respective owners. Sensitivities are suggestions and may vary depending on your device and play style.
Terms of Use: https://www.allakore.com/sensimasterff/terms.html

bluejetty:00020990:ios.description:
Patrol the streets and become the ultimate Police Officer in this spectacular driving simulation game. This new police simulator offers you gigantic cities to explore like:Los Angeles,Rome, Shanghai, several types of missions and countless vehicles, upgrades and officers. Drive around the open world maps or get out of the car, control your officer and have fun in our ultimate police simulator game.
Drive around the open world maps or get out of the car, control your officer and have fun in our ultimate police simulator game.
Pick your favorite car and complete missions or just free-roam the huge maps. You will have a wide selection of vehicles to choose from, ranging from regular cars and classic police cruisers to more exotic supercars and hypercars. You can even drive some massive SWAT trucks!
Complete the various missions in our new 2022 Police simulation game. The Chase mission is one of the most exhilarating driving experiences you can have: chase and hit the suspect's car until you get to arrest them. If you like some more relaxed driving you can try the police escort mission or help your squad stop suspect vehicles with spike strips in the roadblock mission. If you enjoy giving out tickets, try the Parking and Radar missions.
You can also go Undercover with a special set of challenges, unique to our next-gen police simulator. Feel the thrill of the car chase in the Fugitive mission or quietly drive behind the suspect car from a distance in the Follow mission. You can also complete Stakeout missions, in which you take photos of illegal activities.
Police Simulator Features:
◾ Amazing selection of different types of vehicles.
◾ Different police officers.
◾ Explore gigantic cities (4 times larger than before).
◾ 8 mission types with more coming your way!
◾ Realistic Controls (tilt steering, buttons or virtual steering wheel).
◾ Realistic vehicle features and physics.
◾ Visual tuning options and Police cruiser upgrades.
◾ Amazing next-gen graphics with weather effects, rain, fog.
◾ Ultra-realistic city traffic (cars, vans, trucks, motorcycles, bicycles).
◾ Pedestrian traffic makes the city feel alive.
◾ Career, Free Roam, Multiplayer plus milestones and challenges.
◾ Frequent updates to our police simulator game to keep it fresh and fun!
◾ Brand new missions and police cars coming in 2022.
◾ Request new vehicles or features on our social media.
Don't miss out on this opportunity to become a Police Officer in our realistic police simulator game.
Try it now!

Privacy Policy: https://www.ovilex.com/privacy-policy-police-sim/

bluejetty:00165308:ios.description:
Turn your favorite photos into beautiful carousels, scrapbook pages, and collages – all in one app. 17V28 is the creative toolkit trusted by 2M+ creators worldwide for making Instagram posts that actually stand out!!
Whether you’re creating a photo dump from last weekend, a travel diary from your latest trip, a monthly recap, or a digital junk journal – 17V28 gives you everything you need to make it look incredible.
200+ UNIQUE TEMPLATES
Explore a growing library of templates for every mood and moment: Minimalism, Film, Scrapbook, Digital Core, Guides, Grid, Junk Journaling, Summer Dump, Recaps, and more. Every template is designed with care by our team, with new seasonal drops landing regularly so there’s always something fresh to create with.
COMMUNITY TEMPLATES
Some of our most-loved templates are made by creators from the 17V28 community. It’s a feature we’re truly proud of – real creators designing for real creators.
1,000+ HANDCRAFTED STICKERS
Every single sticker in 17V28 is made by hand – from cute papers and vintage tapes to seasonal collections for every occasion. You can also turn your own photos into custom stickers with our cutout tool.
FILM FRAMES & ANALOG TEXTURES
Give your photos that nostalgic, shot-on-film feeling. Choose from our collection of film frames, grain overlays, and light leak textures that bring a timeless, vintage look to your creations.
FONTS THAT FIT YOUR STYLE
Pick from dozens of trendy fonts to add text to your projects or upload your own custom fonts to make your designs truly yours.
VIDEO SUPPORT
Photos are forever, but videos bring the vibe. Mix video and photo into your templates and frames, layer stickers and text on top, and create something that moves.
CREATIVE TOOLS
Add bubble messages, location, time stickers, and drawings to bring your stories to life. Start from a template or create your project from scratch – layer photos, stickers, fonts, textures, and more. Move, resize, and arrange everything exactly how you want.
WHAT CREATORS LOVE ABOUT 17V28
• Seamless carousels that flow perfectly across multiple slides
• Upload your own fonts and stickers for total customization
• New templates & sticker packs added regularly
• Community-created templates made by real creators
• Intuitive drag-and-drop editor
• Made with love by a tiny team of three
We can’t wait to see what you create. Tag us @17v28.app on Instagram and TikTok, and share your masterpieces with #17v28app!!
Questions, ideas, or feedback? Reach out anytime at support@17v28.app
Terms of Use: https://17v28.app/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://17v28.app/privacy/

bluejetty:00084122:ios.description:
My Online Golf Club offers the complete golf handicap, GPS rangefinder, scorecard, statistics, trophies, achievements and live scoring competition solution.
OFFICIAL WHS HANDICAP INDEX
Our app allows you to:
- Register for and purchase an official world handicap system (WHS) handicap index 
- Enter international competitions and play exclusive golf courses worldwide
GOLF HANDICAP
Our app allows you to:
- Submit unlimited scorecards
- Calculate your golf handicap
- Track your handicap progress
- Maintain a recognized handicap
- Use international courses as part of your golf handicap calculation
- Purchase a golf handicap card
- Purchase handicap card re-prints
GOLF HANDICAP FORMATS
Our app supports:
- World Handicap System
- CONGU
- USGA
GOLF GPS RANGEFINDER
- GPS rangefinder that works on every course in the world including distances to greens and a marker of your choice that you can move as required
- All golf course greens are marked in the middle by default but you can alter the green marker to suit your game
GOLF SCORECARD SCORE TRACKER
Our golf scorecard app allows you to track:
- Multi player scorecards
- Scorecards from any golf course worldwide
- Event or round names
- Stableford points
- Number of Putts
- Fairways in regulation
- Fairway bunkers
- Greens in regulation
- Green-side bunkers
- Out of bounds
- Penalties
- Share your scorecards with friends on Facebook
- Share your scorecards via Messages, WhatsApp, etc.
- Search for and filter scorecards
GOLF STATISTICS
Our app golf statistics driven from your scorecards include:
- Progress charts
- Par 3 statistics
- Par 4 statistics
- Par 5 statistics
- Round statistics
- Average scores
- Course section statistics
- Weather statistics
- Putt statistics
- Fairways in regulation statistics
- Greens in regulation statistics
- Scrambling
- Sand Saves
- and more...
TROPHIES
Collect over 60 trophies.
- Play your first round
- Make a par
- Break 80
- and more...
ACHIEVEMENTS
Our golf app analyses every round you submit for new achievements:
- Best round
- Best front 9
- Best back 9
- Most pars
- Most birdies
- Longest par 3 (made par)
- Longest par 4 (made par)
- Longest par 5 (made par)
- Fewest putts
- Most fairways hit
- Most green hit
- and more...
FRIENDS
- Statistics leaderboards with your friends
- Share your scorecards
- Share your statistics
- View your friends golf handicap
- View your friends scorecards and statistics
COMPETITIONS
You can create competitions with friends:
- Create golf competitions based on net score, gross score, stableford points, match play or skins
- Live golf scoring
- View a live leaderboard as you play and after you complete your round
- View hole by hole scores of other competition players
- Receive updates when the leaderboard is updated
PHOTOS
- Upload and save photos from your golf round
DARK MODE
- Full support for Apple's dark appearance
IN APP PURCHASES
All of our app features are free and will remain free forever including all of our future improvements. We simply ask that once you have submitted 30+ scorecards that you pay 99p per year to help us continue to improve and maintain our service.
PLAYING GOLF ABROAD?
Many golf courses throughout the world require golfers to provide evidence of their golfing ability before they will allow them onto the golf course. This is particularly true in Spain and Portugal. Our golf handicap card is accepted worldwide.
MYONLINEGOLFCLUB.COM
With our app you will also gain access to our website where you can further enrich your scorecard information and gain access to more in-depth analysis and charting.
Download our app today and start tracking your golf handicap.
Privacy Policy: https://www.myonlinegolfclub.com/PrivacyPolicy
Terms of Service: https://www.myonlinegolfclub.com/TermsAndConditions

bluejetty:00131788:ios.description:
YaoYao is a standalone Apple Watch app to track your jump rope workouts.
YaoYao is featured by the App Store and Apple Newsroom.
Jump rope is a simple, effective, and an economical aerobic workout. You can choose to jump rope anytime, anywhere.
Currently, Apple Watch allows you to track multiple workouts including running or cycling, and swimming, but not jump rope.
Often, counting your jumps during your jump rope workout is essential and is an important aspect. YaoYao utilizes Apple Watch’s motion sensors to calculate your jumps. YaoYao literally costs you no more than an ordinary jump rope.
- 2022/02/20 New AirPods Mode：Count with AirPods motion sensor, no Apple Watch required（Support AirPods 3/Pro/Max/Beats Fit Pro）
Features :
- Jumps counting (includes support for double unders)
For every 100 jumps, the app encourages you with voice feedback of your current progress - so that you can focus on your posture and avoid glancing at the Watch to check your jump counts.
- Live Count
Live counts of your jumps are displayed along with the voice feedback.
- Exercise time record
- Jump speed (Speed) record/Scrolling Speed (Speed of jumps over the past minute)
- Record the number of consecutive jumps
Along with the jump speed, the app also counts the number of jumps in one go.
- Heart rate record
Max heart rate warning tip.
- Calorie burn value
- HIIT mode
Time or Jumps Interval
- iPhone real time display (Live Count):
Open the iPhone app during exercise and display the jump data on the iPhone
- Syncs with iOS Health app.
YaoYao syncs and stores health data to the iOS Health app from Apple. YaoYao integrates with the Apple Health app to sync your workouts and record heart-rate data.
Enjoy jumping rope!
Note:
If the app does not work after installing, please reboot your Apple Watch.
- Apple Watch 1/2 generation is not supported
User Reviews:
fencemember: Great accurate! I love this app so glad I found it 
nauf4l: was planning to buy a 100$ jump rope which counts skips as i always do 5k skips a day. So after a month was considering this when i came across this app after installing 5 apps of the same.Glad i paid about 2$ for this as it is totally worth it. 
FrankWurst: Accurate jump counter based solely on Apple Watch. App integrates into My Health and Activity App seamlessly. Great product.
tafty：I enjoy the skipping experience with this app. And it syncs well with Apple Watch

bluejetty:00029641:ios.description:
Sugar Cash is a casual match-3 puzzle game where every candy you match can move you up the leaderboard — and into skill-based tournaments for real prizes.
Swap two candies, line up three or more, and watch the board clear. Simple to learn, quick to play, and hard to put down once the combos start chaining.
HOW YOU PLAY
Swap adjacent candies to make a match of 3 or more. Chain matches into combos to trigger power-ups and clear whole rows of the board. Every puzzle level is timed, so the faster you read the board, the higher you score.
COMPETE ON SKILL
Every match pairs you with a player of similar ability, so the higher score wins — not the bigger wallet. Compete head-to-head, climb the leaderboards, and collect trophies as you rank up. Prefer to play solo? Practice any level with virtual currency, as long as you like.
WHAT YOU GET
- Classic match-3 puzzle gameplay with hundreds of levels
- Power-ups and boosters that reward smart matching, not spending
- Live leaderboards, trophies and player rankings
- Head-to-head tournaments on the Skillz® competition platform
- Practice mode with virtual currency, always available
- Quick rounds that fit a coffee break
MATCH, RANK, REPEAT
Clear a board, climb a rank, unlock the next tier. Each level adds new candy layouts and tighter timers, so your matching gets sharper the further you go. Sweet puzzles, real competition, and a leaderboard that never stops moving.
Download Sugar Cash and start matching.
Real prize tournaments are not available in AR, CT, DE, LA and SD. If you are outside a prize-enabled region, you can still play every level for fun with virtual currency.

bluejetty:00015932:ios.description:
iziCast is a versatile audio and video broadcaster. 
You can broadcast audio from the internal microphone, external audio devices, audio files and Audiobus compatible apps to Icecast, Shoutcast and RTMP servers. 
Live video from your camera can be broadcasted to any RTMP compatible service, such as YouTube, Twitch, Facebook and Telegram.
Any of the supported audio sources listed above can be combined with your live camera.  
When using RTMP you can decide if you want to use one of your device cameras as video source or simply an image.
In case of an image it is up to you if you want to stream a single image, the album cover of the current track or just a black image to save bandwidth. 
The image can be changed during the broadcast and you can even let iziCast write text like the current song on the image.
Besides that, iziCast comes with a lot more features. Have a look at the list below to find out what else iziCast can do.
If you have any questions or suggestions feel free to contact me at izicast@danielnoethen.de
The following features are included in iziCast:
• Supports internal microphones
• Supports external multi channel audio devices
• Supports video streaming from your device camera
• Supports audio files

bluejetty:00016425:ios.description:
FreeCell
FreeCell is a fun and classic single player Solitaire card game. The clean design and big cards make playing this game a breeze. This twist on the classic game of Solitaire will keep you entertained for hours. Download the game for free now and enjoy the best FreeCell app out there!
FreeCell is played with a standard 52-card deck. The goal of the game is to move all the cards to the four Foundation piles (located in the top left) and build each suit up from Ace to King. When playing, use the four open cells (on the top right) to store cards as you are trying to win.
Features of FreeCell include:
• Unlimited free games
• Undo feature
• Game statistics
• Auto Move on/off
• Tap to move or drag and drop cards
• Game leaderboards and achievements
• Sound that can be turned on/off
• Game state saved

• “Just love the game keep my mind sharp”
• “Love free cell & this app is great!”
If you like this app be sure to check out our other card games:
• Solitaire
• Spider Solitaire
• Pyramid Solitaire

• Get Woolies delivered super fast
• Shop 10,000+ groceries and 2,000 drinks all on one app

• No service fees
• First 3 deliveries are free

Plus, we’re in more New Zealand areas than ever, delivering to suburbs in Auckland, Wellington, Dunedin, and Queenstown with wayyy more to come.

bluejetty:00151401:ios.description:
O Go car está disponível em Divinópolis, Para de Minas e outras cidades da região.
A GoCar lhe conecta com os melhores motoristas da cidade. Com a Go Car você tem na palma da mão todas informações do motorista que irá lhe buscar e ainda pode avaliá-lo ao final da corrida.
Com nosso aplicativo você planeja sua corrida com antecedência, sabe quanto vai pagar e ainda avalia sua experiência ajudando a manter a qualidade do nosso aplicativo.
Iniciamos em Divinópolis-MG, mas já estamos em Pará de Minas e Itaúna-MG. A GoCar Brasil não para de crescer, em breve na sua região!
Fácil: Chame seu motorista clicando apenas em um botão ;)
Seguro: Apenas motorista credenciados.
Rápido: Seu motorista chega em poucos minutos
Saiba quanto vai pagar! Com a GoCar Brasil você obtém uma estimativa de preço antes de solicitar sua corrida.
Carros novos, ar condicionado, água e balas.
Acompanhe o motorista se deslocando até seu endereço
Motoristas 24hrs na palma da sua mão
Avalie sua experiência: Possuímos um sistema de avaliação de corridas
Como usar
Espere o aplicativo encontrar sua localização com seu GPS. Depois é só pedir o seu motorista online. 
Confirme sua localização, se preciso informe seu ponto de referência e insira seu destino para prosseguir
Espere a GoCar Brasil encontrar um motorista próximo de você. Acompanhe ele no mapa e em minutos ele estará na localização que você solicitou.
Disponível em: Divinópolis, Pará de Minas e outras cidades de Minas Gerais.

bluejetty:00128191:ios.description:
Join thousands of pregnant women who feel calm, sleep deeply, and face labor with confidence. Guided hypnobirthing for a calmer birth. Start today.
Zen Pregnancy is a hypnobirthing app for expecting moms. It combines guided hypnobirthing meditation, breathing exercises for labor, birth affirmations, sleep audio, and labor tools in one calm daily ritual, built around your due date.
WHY MOMS CHOOSE ZEN PREGNANCY
• Release the Fear of Childbirth, our most-loved session, is free
• A daily ritual made for your week: Morning, Hypnobirthing and Tonight sessions
• 60+ hypnobirthing, meditation, relaxation and sleep audios
• Live Family Sharing: your partner and family follow labor in real time
• No account needed. Your pregnancy data stays on your phone
WHAT YOU GET
• Hypnobirthing meditation: deep relaxation, visualization and positive birth practice
• Breathing exercises: calm breathing for pregnancy, surges and contractions
• Birth affirmations: a new affirmation each day, 150 to collect and save
• Pregnancy sleep: bedtime meditations, sleep music and a sleep timer
• Birth partner audio: help your partner support you in labor
• Contraction timer and baby kick counter, also on Apple Watch
• Due date calculator, pregnancy week by week and baby size
• Weight tracker, journal, birth plan and birth guides
• Home screen widgets with your affirmation and daily sessions
• Offline downloads, playlists, favorites and gentle reminders
LIVE FAMILY SHARING
Create a private family page in one tap. Share bump photos, weekly baby-size cards and milestones. In labor, your partner can time contractions with you while family follows along and sends love. You choose who gets the link, you can delete it anytime, and it deletes itself after your baby arrives.
HOW TO USE ZEN PREGNANCY
1. Enter your due date. Your daily plan matches your week.
2. Listen to one hypnobirthing session a day, 10 to 20 minutes.
3. Practice the breathing exercises so they feel natural in labor.
4. Play a sleep meditation at bedtime to rest deeply.
5. Read your daily birth affirmation and save the ones you love.
6. In labor, use the contraction timer and your favorite tracks.
WHO IT IS FOR
First-time moms, second births and VBAC preparation. Natural, medicated, hospital, birth center and home births. Moms with birth anxiety or fear of childbirth. Moms of every faith, including Christian moms looking for gentle, peaceful birth preparation. Anyone wanting a calm, confident pregnancy.
COMMON QUESTIONS
What is hypnobirthing?
Hypnobirthing is a birth preparation method that uses deep relaxation, breathing, visualization and positive affirmations to help you feel calm and in control during pregnancy and labor.
When should I start hypnobirthing?
Many moms start in the second trimester, but it is never too late. Even a few weeks of daily practice can help you feel calmer.
How long should I practice each day?
About 10 to 20 minutes a day. Many moms listen at bedtime.
Does hypnobirthing work with an epidural or C-section?
Yes. Hypnobirthing relaxation and breathing support any birth plan.
Is Zen Pregnancy free?
Yes. You can start free, including Release the Fear of Childbirth. Premium unlocks the full hypnobirthing library and daily program.
Is my data private?
Yes. No account, no ads, no tracking. Family Sharing is optional.
Zen Pregnancy supports relaxation and birth preparation. It is not medical advice. Always follow your midwife or doctor.
PREMIUM
Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the period ends. Manage them in your App Store settings.
-------------------------------------
Zen Pregnancy Hypnobirthing is available for iOS on iPhone & iPad.
Privacy Policy: https://zenpregnancy.net/privacy/
Terms of Service: https://zenpregnancy.net/terms/
Sites: ZenPregnancy.net

Travel into space and visit tiny Mercury, fierce Venus, friendly Earth, dusty Mars, stormy Jupiter, elegant Saturn, hazy Uranus, and mysterious Neptune. Perfect for future astronomers everywhere.
"Space should more accurately be called "Hands On With the Solar System." — Children's Technology Review
*** KAPi Best App for Older Children ***
*** Children's Technology Review Editor's Choice ***
Hurl meteorites through the atmosphere. Spin around the sun and zoom onto its surface. Jump into a whirling space storm. Boldly go where no kid has gone before in 3, 2, 1…. liftoff!
Space is No.8 in Tinybop’s award-winning Explorer’s Library. Kids can discover new worlds in other Explorer’s Library apps, including The Human Body, Plants, Simple Machines, The Earth, Weather, Homes, and Skyscrapers.
FEATURES
 + Visit 8 planets and the sun! 
 + Study the surface of each planet and the sun up close.
 + Discover the characteristics of each planet with a helpful snowman.
 + Throw meteorites at each planet to test their atmospheres and gravity.
 + See how big and massive each planet and the sun are by comparing them side-by-side.
 + Play with and observe each planet’s orbit around the sun. 
 + Follow the moon’s orbit to discover the phases of the moon.
 + See how quickly or slowly each planet spins on its axis and how long each day is.
 + Peek inside each planet’s rocky crust or gassy outer layer.
 + Move the Earth’s axis to see how it affects seasons.
 + Explore Mars’ rocky surface with NASA’s Curiosity, Pathfinder rovers. 
 + Fly the Ingenuity Chopper on Mars.
 + Experience wild weather and more on Venus. 
 + Find out why Mercury has so many craters.
 + See what Saturn’s rings are made of and make them spin.
 + Discover diamonds on Neptune and Uranus. 
 + Interactive text labels in 50+ languages teach vocabulary.
 + FREE Space Handbook has technology tips and basic info for teachers and parents.
 + Original artwork by Jessie Sattler.
 + Original sound design.
 + Open-ended activities with no rules. Curiosity and creativity are rewarded.
 + Multi-user system.
 + Fun for all ages.
 + No third-party advertising.
FREE handbook
Our expert-reviewed handbook is full of facts, interaction hints, and discussion questions to support learning in this app, in the classroom, or at home. Download in your app or at: http://tinybop.com/handbooks.

We take your and your child’s privacy very seriously. We do not collect or share personal information about your child, nor do we allow any third-party advertising.
When the camera, microphone, and other services are used within an app, your information is neither collected nor distributed outside of the app.

bluejetty:00027553:ios.description:
The easiest way to measure your pupillary distance (PD) and get your glasses prescription, right from your iPhone.
Ready to buy glasses online but missing a measurement or two? The Framery is your glasses toolkit. Measure your PD, scan your lenses for your full Rx, and shop with confidence. No appointment, no waiting room, no runaround.
MEASURE YOUR PUPILLARY DISTANCE (PD) — FREE
Your pupillary distance is the measurement between the centers of your pupils. It's what aligns your prescription lenses to your eyes, and it's almost never included on your prescription.
The Framery measures your pupillary distance in under 60 seconds. All you need is your iPhone and any credit card-sized card. No ruler, no mirror, no hassle.
Get your PD. Get your glasses. Done.
SCAN YOUR LENSES. GET YOUR FULL GLASSES PRESCRIPTION.
Can't find your glasses prescription? No need to call your doctor.
The Framery's Lens Scanner reads your prescription details directly from the lenses in your current glasses. Sphere, cylinder, axis, and pupillary distance. Your complete glasses Rx in 2 to 5 minutes.
All you need is your iPhone, a flat computer screen (12 to 27 inches), your current glasses, and any credit card-sized card.
Happy with your current prescription? Now you can reorder without the hassle.
YOUR NEXT PAIR OF GLASSES STARTS HERE
Once you have your PD and prescription, you're ready to shop The Framery's full collection. Hundreds of frames, fair prices, and a virtual try-on so you can find your perfect pair before you buy.
WHY THE FRAMERY APP
 - Free pupillary distance measurement in under 60 seconds
 - Glasses prescription scan with full Rx in 2 to 5 minutes
 - Shop hundreds of frames after you measure
 - Works with any credit card-sized card
 - Clinically tested accuracy (ANSI-80.17: Rx within 0.25D, PD within 2mm)
 - FDA, CE & TGA listed
IS THE LENS SCANNER RIGHT FOR YOU?
Designed for adults 18+ with a stable single vision prescription between -6.00 and +3.00 and cylinder up to -2.50.
Not recommended for multifocal, bifocal, or progressive lenses, prescriptions with prism correction, or anyone with a condition affecting eye health. When in doubt, check with your doctor.
We respect your privacy. Full policy at 1800contacts.com/privacy/privacy-policy
The Framery (formerly GlassesOn) is a registered Class 1 Exempt Medical Device (FDA), CE self-declared Class 1 (EU), and registered Class 1 Medical Device (TGA). The Framery does not provide medical advice and does not replace a comprehensive eye exam. We recommend visiting your eye doctor regularly.

bluejetty:00023671:ios.description:
myID is the Australian Government’s trusted Digital ID app. 
Join millions of Australians nationwide in choosing myID as your trusted way to access government services. Use your myID for a secure and convenient way to prove who you are when accessing government online services. It’s like the 100-point ID check, but on your smart device. No sharing of your physical personal ID documents. 
Access a wide range of federal, state and territory government online services with the myID app. One app to verify who you are, taking the hassle out of remembering different usernames and passwords. Once set up, you can enable your device’s biometrics security feature such as fingerprint or face for added security. This is to protect your identity and help prevent other people accessing your information. 
Your personal information won’t be shared without your permission – putting you in control. myID is accredited by the Australian Government Digital ID System which strictly controls how your identity data is collected, stored and used. 
Your myID is unique to you – don’t share it with others. 
For more information, visit www.myID.gov.au 
To provide your feedback, visit www.myID.gov.au/feedback

bluejetty:00153430:ios.description:
Solitaire Puzzle Card Games offers the perfect classic card experience, thoughtfully designed for visual comfort and mental engagement. With its clear, large-card design and smooth gameplay, it provides a relaxing yet stimulating puzzle perfect for unwinding on your phone or tablet.
Why You’ll Love Solitaire Puzzle Card Games
• Big & Clear Cards – Extra-large cards and bold fonts make every move easy on the eyes, reducing strain and boosting enjoyment.
• Stay Sharp, Play Smart – A delightful brain-training exercise that enhances focus, problem-solving, and mental agility—perfect for daily mindfulness.
• True Classic Gameplay – Faithful to the original Solitaire rules you know and love, with the option to play Draw 1 or Draw 3 for just the right challenge.
• Intuitive & Effortless – Simple tap-and-drag controls and a clean layout let you focus on the fun, whether you’re new to Solitaire or a longtime fan.
How to Play
Arrange cards in descending order, alternating colors, to build the foundation stacks. Choose between Draw 1 or Draw 3 to tailor the difficulty. Use hints and undo freely—it’s all about enjoying the game your way.
Features at a Glance
• Choose Your Challenge – Select Draw 1 or Draw 3 mode to match your skill.
• Unlimited Games – Never run out of layouts—a fresh puzzle every time.
• Daily & Weekly Challenges – Earn trophies and beat your personal best.
• Fully Customizable – Pick card styles, backgrounds, portrait or landscape view, and more.
• Accessibility First – Includes colorblind mode, left-handed layout, and dark/light themes.
• Play Anywhere – No WiFi needed—perfect for travel or relaxing offline.
• Track Your Progress – Detailed stats help you improve over time.
• Hints & Undo (Unlimited) – Get a nudge or redo a move whenever you like.
• Regular New Content – Fresh updates keep your experience exciting.
Designed for ease, built for enjoyment. Whether you're looking to pass the time, keep your mind active, or simply unwind with a trusted classic, Solitaire Puzzle Card Games offers the ideal escape.
Download now and start your journey to relaxation and sharper thinking—all for free!

In Indian Truck Drive Lorry Games, you step into the role of a real cargo truck driver. This truck game takes you across mountain roads where every journey feels different. It’s about handling heavy lorries, keeping control on tricky turns, and enjoying the sights of Indian roads along the way.

bluejetty:00081930:ios.description:
This simple yet strategic challenge involves finding three exactly matching products and tapping them to move to a collection area below, where they're then eliminated, freeing up space for new items.
As you progress, you'll face shelves stocked with an array of diverse products, each level offering its unique puzzle. This not only tests your quick identification skills but also your ability to think strategically about your moves. Clearing the shelves advances you to the next level and brings the satisfaction of mastering the game's strategic elements.With each level, "Goods Blast 3D" presents more complex arrangements of products, requiring greater foresight and planning. 
The thrill of the game comes from this blend of casual gameplay and strategic depth, making completing each level a rewarding experience. As you advance, each cleared level stands as a testament to your quick-thinking and strategic planning skills, providing a sense of achievement and fun that keeps you coming back for more.

bluejetty:00143532:ios.name: Cabify
bluejetty:00143532:ios.summary: Whether you want to move around the city in a cab, order private car rides or send your things from one area of the city to the other, Cabify is your transportation and mobility app. And without giving up the most important thing: the safet
bluejetty:00143532:ios.description:
Whether you want to move around the city in a cab, order private car rides or send your things from one area of the city to the other, Cabify is your transportation and mobility app. And without giving up the most important thing: the safety and quality of your trips.
Cabify, the safe transportation option for your trips. Reach your destination in a premium cab or private car.
How does Cabify work?
1. Reserve or request your car or taxi ride. Indicate in the app where you are located. Select your destination, as well as the type of transportation you want to use: Cabify, cab or delivery.
2. Confirm your request to order a trip and that's it! We will provide you with the details of the car or taxi and the driver, either for a trip or for a delivery.
3. Always know the estimated price before traveling. We will tell you how much you will pay for your car or cab ride. In addition, you can select the payment method that best suits you: debit card, credit card or cash.
4. Share your journey. Send the details of your trip to family and friends so that they know where you are at all times and make you feel even safer.
In addition, you will always move with maximum safety measures.
What are the advantages of traveling with Cabify?
- The safety of your trips is our priority. All trips are geolocated and can be shared immediately with any family member or friend. They will be able to see which taxi or car you are in, which driver you are with, and even where you are in your trip.
- A very easy to use app. You will be faster than Usain Bolt ordering a cab ride or making a delivery.
- Delivery. We don't just move you, we move your stuff too. Our drivers will take what you want from one place to another in their cars or motorcycles. It couldn't be easier!
- More options for you. Because we know you don't always travel the same way, we have free cars and cabs for every occasion. Cabify for your day-to-day trips, Taxi to get there as soon as possible, or Delivery to receive what you want.
- Carbon neutral trips. We offset all the CO2 emissions generated by your trips with Cabify. Choose a transportation option that thinks about the environment!
- The best drivers. At Cabify we have the most selective criteria when it comes to accepting car or cab drivers.
- No surprises. We show the price before you request a trip. This way you can travel with the peace of mind of knowing how much you are going to pay.
- 100% customization. You decide how to move. Choose from the payment method that best suits you to what beat you want to play on your radio.
- For everyone. Cabify's app is accessible for people with sight impairments, and we have accessibility settings for people with disabilities.
Where is Cabify available?
Cabify is now available in 7 countries so you can get around by car or cab. Order your taxi driver in cities like Bogota, Lima, Madrid or Buenos Aires and start enjoying more transportation options with the leading taxi app: car rides, motorcycle deliveries, airport cabs, and more. Get to know in detail all the services available in each city at cabify.com.
Want to use Cabify for drivers and become a taxi driver?
If you're passionate about helping others discover your city, find out more at cabify.com or download the Cabify Driver app.
Looking for corporate transportation for your company?
Offer the best transportation app to your employees. Open a corporate account to have a large fleet of cars and cabs available for your company's trips and deliveries. In addition, our management platform will allow you to have greater control of expenses.
Download Cabify, your car or taxi transportation app and move or send whatever you want around your city.

bluejetty:00132417:ios.name: Measure Map Pro
bluejetty:00132417:ios.summary: Measure Map Pro lets you quickly and easily measure multiple distances, perimeters and areas with laser sharp precision!. Use it for small areas or large, then share with coworkers. Click “...More” to learn why you should download this App
bluejetty:00132417:ios.description:
Measure Map Pro lets you quickly and easily measure multiple distances, perimeters and areas with laser sharp precision!. Use it for small areas or large, then share with coworkers. Click “...More” to learn why you should download this App today! 
Calculate surface areas, buildings, plots, floors, forest areas or dimensions for fencing, sports tours, trips or anything you need for field work without having to go to the spot to take measurements. Only one finger to calculate with astonishing accuracy all these measurements over satellite images.
That’s what Measure Map Pro is for, to put a powerful, portable measuring tool right in the palm of your hand. Your iPhone, iPod touch or iPad can now provide you with totally precise measurements of any distance, from as small as one tenth of a meter to as big as thousands of kilometers or miles, even taking the curvature of the earth’s surface into account when measuring. It does all that, fast and effortlessly. 
Just one "magic" button for all the operations to easily place points without loosing it's professional accuracy. 
Some impressive features you get in Measure Map Pro (some of them via in-app purchase): 
* Autosave
* Attractive, smooth, easy navigation and use 
* For iPhone and iPad 
* Apple or G00GLE Maps with extra zoom level.
* Displays Maps View: Map, Satellite, Hybrid and Terrain.
* Undo and redo operations as needed 
* AirPrint and iCloud support
* More maps with extra zoom level through in-app purchase: Bing, Here, and ArcGIS. And Open Street, Open Cycle, World Street and more in the future
* Operations: Add, delete intermediate pins, insert between pins, move pins, get info.
* Circles and rectangles 
* Multiple areas and routes on screen
* Display of altitude above sea level, azimuth and angle
* Calculates azimuth or bearing
* Search for current location, text (villages, places of interest, etc.)
* Length units: meters, kilometers, feet, yards, miles, nautical miles, ken, ri, bù, lǐ
* Surface units: square meters and kilometers, ares, hectares, square foot, square yards, square miles, acres, fanegas (Valencian, Castilian or Colombian), tsubo, bu, so, lí, mǔ 
* Intermediate distances between pins can be displayed 
* Attach pictures to points
* Ability to select color and thickness of the perimeter line. 
* Ability to select the color and transparency of the selected area. 
* Working format: Measure Map, KMZ, KML (G00GLE Earth), CSV (Excel), Autocad (DXF), Shape (SHP), GPX, Image (PNG) and PDF 
* Export and import of surfaces and routes via e-mail, iTunes, AirDrop and Dropbox. 
* Save to photo album 
* Download surfaces and routes from the Internet. 
* Calculates multiple areas and routes simultaneously
* Ability to create inner polygons as "holes".
* Drawing of shapes: circle and rectangle.
* More maps with extra zoom level through in-app purchase
* Calculates azimuth or bearing 
* Attach pictures to points
* Displays altitude above sea level, azimuth and angle.
* Imports KML, KMZ and GPX format files besides exporting them.
* Track mode: drops pins on current GPS position at regular intervals.

bluejetty:00084247:ios.summary: Create unique invitations and bring people together for life’s most exciting moments. Customize your invitation with one of your own photos, or pick from the background gallery to bring your event to life. Cohost with friends, keep guests i
bluejetty:00084247:ios.description:
Create unique invitations and bring people together for life’s most exciting moments. Customize your invitation with one of your own photos, or pick from the background gallery to bring your event to life. Cohost with friends, keep guests in the loop, and capture every memory in a Shared Album. Whether you’re hosting or attending, Apple Invites makes it easy to get the party started.
Create beautiful invitations:
• Choose a background from a curated set of options or pick a photo from your own library to catch your guests’ attention.
• Customize the font of your invitation so it feels just right.
• Maps and Weather are automatically added so guests have all the details.
• Add a Link tile to share anything relevant to your event, like a registry, potluck sign-up sheet, inspo board, collaborative document, and more.
Plan and host together:
• Add cohosts so friends and family can join in on the fun, invite guests, and share updates.
• Sync events to Calendar automatically so you can easily keep track of what’s coming up.
• Post messages in the event to keep everyone up to date on last-minute details.
Invite and manage RSVPs:
• Invite others with just a link using any messaging platform.
• Guests can RSVP in the iPhone app or on the web from any device.
• Build anticipation with the countdown widget on your Home Screen.
Fuel the party with Music and relive it with Photos:
• Add a collaborative playlist so guests get to hear their favorite songs at the party.
• Include a Shared Album so everyone can add photos and relive all the best moments from the event.
Requirements:
• Apple Invites is available for all iPhone models running iOS 18 or later.
• Ability to collaborate with Apple Music Playlists requires an Apple Music subscription.
• Anyone can reply to invitations. Creation of invitations requires an iCloud+ subscription.

You need not worry which Bank you have your account with. Just download “BHIM SBI Pay” & start using it.
You just need to ensure that:
• Your mobile number has been linked to your Bank accounts
• You have a Debit card linked to your account
BHIM SBI Pay allows you to make easy, instant & secure payments at your convenience on all 365 days of the year
With BHIM SBI Pay you can also do recharges, order food, pay utility bills & buy local deals.
Recharge: Prepaid, Postpaid & DTH
• Track all your recharges at one place
• Get reminders for postpaid bills
Food: Order Food from your Favourite Restaurants
• Compare & Use Swiggy, Freshmenu, Faasos, Behrouz Biryani at one place
• Browse menu, add food items to cart, pay from your account & get food delivered
Bill Payments: Hassle free payment of Electricity, Gas, Broadband, Landline & Water Bills
• Fetch your bill using your customer id or unique identification number of bill
• Get Reminder for utility bills
• Pay for 70+ popular bills
Local Deals: Explore all local deals at one place
• Notification of latest deals
• Get discounts on Buffets, Spa & salons, weekend activities & more
Transaction Limits on BHIM SBI Pay:
• Max. limit per transaction: Rs.1,00,000/-
• Max. transaction limit per day is Rs.1,00,000/-
If you are a Merchant: Login to the app, Click on ‘I am a Merchant’ option, fill-up your business details & you are ready to collect payments from your customers.
Toggle between Consumer & Merchant modes:
• With BHIM SBI Pay, you can collect payments as a Merchant or make payments as a Consumer by simply using the toggle switch from the Menu icon at the top left
Pay/Send money using:
• VPA of the beneficiary
• Account Number + IFSC of the beneficiary
• Scanning QR Code of the beneficiary
Steps to Send Money:
• Login to the App & Click on Pay
• Select Debit Account, Payee Address type (VPA or Account and IFSC)
• Enter other required details
• Enter UPIN
• Click Submit
Steps to Receive/Collect Money:
• Login to the App & Click on Collect 
• Enter Payer VPA
• Enter other required details
• Click Submit
Transaction History:
• View your latest 20 transactions & transactions done for a range of dates
Manage multiple bank accounts: 
• Select My Accounts option from Menu, select your bank & simply add it
• If you have only one Bank account, that will be your Default account to make & receive payments on BHIM SBI Pay
• In case you have multiple accounts, you can select any 1 of them as your Default account, by clicking on “Set as Default” option against the account
• During the ‘Pay’ transaction, select any debit account by swiping through the accounts displayed on the Home screen
Create and Manage Multiple VPAs:
• To add a VPA, go to the Menu at the top right of your app screen, click on View Profile.
• Select Add a New VPA and create your new handle, for e.g. mobileno@sbi
• Select the account to link to the new VPA
• Multiple VPAs can be used for different accounts or one VPA can be linked to different accounts
Steps to Reset PIN:
• In case you forget the App PIN, choose ‘Forgot App PIN’ option on the login screen, answer the secret question to reset the App PIN
• In case you forget the UPIN of Account, reset it by clicking on ‘Reset UPI PIN’ against that account
Complaints/Dispute management: 
Dispute can be raised only for successful transactions.
• Login to the App
• Click on View All in Recent Transactions
• Select the transaction and Click Raise Dispute button
• Select Dispute type, enter Remark.
• Click Submit
For other queries/complaints related to BHIM SBI Pay, please write to support.upi@sbi.co.in

Obilet — Flight, Bus & Train Tickets: Integrated Mobility Solution
Obilet brings your flight, bus, and train bookings into one easy-to-use app, making travel planning quick and simple. Instantly search, compare, and purchase tickets for domestic routes and a wide range of international destinations. Obilet is your integrated mobility solution, ideal for both quick local trips and corporate travel management. Choose the best option and complete your purchase with a single click using your credit or debit card. Enjoy a seamless, fast, and secure travel experience.
24/7 Customer Support — Continuous Operational Assistance
Our dedicated Customer Service team is available around the clock, 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, to provide you with technical and operational support. Chat live in the app for instant answers or call our contact center to speak with a representative. We are here to assist with all inquiries regarding bookings, tickets, or cancellations, ensuring efficient communication and rapid solutions.
Fast and Secure Payments — Confidence in Every Transaction
Buy tickets quickly and securely right from your mobile device. All transactions use advanced security and encryption protocols to protect your data. With your security assured, you can focus on planning your next trip.
Comfortable and Flexible Travel
Choose your destination and travel dates with full flexibility, tailoring your trip to your needs. Obilet offers options for business travel requiring punctuality and efficiency as well as for personal trips needing adaptability.
Change and Cancellation Management
Operational flexibility is essential. We help you manage your bus, flight, or train tickets in line with each carrier’s cancellation and change policies. Our team guides you to get the best possible outcome.
Travel Recommendations and Experiences
Discover new cities, popular routes, and travel insights along with great deals. Obilet streamlines route logistics and upholds high standards of comfort and safety throughout your journey.
Download the Obilet app now and start planning your next trip with ease and confidence.

bluejetty:00026652:ios.description:
Yahoo News: News that gets you. That means unlimited access to the stories and topics that matter most to you. Whether you prefer listening to audio, watching videos or reading articles, we aggregate news from a broad spectrum of premium publishers, so you can keep up with your world through a feed personalized to your interests and preferences. Never miss out on breaking world or national news updates, plus read about entertainment, lifestyle and more.
Yahoo News has been bringing readers the latest headlines and hottest trends from trusted sources for over 20 years. Join the millions of people who get personalized news updates from Yahoo News, and access the following benefits.
Yahoo News Features: 
PERSONALIZATION: Keep up with the news you care about through a personalized feed that adapts to your interests, while helping you stay informed with the most important breaking headlines. Instantly access the stories, topics and publishers that matter most to you, and adjust your preferences at any time to improve your feed and notifications. Block any keywords or specific publishers you don’t want to hear from, and make your news feed uniquely yours. 
PREMIUM NEWS SOURCES: Yahoo News aggregates content from the best global publishers — from CNN and Time to Business Insider, People and Esquire — so you can feel confident that you have access to the best, and most comprehensive news providers out there. Get perspectives from a broad range of publishers, and opt into updates from your favorites.
UNLIMITED ACCESS: Access unlimited stories from premium publishers, so you can always stay on top of the topics you care about.
TRENDING VIDEOS: Whether you’re looking for can’t-miss shorts or trending video journalism, we aggregate only the highest quality videos, so you can watch and scroll without the noise. 
MORNING AUDIO DIGESTS: Listen to the Morning Briefing, an AI-generated audio digest that allows you to learn about the day’s most important headlines while you read, get ready, commute or multitask. 
BREAKING NEWS FROM AROUND THE WORLD: Get global breaking news headlines that matter to you, wherever you are. Yahoo News partners with international news organizations like Associated Press, Reuters and The Washington Post, that report on the biggest world stories and current events. You’ll never miss a beat.
REGIONAL NEWS: We’ve partnered with an array of regional publishers like the Miami Herald, Charlotte Observer, NY Post and more, so you can stay on top of politics, news, weather updates and other important events across America.
DIVERSE RANGE OF TOPICS: Yahoo News is proud to aggregate content from a vast range of publishers. In addition to our proprietary Yahoo coverage of News, Entertainment and Lifestyle content, you will also get access to the other topics you love like: celebrity, sports, movies & television, music, technology, health & wellness, parenting, style & beauty, travel, home & garden, autos, shopping, horoscope, science, weather and more.
QUICK AI TAKEAWAYS: AI-generated, scannable, bulleted takeaways for articles make it easy to get the most important elements of a story in an instant. Harnessing the power of AI, users can quickly browse the key points of stories and stay in the know.

bluejetty:00082432:ios.summary: Al-Sahifa al-Sajjadiyya al-Kamila contains a collection of supplications of Imam Ali ibn al-Husayn Zayn al-Abidin. In fact, it is a rich treasure trove of divine knowledge, encompassing fifty-four supplications. Many scholars and true mysti
bluejetty:00082432:ios.description:
Al-Sahifa al-Sajjadiyya al-Kamila contains a collection of supplications of Imam Ali ibn al-Husayn Zayn al-Abidin. In fact, it is a rich treasure trove of divine knowledge, encompassing fifty-four supplications. Many scholars and true mystics have paid great attention to this book, even calling it "the Psalms of the Household of Muhammad" in their words and discussions.Introducing the al-Sahifa al-Sajjadiyya al-Kamila Application for Mobile Phones
In addition to the complete text of al-Sahifa al-Sajjadiyya al-Kamila, this version provides various translations and commentaries on the supplications. It also offers other features for users, such as content search, a thematic index, a linguistic dictionary, and audio recitations of the supplications.All the application's content is displayed online, but users can access the text of the supplications, translations, two commentaries, and the linguistic dictionary offline after downloading them. Additionally, the audio recitations of the supplications can be played offline after downloading.
Application Content
The different sections of the al-Sahifa al-Sajjadiyya al-Kamila application are:
Complete Text of al-Sahifa al-Sajjadiyya al-Kamila: Includes fifty-four supplications with translations and audio recitations.
Translations and Commentaries: Includes translations of the supplications into Persian and English, as well as commentaries in Persian and Arabic.
Thematic Index: A thematic index of al-Sahifa al-Sajjadiyya al-Kamilain both Arabic and Persian.
Linguistic Dictionary: Provides translations of the words in the supplications at the end of each section.
Search: In addition to the thematic index and the text of the supplications, which can be searched by title and content, there is also a search feature available for the translations and commentaries sections.

bluejetty:00140499:ios.description:
Welcome to Mahjong Triple Club: Are you ready to challenge your mind and embark on a thrilling majong puzzle journey? Install now for free!
The ultimate real tile-matching game where classic mahjong gameplay meets modern puzzle excitement! Whether you're a seasoned mah-jong player or new to the world of matching games, this game offers endless fun, strategy, and relaxation for players of all skill levels.
With over 10,000+ mohjong levels, each puzzle introduces new challenges, beautiful landscapes, and unique tile sets that will keep you coming back for more. Match majong tiles, unlock new locations, and uncover the mysteries of the ancient mah-jong dynasty as you progress through a captivating adventure.
- Immerse yourself in a world of vibrant, carefully designed majong tiles that offer a delightful mix of classic and modern elements that sharpen your memory and test your strategy puzzle skills.
- With thousands of levels ranging from easy to advanced, there’s something for everyone. Use powerful boosters to overcome the toughest challenges and keep your puzzle game momentum going.
- Join a global community of mahjong players! Team up in clubs, chat with friends, and help each other solve difficult majhong puzzles. Compete in tournaments to show off your tile-matching skills and climb the leaderboards in your quest to become the tile master.
- Travel through diverse landscapes, unlocking new backgrounds and environments with each new location. Every location adds a fresh twist to the mojang gameplay, making every tile match a journey.
- No Wi-Fi Needed! Play offline whenever you want and enjoy the game on the go. Whether you're looking for a quick break or a deep puzzle session, Triple Mahjong Club delivers an engaging experience without needing an internet connection.
- The puzzle game is perfect for both casual players and those seeking a mahjong-for-seniors experience. Relax and enjoy at your own pace.
- Match 3 tiles, clear the board, and dive into a relaxing yet strategic monjong adventure. This game provides a perfect balance between brain-training puzzle games and calming visuals, making it an ideal choice for fans of matching games for adults.
Download now and start your mahjong journey across countless levels, unlocking new challenges and becoming the ultimate puzzle games master!

bluejetty:00179084:ios.name: Labbet: Photo & Video Editing
bluejetty:00179084:ios.summary:
10M+ EXPORTED PHOTOS & VIDEOS.
Labbet is a creative lab for film‑inspired, beautifully nostalgic images. Rated 4.8 from thousands of reviews and trusted by a community that has exported over 10 million photos, it's a photo and video editing
bluejetty:00179084:ios.description:
10M+ EXPORTED PHOTOS & VIDEOS.
Labbet is a creative lab for film‑inspired, beautifully nostalgic images. Rated 4.8 from thousands of reviews and trusted by a community that has exported over 10 million photos, it's a photo and video editing app for creators with an analog soul who value texture, mood, grain, and honest expression over glossy perfection.
WHAT LABBET DOES
Labbet combines simple, precise tools with film‑inspired looks, grain, dust, and borders so you can create timeless visuals fast — in photo and video. Effects like authentic textures, glow, motion blur, and soft vignettes give your work a tactile, film‑like presence that stands apart from standard mobile edits.
FILM‑INSPIRED TOOLS
Shape light, color, and depth with clean, focused editing controls that keep you in your creative flow — whether you're working on a still or a moving image.
ANALOG FILM FILTERS AND VINTAGE EFFECTS
Film‑style filters and vintage color tones for retro, nostalgic, and analog‑inspired photos and video – from soft, faded palettes to rich, contrasty film looks.
AUTHENTIC GRAIN, DUST & TEXTURES
Realistic film grain, dust, scratches, paper textures, and light leaks add depth and tactility so your work feels like physical prints and projected film, not flat digital files.
FILM‑REAL BORDERS AND FRAMES
Analog borders inspired by film edges, contact sheets, and vintage prints that frame your stories and give each image a finished, archival feel.
VIDEO EDITING WITH AN ANALOG SOUL
Bring the full Labbet treatment to motion. Apply your favorite looks, layer grain and textures, shape color with the same precision as on stills, and export clips that feel hand‑made rather than algorithm‑smoothed.
ARTISTIC TEXT TOOL
Minimal, refined typography and unique text overlays that blend into your image, ideal for visual storytelling, covers, posters, and brand‑driven layouts.
CORE PHOTO AND VIDEO TOOLS AND PRESETS
Fine‑tune exposure, contrast, color, and detail, or start with one‑click film presets. Save your favorite combinations of filters, textures, and effects so your analog style stays consistent across photo and video.
WHO LABBET IS FOR
Labbet is designed for creatives with a point of view - drawn to filmic tones, analog textures, and images that feel lived in. A space where your aesthetic instincts are respected and refined.
We believe images and video should feel like something, not just look like something. The most memorable work carries the marks of real film: a hint of noise, a strange color shift, a light leak that somehow tells the truth. Labbet exists to make that kind of creative risk simple, fast, and deeply enjoyable.
HOW WE ARE DIFFERENT
Where many editors chase flawless, glossy surfaces, Labbet is built around beautifully vintage, analog‑first editing. Our tools are opinionated yet easy to use: serious control without desktop‑software overwhelm. We focus on how highlights roll off, how grain sits in a shadow, how a moving image breathes – so you stay in your creative flow.
LABBET+
With Labbet+ you unlock all film‑inspired filters, textures, borders, tools, and effects across photo and video. Labbet+ is available as a Yearly plan (subscription) or Lifetime (one‑time purchase).
Prices vary depending on the country. Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless auto‑renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period. Subscriptions may be managed by you and auto‑renewal can be turned off in Account Settings after purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, is forfeited when you purchase a subscription.
Privacy Policy: https://labbet.app/privacy/
Terms of Use: https://labbet.app/terms/

bluejetty:00164993:ios.description:
Journi is the easiest way to capture your life as beautiful timelines with photos, notes, maps and more. Turn them into printed photo books in seconds & easily define which photos are private! Use it offline, create timelines together & sync across all your devices! Make more out of your photos and remember all your life moments with Journi now! It's free.
----------------------------------------------
What others say about Journi:
• "Makes travel blogging a pleasure" - Condé Nast Traveler
• "Best new app, hot apps, apps we love" - Apple
• "The best, I can use it offline." - L.A. Times
----------------------------------------------
◆ Your Advantages ◆ 
▸ Turn your travel adventures into beautiful stories with photos, text, maps, stamps, weather, flights and more.
▸ Order your unique photo book with one click.
▸ Decide who can see your stories: Just for you, Secret, Only on request or Public.
▸ Use Journi offline, without Internet.
▸ Create stories together with friends and have all moments captured in one place.
▸ Upload multiple photos at once and let Journi build your story automatically. No matter if it's photos from a past or current adventure, Journi will group them smartly by time and location data.
▸ Save your photos for free in full size and high resolution
▸ Invite friends to follow or share your journi via iMessage, WhatsApp, Facebook, Email, etc.
▸ Explore and search other stories from around the world and get inspired. 
▸ Find and navigate to moments using the timeline or the overview map.
▸ Back-up your journis to Dropbox and Google Drive.
▸ Journi is optimized for long battery life.
We constantly improve and update the app.
*** MORE ABOUT PREMIUM MEMBERSHIP & PHOTO BOOK***
Get full access to all Journi features by becoming a premium member. Additionally to all the free features this includes the option to save your journis to the cloud, add weather and flight information to your timeline & get access to all 600 stickers. If you choose the yearly membership get 10% off all your photo book orders. 
Choose from 3 Premium Membership plans:
- 1 month for €9.99

Pricing in other countries may vary and actual charges may be converted to local currency. Your subscription will be renewed automatically at the end of each term unless cancelled 24 hours prior to the end of the subscription period. You can manage, upgrade, downgrade and cancel it in Account Settings in iTunes.
Photo books start at €22.99 incl. worldwide shipping. Our books are made in the Alps out of environmental friendly paper that is FSC certified. 
Your photo books are personalized products that are made just for you. Hence they are not replaceable, not returnable and can not be refunded. Please make always sure to carefully check the preview of your book before you place your order. Production and shipping times are between 3-7 days within the EU, 5-10 days for USA and Canada and for all other countries 10-16 days. We are already working on decreasing both delivery times and our CO2 footprint.

bluejetty:00156779:ios.description:
"Seek the place within from which all life springs" -Rumi
Heart Rhythm Meditation combines breathwork with a focus on the physical heart and its heartbeat. This method is a simple and deep way to understand and affect your inner landscape while improving your health and well-being.
Welcome to the first step of relating to your heart. We’re glad you’re here!
-----------------------------------------------
Discover a diverse set of heart rhythm practices which deepen your experience beyond sensation and mindfulness.
You’ll love starting your day with a moment of reflection. When you enter your intention into the app, you’ll receive a suggested guided meditation.
Flexible to what you need: While some meditations stand alone as Guided Singles, others are sequenced into Guided Journeys.
Each meditation teacher offers their unique perspective. You can listen to your favorite teachers over and over.
-----------------------------------------------
DOWNLOAD TO ACCESS THESE FEATURES:
**TOOLS TO SUPPORT YOU**
Sense your pulse with the iPhone camera! With this technology, you can:
• Use visual animations to learn how to synchronize your breath and heartbeat.
