bluejetty:00121910:ios.description:
Radio FM – Live Radio, FM Stations & Podcasts
Listen to your favourite radio stations, discover new music and stay up to date with news, sports and podcasts—all in one simple app. Explore more than 55,000 stations and 4.2M podcasts from Germany and around the world, with an easy to use radio player designed for everyday listening. 
Trusted by more than 100 million listeners worldwide, Radio FM makes it easy to find local radio stations, international broadcasts and your favorite programs wherever you are.
LIVE RADIO & MUSIC
Enjoy live radio stations for every mood and moment. Listen to pop, rock, country, jazz, classical, hip-hop, R&B, electronic, dance, reggae, gospel, oldies, retro, instrumental music and more.
Discover music radio from the United States and around the world, find new stations and listen to your favorite music anytime.
Explore more than 55,000 live radio stations from thousands of cities and countries.
Search by station, country, location, genre or language to quickly find the radio you want to hear.
LOCAL RADIO AT YOUR FINGERTIPS
Looking for a local radio station? Select a location on the map and discover stations available in that area. Find your hometown station or explore radio from cities and countries around the world.
NEWS & TALK RADIO
Stay informed with live news radio, breaking news, talk radio, interviews and current affairs programs. Listen to news and discussion programs from local and international stations while commuting, working or relaxing.
SPORTS RADIO
Follow your favorite sports with live sports radio, sports news, football radio, baseball, basketball, hockey, tennis and more.
Listen to sports commentary, match updates, expert analysis, interviews and sports talk from radio stations around the world.
Over 4.2M PODCASTS
Explore more than 4M podcasts covering news, business, technology, sports, comedy, education, entertainment, history, culture, motivation and personal development.
Discover new shows and listen to podcasts that match your interests, alongside your favorite radio stations.
POWERFUL RADIO PLAYER
Radio FM is designed to make listening simple:
• Play live radio with one tap
• Search for radio stations and podcasts
• Save stations to Favorites
• Quickly access recently played stations
• Browse stations by country, genre and language
• Find stations with the radio tuner
• Equalizer to customize your listening experience
• Car Mode for safer, easier listening while driving
• Caste Screen & Widget Feature
• Continue listening with background playback
• View currently playing information
• Control playback from your device
• Share what you are listening to
SLEEP TIMER & ALARM
Fall asleep while listening to your favorite music radio, talk radio or podcast with the Sleep Timer. Set the timer and playback automatically stops at the time you choose.
Use the Alarm Clock to wake up with your favorite radio station and start your morning with music, news or talk radio.
LISTEN WHILE YOU DRIVE
Enjoy radio and podcasts while driving with supported in-car features, including Apple CarPlay. Quickly access your favorite stations and keep listening while on the road.
WHY CHOOSE RADIO FM?
 Live FM and AM radio
 Internet and online radio
 Local radio station discovery
 Music, news, sports and talk radio
 Radio tuner and powerful search
 Favorites and recently played stations
 Sleep Timer and Alarm Clock
 Background playback
 Apple CarPlay support
 Simple and convenient radio player
Can't find a station you want? Use Suggest a Station to request a radio station you'd like to see added to the catalog.
An internet or Wi-Fi connection is required for live radio and podcast streaming.
For any suggestions or queries in the app you can write to us on support@appradiofm.com 
Keep listening with Radio FM.

bluejetty:00087451:ios.summary: Your mission, should you choose to accept it, is to break into the most heavily guarded safe vault in the world, bypassing lethal security systems and hundreds of armed guards, in order to steal the key to saving the world. You are a secret
bluejetty:00087451:ios.description:
Your mission, should you choose to accept it, is to break into the most heavily guarded safe vault in the world, bypassing lethal security systems and hundreds of armed guards, in order to steal the key to saving the world. You are a secret agent known only as the Dodge Agent, a master of evasive acrobatics, stealth, and infiltration. You can bypass any security system in the world. You can evade entire armies of armed security guards. But can you been the special agent who saves the world?
Who needs lock picking? Why unlock a gate when you can scale the wall? Why disarm the laser security when you can dive past the lasers faster than the eye can see? You don't need any equipment except you amazing ninja skills and lighting fast reflexes. Keep to the shadows and sprint to your goal, this is a fast passed action game and you better be ready to keep up!
Features:
Swipe to Dodge! Sprint through high tech laser security fields, swipe to jump and dive past the lasers to reach your goal!
Lethal Obstacles! Those lasers will slice you down into little pieces if you're not careful, watch out!
Challenging Gameplay! Easy to pick up, harder to master. You need cat like reflexes to be the best secret agent in the world, do you have what it takes?
Explore the World! Your targets are scattered all over the world, each stealth mission will take you to a new location with new obstacles and enemies. 
Dozens of Secret Agents to play as! Pirouette around the guards as the ballerina. Sling through the lasers with Spidey's string shooters. Go unseen and unheard as the Cat Burglar, master of stealth and shadow. Can you unlock them all?
Amazing Graphics! Experience the Dodge Agent vaulting over glittering laser beams in the best HD graphic quality!
Visit https://lionstudios.cc/contact-us/ if have any feedback, need help on beating a level or have any awesome ideas you would like to see in the game!

bluejetty:00132383:ios.description:
My Baby Heart Sounds is a quick and easy way to use your iPhone to listen, record and share your baby's heart sounds.
Not too long ago, we were pregnant mothers too. While our partners enjoyed listening to our babies' sounds by placing their ears on the tummy, we wanted to capture and share these precious audio-memories ourselves. We tried voice memo apps and other sound-recording apps but felt that there was something more we could do to improve the quality of the sound in a simple setup. Fast forward a couple years and here we are!
Why should you try this app?
- Minimum time to setup. All you need is your iPhone. Simple instructions are provided within the app and we are here to support you all the way.
- High quality sound. Using advanced audio signal processing techniques, we deliver a high quality audio experience that allows you to distinguish your baby's heart sounds. For best results use AirPods.
- Listen for free and only pay when you want to record and share.
- Secure. All recordings are stored on your phone. We do not have any access to your recordings. You decide how you would like to share your recordings.
- Track your pregnancy journey. Get weekly insights on pregnancy symptoms, learn how to read ultrasound scans, monitor contractions, and keep track of your baby’s movements with a kick counter.
For best results:
- Use the app when you are 20-30 weeks or greater pregnant.
- Use the app in a quiet room
- Remove any phone case/shell/cover (the iPhone needs to touch your skin to be able to pick up the sounds)
- Put the phone in Airplane Mode
- Start the app and place the iPhone on your tummy to listen for a clear sound. You may need to try a few different spots. Press "Record" to create a recording
- Use AirPods
My Baby Heart Sounds Disclaimer:
- The My Baby Heart Sounds app is NOT a Medical Device or application. It is NOT in any way suitable for medical opinion, advice or diagnosis, and it is NOT intended to provide any information about the person of use's wellbeing or health.
- The app does NOT backup recordings automatically outside the user's device. It is the user's responsibility to regularly backup their recordings.
Subscribe to access to premium app features; subscription details are the following:
- Length: weekly, yearly
- Your payment will be charged to your iTunes Account as soon as you confirm your purchase
- You can manage your subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal from your Account Settings after the purchase
- Your subscription will renew automatically, unless you turn off auto-renew at least 24 hours before the end of the current period
- The cost of renewal will be charged to your account in the 24 hours prior to the end of the current period
- When canceling a subscription, your subscription will stay active until the end of the period. Auto-renewal will be disabled, but the current subscription will not be refunded
- Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when purchasing a subscription

bluejetty:00120884:ios.description:
About Backgammon Board Game
Backgammon is the ultimate king lord of dice games! A challenging and addicting game with millions of fans all over the world!
Backgammon Basics and Rules / How to Play
Each player has a piece set of Backgammon checkers. In front of him/her is the home board where he/she should bear off while the side across is the starting point. This means the opponents starting point is exactly on the opposite side. The objective is to remove all of one's own checkers from the board before one's opponent does. When a player leaves a checker single, the opponent has the option to make a blot, plus leave the checker temporarily out of game. Once the player has moved all his fifteen checkers into his/her home board, might commence “bearing off”.
Hints: If during a game a player has not been able to bear off neither of his checkers, the other player scores a gammon, a double victory, which counts twice a normal win (doubling).
Backgammon Arena offers 6 live Game Modes (different rooms and themes) according to your progress. Start your unlocking journey, enjoy the trip with unlimited games!
1. Newbies (learn the tricks at level 1)
2. Amateurs (rush for the win at level 2)
3. Professionals (pro race unlocked at level 4)
4. Experts (high stakes matches unlocked at level 6)
5. Super VIP Players (unlocked by superiors at level 8)
6. Gods! (unlocked by the unbeatables at level 10)
Backgammon Arena is multiplayer and can be highly competitive among elite dice gurus. Luck is needed but long practice is Gold! Test your skills and strategy, win one match after the other, have fun with buddies, level up, enjoy prestigious trophies, earn amazing prizes and become the master of the best and most popular dice game!
Get in this premium club! Join the worldwide community of Backgammon champions!
Backgammon Arena Features
• Compete with REAL players: no robots / no artificial intelligence opponents.
• FAIR dice roll and PLAYING: Backgammon Arena uses a "cryptographically secure" random number generator, implemented by the OpenSSL library, for all random aspects of the game. This is a state of the art RNG that is guaranteed to generate uncorrelated and unpredictable values.
• Quality, hd graphics in each mode.
Deluxe royale backgammon version with:
• Daily coins BONUS: instant win.
• Global TOURNAMENTS for elite players.
• Different bet, earnings and settings: In each new Game Mode, you have the chance to win more Points and Chips for each victory while game completion can be achieved either on one or on three wins as you elevate across modes. More over quick decisions are needed while the time to play each one's turn, is reduced, as you progress.
• In-game CHAT with your oppenents (Online feature).
• "Play with a FRIEND" option: invite your chums to an extreme buddy challenge!
• Fireworks effects to celebrate a match win!
• Daily, weekly and monthly Leaderboards and CHARTS for TOP players
• "Share the fun" feature by sending GIFTS (special items) to your friends even when they are offline.
The game is popular in certain countries like Egypt, Greece, India, Turkey etc. Apart from the classic game, many variants exist, known with alternative names around the globe such as Tavli or Tavle, Tawla or Tavla, Tapa, Tabula (table for Romans), Gamao, Narde or Nardi, Nackgammon, Hypergammon, Gammon, Acey Deucey, Shesh Besh, Portes, Plakoto, Fevga, Mahbusa, Gul Bara. Backgammon is oftened considered a type or parlour games or part of social casino style games.

bluejetty:00134870:ios.description:
Magic Packet is an app for remote computer management over local network and the Internet. Wake, shut down, restart, and monitor your computers from iPhone, Apple Watch, widgets, and Siri.
USE CASES:
- Wake your home NAS before watching movies
- Connect to your home PC via RDP, VNC, or TeamViewer
- Prevent your computer from sleeping during downloads, streaming, or rendering
- Remotely reboot frozen PCs
- Shut down and restart computers over the Internet
WAKE ON LAN:
- Instant magic packet sending
- Works over local network and the Internet
- Custom UDP port for each host
- SecureON support
- Support for broadcast, IP addresses, and domain names
REMOTE MANAGEMENT:
- Shutdown, restart, sleep, hibernate, and lock
- Works through Magic Packet Server for Windows, macOS, and Linux
- Automatic server discovery in local network
STATUS AND MONITORING:
- Availability checks via ping or HTTP
- Online / offline status with auto refresh
- Laptop battery level monitoring
- Quick host status checks
SIRI, SHORTCUTS, AND WIDGETS:
- Siri voice commands
- Automations through Shortcuts
- Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets
- Control Center controls (iOS 18)
APPLE WATCH:
- Control hosts directly from Apple Watch
- Media and volume controls
- Complications for quick access
- iCloud sync
MEDIA:
- Play and pause
- Next and previous track
- Volume and mute controls
- “Keep Awake” mode with timer
HOST CUSTOMIZATION:
- Unlimited hosts
- Icons, SF Symbols, emoji, and letters
- Custom colors
- Custom action order
- iCloud sync
CONVENIENCE:
- Dark mode support
- Step-by-step Wake-on-LAN setup guides
- Optimized for iPhone and iPad

bluejetty:00200202:ios.name: Ahoy! From Picardy
bluejetty:00200202:ios.summary: "Ahoy! From Picardy" (Apple Design Award finalist) follows Picardy, an inventor desperately trying to revive the crumbling island left in his care. Picardy believes only the most sought-after mind in the world can fix it. His elaborate invi
bluejetty:00200202:ios.description:
"Ahoy! From Picardy" (Apple Design Award finalist) follows Picardy, an inventor desperately trying to revive the crumbling island left in his care. Picardy believes only the most sought-after mind in the world can fix it. His elaborate invitation to her—a vision of the future—will be sent only when it's perfect. And we all know perfect is better than done.
This is your invitation to join in and begin anew. Step into a world of possibilities where Picardy’s vibrant, hand-drawn “hologram visions” transform the dusty ground, painting a picture of an island brought back to life.
The story unfolds within a grand globe diorama that can be placed anywhere. Sit back and enjoy a cinematic escape, or step into the globe’s ring for an even more immersive experience and explore the tiniest details from any angle.
This project embraces groundbreaking techniques to celebrate the arrival of spatial storytelling—a world of light layered over our physical world. It combines hand-made physical models (3D-scanned into the digital space), hand-painted backdrops, and elegantly simplified characters with hand-painted textures—all creating a uniquely warm and approachable experience. 
Immersive, spatialized sound design with original music, surrounds guests in a rich sonic world. 
This chapter of Picardy’s story is only the beginning, serving as a first access point, an invitation to step into an expansive ocean awaiting discovery.
Format:
- English (spoken and written)
- Subtitles, English (iPhone & iPad only)
- Music-driven, linear narrative short film 
- Movable stage, viewable from any angle
- Custom haptic design for increased immersion (iPhone only)
- Subtle interactive elements
- Roughly 16 minutes

• Atmospheric visuals & soundtrack — moody scenes that pull you deep into the mystery.

• Fully optimized for iPad and iPad Pro — play on a big screen with stunning Ultra HD graphics and detail!
• Play completely offline — Desktop, Phone & Tablet support — anytime, anywhere
• No data collection — your privacy is safe

bluejetty:00077391:ios.description:
◆◆◆ Now Supports Video Recording! ◆◆◆
■ Capture the Look of Real Analog Film
Filmlike brings the rich colors, warmth, and texture of analog film to your photos. The 28 filters included across 7 filter sets combine beautifully with film effects to create deep, nostalgic images that feel just like real film photography. You can also explore new styles with our limited-time collaboration filters.
■ Choose from Three Modes to Match Any Situation - New
Enjoy applying filters to photos you take or import in Normal Mode. Or focus entirely on shooting with Auto Save Mode, which automatically saves photos with real-time filters applied.
And now, you can finally record videos with your favorite Filmlike filters!
■ Create an Even More Vintage Look with Filter Editing
In Normal Mode, you can fine-tune the intensity of both filters and film effects after applying them. Film effects combine grain and blur to recreate the look of aged film and nostalgic photography.
■ Date Stamps and Initial Stamps
Customize the date and format of your date stamp to make photos look like they were taken years ago. You can also personalize your photos with the newly added Initial Stamp feature. Both stamps are easy to configure and can be accessed directly from the filter screen.
■ Import Photos from Your Library
Apply Filmlike's filters to any photo in your library. You can now import photos directly from the filter screen for a faster editing experience.
■ Additional Features
* Manual Focus and Manual Exposure
* 3:4 / 1:1 / 2:3 Aspect Ratios
* Self Timer and Mirror Mode
* Silent Mode
* Favorite Filter Presets
* Metadata Preservation
* Classic Camera Skin Mode
* Simple and Intuitive Interface
■ 7 Filter Sets, 28 Filters
[C] - C1 / C2 / C3 / C4
[H] - H1 / H2 / H3 / H4
[K] - K1 / K2 / K3 / K4
[M] - M1 / M2 / M3 / M4
[A] - A1 / A2 / A3 / A4
[D] - D1 / D2 / D3 / D4
[Y] - Y1 / Y2 / Y3 / Y4
Tag your photos with #filmlike_me on Instagram!
Instagram: instagram.com/filmlike_me

bluejetty:00069748:ios.description:
MCB Live is the new flagship digital banking solution of MCB Bank that has been designed from the ground up to offer new and improved services to our customers, with a view to securely and conveniently conduct financial and non-financial transactions. MCB Live has a completely new user interface and an intuitive layout that will enable you to conduct digital banking transactions conveniently on the go or from wherever you may be. MCB Live is Fresh, its Fast, its Futuristic! 
- MCB Live comes with a new set of features, just a few of which are mentioned below:
- Bill Payment to 1,000+ Billers
- Swiftly Transfer Funds to any Bank via Quick Transfer
- Secure financial transactions through OTP
- Multiple Accounts Management 
- Cheque Book Request, Status inquiry and Stop Cheque Request
- Account Statement with details of up to 10 transactions
- e-Statement Subscription & Un-subscription
- Efficiently manage your MCB Debit and Credit Cards 
- Request for new/replacement Cards online 
- Activate your Cards for eCommerce, online & International use online
- Lodge a detailed Complaint quickly from within the app
- Conveniently Donate to leading NGOs and social causes 
- Download Withholding Tax Certificate
- Locate your nearest MCB ATM through the in-app ATM Locator
- & much, much more!
In order to take advantage of the new MCB Live experience, please manually uninstall your existing app and then download the new app from this App Store.
For any queries or concerns regarding MCB Live, please call 111-000-622 or send us an email at info@mcb.com.pk from your registered mobile number. 
Please note that MCB Bank will continue to provide technical support for MCB Mobile till the foreseen future.
Thank you for your patronage and support.

Entregar produtos de alta qualidade e exclusivos, não são mais apenas características, mas sim, parte do DNA da empresa.
Por isso, agora, inauguramos nosso e-commerce, para facilitar ainda mais o dia a dia de nossos clientes. Garantindo agilidade na entrega, com o atendimento personalizado que você merece e mantemos, como tradição.
Você já é parte da família, então vem conhecer nossa nova casa, digital.
Um grande abraço, De Angelina.

The Harvest Array App will conveniently allow you to shop our Online General Store, where we offer unique American Made products from small, family-owned businesses. We pride ourselves on providing you with everyday goods for your home and family.
App Launch
• Welcome screen with our logo and account setup/login.
Main Screen
• Products: View our everyday Made in America favorites and seasonal items.
• Screen layout: General store based on our familiar website and logo.
• Home screen: Top-selling products on the home page.
• Product Categories: Shop easy-to-find links to all our products.
• Promotional: Direct link to the Sales Flyer.
• Top Categories: Find our top three product categories.
• Discount: 10% discount on your first purchase. Exclusively on the app.
• Contact Us: Call us at 814-396-2151 for US Based Customer support.
• Recently Viewed: Select the items you viewed on the app.

• Online Chat: Communicate directly with our US-based customer support team.
• Shopping Cart: View your future purchases.
• Search: Find your Made in the USA products.

• Home Screen: Go back to the main page.
• Account: Login or set up your account.
• Wishlist: Create and access your Wishlist. Exclusively on the app.

• View all our American Made products in their natural categories and subcategories.
• Sort products by featured, best sellers, or recently added.
• Filter by newest, oldest, best sellers, price, or alphabetically.
• Search for products by category or description.
• Add to cart from the main category screen.
• Hit the “Heart” to add to the Wishlist.
• Hit the red “ADD TO CART” to add to your online shopping cart.
• Hit the “Share” to text, email, print, or add to social media.
• Chat with Harvest Array directly from the product screen.

• Contact Information: Direct link to email us. Contains information on calling, chatting, or mailing us.
• About Us: Learn about the history of Harvest Array and the Made in the USA pledge.
• Customer Service: Details on ordering and payment information.
• Shipping Policy: Learn about the shipping terms and when you will receive our USA products in your home.
• Return Policy: 30-day return policy.
• Privacy Policy: All of your information is secure at Harvest Array.
• Terms of Service: Review of product and company policies.
• Apply as a Vendor: Join Harvest Array and become a vendor.

• Meet our Vendors: View our US-based small business partners.
• Recipes: Sample our recipes based on our products.

• Call: Press to directly call Harvest Array.

bluejetty:00186409:ios.description:
Popcorn, Movies, Snacks and Music are ready, Invite your best friends, turn the light off and let the Pajamas party start! So many kids have requested this one we just had to create it. Don't forget to visit our new pajamas Party Store where you can get cool pajamas, lamps, toys and snacks for your party. 
Create Your own parties, Anywhere!
Get everything you need to host the perfect pajamas party game in my city. Flower shop for that extra fun party feeling, night store that sells all you need for your party, a large friends house with lots of rooms and locations just perfect for your party. Do you want to hold the party in another house? don't worry about it. My City games are connected, you can easily move all items and characters between our other My City games.
Age group 4-12:
Easy enough for 4-year-olds to play and super exciting for 12 years to enjoy. 
Game features:
- 6 Exciting locations - Friendly Friends House, Flower Store, Food truck, PJ Party Store.
- 20 characters that you can use and move between other My City games
- Lots of things to explore, Customise and discover.
- The game is connected to all other My City Games, All locations and characters will be available in other games you own
- The furniture store will add more customization to My City Home
Play Together
We support multi-touch so kids can play games together with friends and family on the same screen!
We love making children games, if you like what we do and want to send us ideas and suggestions for our next games of My City you can do so here:
Facebook - https://www.facebook.com/mytowngames
Twitter - https://twitter.com/mytowngames
Terms of Use: https://www.my-town.com/EULA
Customer Support contact: support@my-town.com
Get Privacy-related information at: https://www.my-town.com/privacy-policy/.

bluejetty:00178625:ios.description:
A location based Photo App to let everyone know exactly where and when you were in that photo. 
Location overlay will give you a chance to share with friends what you’re seeing in real time!
Beautifully crafted custom skins will give your photos CLEANER, more ELEGANT look. 
from gotechlive: 
"Everyone loves clicking holiday photos and sharing them on social networks. But why share plain pictures when you can stamp them with location information and create cool-looking postcards? PhotoPlace lets you add captions as well as attach GPS data from your phone or from FourSquare to your pictures. Consider, for instance, you are at the Eiffel Tower. Now, Instead of sharing a big vanilla photo of the landmark, you can overlay it with a caption saying ‘I was here at Eiffel Tower, Paris’." 
The app is so smart that it will recognize your current location and it will also recommend you with various skins that you can choose. 
You can add whatever text you wish, plus the name of the location (custom or geolocated pulled from Foursquare or Facebook) where you are snapping the photo. 
Even while you are not social media person PhotoPlace is for you - just save pictures to your camera roll! 
It lets you beautify your pictures that will add more to your memories in life. You will enjoy it in years to come!
features: 
over 70 skins for every imaginable location or occasion 
share to: Instagram, Facebook, Twitter, Weibo, Flickr, Tumblr 
customizable Timestamp 
works with your old photos! (as long as you have GPS information saved to them) 
location pulled from Foursquare or Facebook

You can cancel at any time. Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period. Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase.
Our private policy can be found at: http://byssmobile.com/priv/priv.html
Our terms of use can be found at: http://byssmobile.com/priv/wsterms.html
Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases.
If you have any problems with our app please let us know using Contact Us (available in our app menu - just tap three dots button and tap option: Contact Us).

bluejetty:00138622:ios.name: Learn Sicilian
bluejetty:00138622:ios.summary: Introducing Learn Sicilian, your gateway to mastering the vibrant language of Sicilia! Dive into the rich linguistic tapestry of this Southern Italian region with our user-friendly language learning app. Specifically tailored to help you gr
bluejetty:00138622:ios.description:
Introducing Learn Sicilian, your gateway to mastering the vibrant language of Sicilia! Dive into the rich linguistic tapestry of this Southern Italian region with our user-friendly language learning app. Specifically tailored to help you grasp the nuances of different regional dialects, Learn Sicilian is your virtual tutor, available anytime, anywhere.
With Learn Sicilian, you'll unlock a treasure trove of audio and written translations for words, phrases, and verbs, seamlessly bridging the gap between multiple languages and the captivating Sicilian language spoken across the island. Whether you're a language enthusiast, a traveler eager to immerse yourself in local culture, or someone with Sicilian roots seeking to reconnect with your heritage, our app is your indispensable companion.
Key Features:
Courses and Lessons: Dive into detailed courses specifically designed to teach the intricacies of the Sicilian language. Each lesson takes you through the basics and gradually advances into more complex structures, ensuring a comprehensive learning experience.
Interactive Quizzes: Test your knowledge and improve your Sicilian language skills with our interactive quizzes. Challenge yourself after each lesson and track your progress as you master new vocabulary and phrases.
Region Dialect Options: With our interactive map of Sicily, you can choose from various Sicilian regional dialects such as Palermitano, Catanese, Siracusano, and more, ensuring an authentic and tailored learning experience that reflects the unique linguistic landscape of Sicilia.
Progressive Learning: As we continue to grow, your contribution supports the expansion of our offerings, including additional language resources, more courses, and even live conversation features to enhance your learning journey.
Embark on your language-learning adventure with Learn Sicilian today and unlock the beauty of Sicily's linguistic heritage. Whether you're navigating the bustling streets of Palermo and Catania or exploring the picturesque landscapes of Taormina and Cefalù, let Learn Sicilian be your guide to meaningful connections and immersive experiences.
Also available in other languages.
User terms of service: https://www.learnsicilian.com/terms-and-conditions

→ Cash flow tracking: view your income, expenses and balance at a glance.
→ VAT management: track your collected and deductible VAT in real time.
Customer support that's there for you
⇒ Responsive support: trained and based in France, available 5 days a week by chat, email and phone.
⇒ A comprehensive help centre: articles and tutorials to answer all your questions.
⇒ By your side to help you succeed: whether it's a technical detail or a billing question, we help your business grow.
Shine Facture — Focus on your business, not your admin.

bluejetty:00175338:ios.summary: Welcome to Clapper, one of the fastest-growing social media platforms focused on promoting real lives, connections and communities. You can see the latest trends and people’s real lives as they unfold, as well as people’s opinions and talen
bluejetty:00175338:ios.description:
Welcome to Clapper, one of the fastest-growing social media platforms focused on promoting real lives, connections and communities. You can see the latest trends and people’s real lives as they unfold, as well as people’s opinions and talents. FREE to use, NO Ads, No BS just Real lives.
Our mission is to use technology to empower everyone's life, so that everyone has the opportunity to show, the channel to speak, and the possibility to be seen. No troll, no shadow ban.
-Be heard
Build up your own following and be an opinion leader. Connect with friends and follow those whose opinions you want to hear. Our “Clapback” feature is unique in that you can simply express your opinion and easily view people’s opinions with support or opposition.
- Be seen
Clapper uses ‘equal opportunity’ algorithms to show ordinary, real, and diverse communities of people through the sharing of short videos and live streams, Everyone can easily record videos and be a part of the heartbeat of your community. Based on your location things that are local in your area will be aggregated for you as well.
- Be valued
Clapper launches live streaming to further increase the timely communication and interaction between creators and users, and add more new ways for creators with a moderate audience to obtain substantial income. With monetization, Clapper now offers a practical path for content creators to sustain themselves on an ad-free short video platform.
*What can you expect?*
a) Post Video: Short video is the foundation of Clapper where users can post videos for up to 3 minutes and you also have the option to use our additional features like add text, video trimming, music, and other effects. Interact, sing, dance, talk about your day, send messages to friends and followers.
b) Duet Live: Apart from the solo Live option, duet live feature allows you to bring your follower on live and interact in real-time.
c) Radio: Imagine an auditorium but with only vocals. This is the audio-only feature that allows you to create a room of up to 2000 listeners and up to 20 speakers to 'talk'
d) Group: Create a community of your super fans where you can share interact 1:1 with them.
Download now and discover the heartbeat of your local area and around the world.
Website: https://clapperapp.com/
Facebook: https://facebook.com/theclapperapp
Instagram: https://instagram.com/theclapperapp
Twitter: https://twitter.com/theclapperapp
Email: contact@clapperapp.com

bluejetty:00035941:ios.description:
Discover the Touch of Words – Play Colorwood Words Puzzle!
Dive into the tactile world of Colorwood Words, where every discovery vibrates with excitement. This game isn’t just about finding words; it’s an immersive experience that stimulates your senses with haptic feedback, making each word you uncover a thrilling revelation.
Why Choose Colorwood Words Puzzle?
• Tactile Gameplay: Feel the satisfaction with each correct word through haptic feedback, enhancing your engagement and enjoyment.
• Engaging Challenges: Perfect for quick sessions or extended play, our puzzles offer a delightful blend of simplicity and cognitive challenge.
• Vocabulary Expansion: Learn and discover new words with each puzzle, enriching your language skills as you play.
• Stunning Wooden Aesthetics: Immerse yourself in levels beautifully crafted with a serene wood theme, making each puzzle not only challenging but also visually relaxing.
• Daily Rewards: Keep the excitement alive with new puzzles and surprises every day, rewarding your progress and dedication.
How to Play
• Decipher the Wood: Like solving a cryptogram, decode sequences of letters to unveil hidden words, accompanied by tactile feedback that celebrates your success.
• Animate Your Achievements: Watch the wooden blocks animate vibrantly with each word you find, adding a rewarding aspect to your puzzle-solving journey.
• Advance and Conquer: Clear levels to unlock increasingly challenging puzzles, keeping your brain sharp and engaged.
Perfect for All Puzzle Enthusiasts: Whether you’re a seasoned word game player or new to the genre, Colorwood Words offers a unique sensory twist that captivates and challenges both your mind and your touch.
Step into a world where words feel as real as they look. Download Colorwood Words Puzzle now and start your tactile word adventure today!

◆ Health tracking! Track diapers, feedings (breast or bottle), sleep, milestones, and more

◆ Invite friends & family to follow your children and view updates, photos, videos, and more

◆ Diaper Changes

◆ Milestones

*Read Daily Personalized Content*

bluejetty:00138136:ios.summary: Welcome to the ProMedica ForeverFit app! Our focus is to provide individuals with fitness services and a wide range of wellness programs tailored to support healthy aging. We are more than an athletic club, ProMedica ForeverFit is a hub to
bluejetty:00138136:ios.description:
Welcome to the ProMedica ForeverFit app! Our focus is to provide individuals with fitness services and a wide range of wellness programs tailored to support healthy aging. We are more than an athletic club, ProMedica ForeverFit is a hub to learn, socialize and connect to a wide range of health and wellness services provided by the professionals of ProMedica. 
The app allows our members to sign- up for group exercise classes and lap swimming and add them to their calendar. Members can also create personal goals both in the club and on the go and be able to sync to other personal tracking devices to stay motivated. The ProMedica ForeverFit App offers a variety of Virtual Only classes and individual exercise plans for those who want to work out in the safety of their own home.
ProMedica ForeverFit app uses the Health app that is pre-installed on your iPhone to sync nutrients and workouts data. Because of this, the app will ask you to grant read and write access to your nutrients and workouts data.

bluejetty:00112979:android.description:
Let us know this game deeper….:
Are you interested in becoming a Master Chef? This game is especially for you. This game provides an entertaining and engaging way to learn the fundamentals of cooking and baking. It features a variety of recipes and challenges for players to complete, It's the perfect way to hone your culinary skills and have fun while doing it! We have multiple recipes for you in this cooking game. Choose a recipe and select how you want to make the dish. You as a junior chef take control of the kitchen at home and prepare different dishes with our recipe.
Prepare different dishes and practice cooking faster and better each time and become a master at your recipes. Improve your culinary skills and have fun while doing it. Challenge yourself and try new recipes to become an expert chef. Enjoy the cooking process and create delicious dishes to share with your friends and family.
Get ready to become a Master Chef and serve the best meals in the kitchen. Experiment with different ingredients and flavor combinations to create unique dishes. Taste your creations and adjust ingredients accordingly. Make sure to have fun and enjoy the process! This will allow you to become familiar with the components of dishes you like and how to use them in different ways. In addition to learning how to combine the ingredients for optimal flavor, you'll also learn how to time your cooking so that all the dish's components are ready at the same time as you're preparing them. 
You can prepare and bake any dish from the following: Lemon cake, chocolate biscuits, chocolate lava cake, bacon-wrapped monkfish, buttermilk pancakes, prawn fry, banana fritters, cream of chicken soup, seekh kebab, paneer tikka, juice, spicy masala bread toast, pancake, garlic mushroom soup, Christmas cake, pizza, mandarin beef, fusion wrap, fish fry, Gobi Manchurian, omelet, waffles, potato tomato rosemary soup, gnocchi, burger, cheese crackers, etc. Depending on your taste, there are several toppings available for you to use to decorate your dishes with all kinds of wonderful ideas.
The trait of this game
There are 25 recipes in this cooking game. Create the most impressive menu.
• Bake your pizza in the oven
• Bake pancake with fruits and syrup 
• Bake waffles with ice cream and toppings.
• Bake your chocolate cake
• Make creamy chicken soup for the family
• Make bread toast and an omelet for breakfast
• Make the juice for the summer 
• Make the finest fish and prawn fries.
• Cook paneer tikka with a tangy, flavorful marinade.
• Make Gobi Manchurian with a sweet and spicy sauce. 
• Cook banana fritters with a light and crispy batter.
• Cook bacon-wrapped monkfish with a savoury and smoky glaze.
• Cook seekh kebab with a flavorful and aromatic spice blend.
Become a Master Chef by playing this cooking game with your kids or by yourself if you prefer. Enjoy a fun-filled cooking adventure as you unlock new levels, recipes, and ingredients. Challenge yourself to create the most delicious and mouth-watering fries ever made. Share with your friends and family to show them the most delicious fries. 
Have fun and be creative! Bon appétit!

bluejetty:00145041:ios.description:
Find your life purpose and path through Numerology, Biorhythm, and Psychomatrix. We provide these calculations and forecast to help you discover yourself and your future. In Numerology and Biorhythm app, we combine our knowledge of human nature and mathematic calculation to find answers for your life’s questions. Download our app now and get forecast, compatibility calculations and many more! 
We have so many questions in our lives, from what is my life’s purpose, who am I compatible with, which job I should take, how to balance my life, and so on. It’s not easy to find the answers to these questions. Some people turn to astrology, tarot reading, or psychic for answers. We hope that our Numerological & Biorhythm app can help answering some of your questions and guide you in your daily life. We have extensive features and sections so that our numerological calculations can guide you through every aspect of your life. 
=== FEATURES OF NUMEROLOGY & BIORHYTHM:===
 DAILY BIORHTYHM GUIDE
 PERSONAL DAY NUMBERS
 LIFE PATH NUMBERS
 PSYCHOMATRIX LINES
 SOUL NUMBERS
 CHALLENGE NUMBERS
 NAME NUMBERS
 LUCKY DAY NUMBERS
 DESIRE NUMBERS
 EXPRESSION NUMBERS
 BIRTHDAY NUMBERS AND CODES
 MATURITY NUMBERS
 LUCKY GEMS
 DAILY, MONTLY, AND ANNUAL FORECAST
 BIORHYTHM DAILY FORECAST
 LOVE COMPATIBILITY
 CREATE MULTIPLE PROFILES. 
We will give a very detailed description and explanation for every reading and calculation so you will have a complete understanding about the result and hopefully answer some of your life’s questions. Our new feature is the ability to create multiple profiles. You can add your partner’s or children’s profiles or maybe your friends’ and family members. Through these readings and profiles, you can understand them better. 
---
We hope that Numerology & Biorhythm app can help you and your loved ones in your life’s journey. If you enjoy using our app, please take a few seconds to leave us a rating and review. It will help our app’s visibility tremendously and it will enable other users to find and download this app. 
Thank you and enjoy!

bluejetty:00184276:ios.description:
The Bar Harbor Mobile App is a free mobile decision-support tool that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other financial institutions, into a single, up-to-the-minute view so you can stay organized and make smarter financial decisions. It is fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your personal finances.
FEATURES
Multi-Account Aggregation: View all of your financial information (balances, transaction history, merchant spending averages) in one place for on-the-go organization.
Alerts & Notifications: Set alerts for low funds and be notified about upcoming bills.
Add Tags, Notes, Images & Geo-Information: By enhancing transactions with custom tags, notes or photos of a receipt or check, you have the ability to stay organized and find exactly what you’re looking for when searching through your finances.
Contact: Locate ATMs or branches and contact Bar Harbor Bank and Trust customer service directly from the app.
SAFE AND SECURE
The app utilizes the same bank-level security that protects you when you’re on Internet Banking. The app also features a unique 4-digit passcode setting that prevents unauthorized access.
GETTING STARTED
To use the Bar Harbor Mobile App, you must be enrolled as an Bar Harbor Bank and Trust Internet Banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials. After you successfully login to the app, your accounts and transactions will begin updating.

bluejetty:00069093:ios.summary: The official MOJO app. Your go-to place for world-class music journalism. With reviews of the latest key releases and archival reissues, exclusive interviews, and in-depth features that bring new perspectives on music’s greatest heroes incl
bluejetty:00069093:ios.description:
The official MOJO app. Your go-to place for world-class music journalism. With reviews of the latest key releases and archival reissues, exclusive interviews, and in-depth features that bring new perspectives on music’s greatest heroes including Bob Dylan, Queen, The Rolling Stones, the Beatles and many more up and coming artists. Our writers cover a wide range of genres - punk, modern and classic rock, folk, soul, country to reggae, electronic and experimental. 
Enjoy every page of unrivalled insight and stunning photography from each edition of the magazine, delivered to your phone as soon as it hits the shops. 
- Read each magazine in full. 
- Search for your favourite bands, artists, albums and tours. 
- Bookmark articles for later. 
- Access the MOJO magazine back catalogue. 
For the past 25 years, MOJO has been recognized as the definitive magazine for music lovers the world over. 
Every month, our passionate and dedicated team create a magazine which vividly celebrates classic sounds, old and new, and the remarkable people who have made them. At MOJO’s heart, there is a profound understanding of how important music can be – an understanding shared by both its discerning and enduring international readership, and by the legendary artists themselves. 
Those artists respect MOJO and have long collaborated with the magazine for revelatory interviews and bespoke free CDs. They, like the readers, implicitly trust the MOJO team to direct them to the good stuff: music from a multitude of genres and eras, made by icons and valiant young upstarts. Every issue is beautifully designed to be a place where readers can reconnect with the heroes of their youth and discover that wealth of new artists who are re-imagining musical tradition in dynamic new ways. 
The MOJO Filter remains the essential music reviews section: a guaranteed guide to the finest releases each month, which encompass the magazine’s eclectic but focused mission: to find the greatest music of all time, and present it to the readers with an excitement, knowledge and insight that no other music publication can match. 
Please Note: This app is optimised for iOS 14 and higher. If you're using an iPad 1 or 2, iPad Mini 1 or iPhone 5 (or before) you may struggle to run this app smoothly. 
Your subscription will automatically renew each billing period, and you will be charged through your iTunes account within 24-hours prior to the end of the current cycle. You can turn off auto-renew at any time from your iTunes account settings up until 24-hours before the end of the current period, but refunds will not be provided for any unused portion of the term. Please visit our Privacy Policy and Terms of Service for more information:

https://www.bauerlegal.co.uk/app-terms-of-use-03032025 
Privacy Policy

bluejetty:00138546:ios.description:
Can't find your remote again? Here is an easy way to find a replacement without leaving your home! 
Lost your TV remote control? Say goodbye to the hassle of searching for your remote. 
Simply connect it to the same Wi-Fi network as your Roku TV, you can effortlessly turn the TV on/off, switch channels, adjust the volume and manage content playback - just like a typical physical remote control. It even has a touchpad and voice input for added convenience. Enhance your TV experience with the TV remote app today!
Here are the guidelines for using the TV remote app:
1. Download and install the universal roki TV Remote app.
2. Select a Roku TV that is connected to the same WiFi network.
3. Tap to connect.
4. Voila! The TV Remote control is now all set up.
Enjoy seamless control of your Roku TV with these simple steps!
With the TV Remote app, you'll enjoy a range of convenient features:
- Automatic detection of Roku TVs on the same WiFi network makes setup a breeze.
- Rapid Roku TV control gives you instant access to volume adjustment, reverse, and fast forward functions.
- Experience smooth and efficient TV control with the touchpad feature.
- Swift text input and search functionality help you find your favorite shows and movies quickly.
- Power on/off your Roku TV directly from your device for added convenience.
- Take advantage of voice search functionality for hands-free control.
Enjoy the functionalities and features of the app at your own discretion.
For troubleshooting:
- The app can only connect to the same WiFi network as your Roku device.
- For connection failure with Roku TV, app reinstallation and TV reboot are suggested to resolve most issues.
Please note that the TV Remote is not an official application and is not affiliated with Roku. However, it provides a convenient and user-friendly way to romote control your Roku TV. 
Privacy Policy: https://sites.google.com/view/tv-remote-ios-privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://sites.google.com/view/tv-remote-ios-terms-of-use

Continuing to lead the market with unparalleled innovation and functionality, AvPlan features multiple firsts with terrain warning, touch
bluejetty:00076297:ios.description:
Get flying faster with AvPlan EFB - the premier lifetime Electronic Flight Bag that grows with you. 
Continuing to lead the market with unparalleled innovation and functionality, AvPlan features multiple firsts with terrain warning, touch to display restricted airspace status, automatic IFR airway planning and geo-referenced airport taxi & instrument approach diagrams to arm you with superior situational awareness.
Envisioned, developed and rigorously tested over a two year period by pilots for pilots, AvPlan EFB integrates everything you need to prepare, plan and execute your flight - whether it be in a recreational aircraft, corporate jet or something in between.
Your AvPlan EFB comes packed with the following features:
• Comprehensive VFR & IFR Flight Planning
• Complete official FAA airport/waypoint database
• All necessary documentation
• Advanced aircraft flight model setup
• Automatic TOC, TOD, PNR and optimum altitude calculation
• Full DUATS integration (WX, NOTAMS, flight plan submission)
• All US VFR & IFR aeronautical charts (with pan, zoom and rotation)
• Touch and drag (rubber band) graphical flight replanning/diversion 
• Weight and balance (with loadsheet and passenger manifest)
• Graphical WX overlays on any chart (WX Radar, Lightning, METAR, SIGMET)
• GPS moving map with display data labels
• Touch-to-display TFR status
• Terrain map overlay and in-flight terrain alerting 
• Geo-referenced airport diagrams (auto displays aircraft position on landing)
• Geo-referenced instrument approach plates which support route editing and more
• FAA Documentation (including full text search and bookmark functions)
• Aircraft pilot operating handbook import 
• Send a briefing pack to PDF file, email & Apple AirPrint compatible printers 
• Extensive integration with external flight planning systems/panel GPS/FMS’s (Including Garmin G1000)
• Ability to sync flight plans between Apple IOS devices
• Easy to access support from a team of committed professionals
• And much more we can’t list here
The Perfect Co-pilot
Intuitive, reliable and responsive, AvPlan’s inbuilt context awareness engine ensures it’s always up to date and ready to provide you with the right information at the right time, whether you’re preparing for your flight or already airborne. 
Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.
AvPlan EFB – Plan faster, fly sooner

bluejetty:00065457:ios.description:
APP DESCRIPTION:
The Western Nebraska Bank Mobile App is a free mobile decision-support tool that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other financial institutions, into a single, up-to-the-minute view so you can stay organized and make smarter financial decisions. It is fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your personal finances.
FEATURES
Multi-Account Aggregation: View all of your financial information (balances, transaction history, merchant spending averages) in one place for on-the-go organization.
Alerts & Notifications: Set alerts for low funds and be notified about upcoming bills.
Add Tags, Notes, Images & Geo-Information: By enhancing transactions with custom tags, notes or photos of a receipt or check, you have the ability to stay organized and find exactly what you’re looking for when searching through your finances.
Contact: Locate ATMs or branches and contact Western Nebraska Bank customer service directly from the app.
SAFE AND SECURE
The app utilizes the same bank-level security that protects you when you’re on Internet Banking. The app also features a unique 4-digit passcode setting that prevents unauthorized access.
GETTING STARTED
To use the Western Nebraska Bank Mobile App, you must be enrolled as a Western Nebraska Bank Internet Banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials. After you successfully login to the app, your accounts and transactions will begin updating.

bluejetty:00139965:ios.description:
Run, shapeshift, and escape the forest's guardian golem!
Get ready for a thrilling adventure through a mystical forest in this fast-paced endless runner game! Shapeshift between five magical animals—wolf, moose, rabbit, raven, and bear—to navigate through dangerous obstacles and outrun the powerful forest golem hot on your heels.
Shapeshift to Survive
Each animal has unique abilities crucial for survival:
Wolf: Unleash your speed and agility to dash past obstacles with precision.
Moose: Use raw strength to smash through barriers and destructible obstacles in your way.
Rabbit: Slip through tight spaces and burrows where others cannot follow.
Raven (Power-Up): Soar high above danger, evading ground obstacles and collecting coins in mid-air.
Bear (Power-Up): Become unstoppable for a short time, destroying all obstacles in your path without slowing down.
Collect Coins & Unlock Skins
As you race through the forest, gather coins to unlock exclusive magical skins for each animal. Each skin is adorned with enchanting markings, showcasing their hidden mystical powers.
Daily Quests & Achievements
Challenge yourself with daily quests that push your skills to the limit. Complete objectives and earn rewards while unlocking achievements that bring you closer to becoming the ultimate shapeshifting runner.
Compete on Global Leaderboards
Think you're the best? Compete with friends and players worldwide on the global leaderboards. Prove your skills by running farther, dodging faster, and shapeshifting smarter than anyone else.
Features
Shapeshift between 5 magical animals: wolf, moose, rabbit, raven (power-up), and bear (power-up).
Dodge & Destroy: Use each animal's unique abilities to avoid obstacles or smash through them.
Collect Coins to unlock mystical skins and power up your animals.
Complete daily quests and earn achievements for extra rewards.
Compete on global leaderboards and rise to the top.
Special Events: Look out for limited-time events like Halloween for even more fun and rewards!
Why You'll Love It
Endless Action: The thrill never stops as you shapeshift, dash, and fly through the enchanted forest.
Stunning Visuals: Beautifully crafted environments and magical creatures immerse you in a fantasy world.
Constant Updates: We're always adding new skins, quests, and events to keep the game exciting!
Download Shapeshifter: Animal Run now and experience the thrill of transforming into powerful animals as you escape the forest's relentless guardian! How far can you go?

bluejetty:00091438:ios.name: Tower Defense: Lazy Apocalypse
bluejetty:00091438:ios.summary: Prepare for an action-packed idle tower defense adventure in Lazy Apocalypse: Tower Defense! Defend against relentless waves of zombies, upgrade your weapons, and become the most famous monster-slaying streamer in this thrilling idle defens
bluejetty:00091438:ios.description:
Prepare for an action-packed idle tower defense adventure in Lazy Apocalypse: Tower Defense! Defend against relentless waves of zombies, upgrade your weapons, and become the most famous monster-slaying streamer in this thrilling idle defense game. Whether you’re strategizing or relaxing, the action never stops! Enter an immersive world where every second counts, and every upgrade brings new possibilities for survival. Can you withstand the ultimate apocalypse?
Why You’ll Love Lazy Apocalypse: Tower Defense
Idle Tower Defense Meets Action Gameplay – Enjoy a unique mix of idle and tower defense mechanics. Your hero keeps fighting even when you're away, collecting rewards and strengthening your undead defense fortress. Strategically place defenses, enhance your weapons, and adapt to increasing enemy waves. The game balances automation and hands-on strategy for an optimized experience.
Defend Humanity in the Apocalypse – The monsters have taken over! Protect your base, survive the zombies apocalypse, and eliminate terrifying boss zombie before they destroy everything. Fight through different regions, each with its own unique challenges and enemy types. Face off against specialized zombie creatures with advanced attack patterns that require calculated countermeasures.
Upgrade Your Ultimate Battle Armchair – Transform your basic stool into a fully armed combat throne with flamethrowers, laser cannons, and machine guns to obliterate the zombies. Customize your chair’s defenses with auto-turrets, electrified barriers, and motion-detection weapons for an unstoppable fortress. Level up and unlock unique chair skins to stand out in the heat of battle.
Fight Epic Undead Bosses – Challenge powerful undead overlords in fast-paced battles across stunning locations, from Miami Beach to abandoned malls. Each location offers unique environmental challenges—utilize cover, avoid hazards, and exploit weak points in enemy formations. Special event bosses appear periodically, offering high-risk, high-reward challenges that test even the most skilled players.
Unlock Crazy Game Modes – Take on Gold Rush Mode and Monster Rush Mode for extreme enemies battles and special survival challenges. Test your endurance in Endless Wave Mode, where the difficulty constantly escalates. The variety of modes ensures you’ll always have a fresh challenge awaiting.
Massive Arsenal of Weapons – Equip rocket launchers, miniguns, plasma cannons, and more to crush the zombie horde. Upgrade and customize your weapons to suit your strategy. Unlock special ammunition, including explosive rounds, cryo bullets, and EMP shells to counter different enemy types. Every weapon comes with multiple upgrade paths, allowing you to tailor your arsenal to your playstyle.
Earn Idle Rewards & Progress Offline – Your hero fights 24/7, even when you're not playing. Collect loot, resources, and upgrades to stay ahead in battle. Earn additional bonuses through daily login streaks and weekly challenges that reward loyal players with exclusive upgrades.
Daily Missions & Exclusive Events – Take on daily quests, limited-time challenges, and special events to earn rare gear, weapons, and powerful upgrades. Engage in seasonal events, where exclusive enemies and rewards await. Battle through themed events that introduce new mechanics and challenges, keeping gameplay exciting and dynamic.
Survive. Stream. Slay.
Are you ready to chill, kill, and survive? If you love zombie survival games, tower defense games, or idle clicker games, this is your chance to shine! Master strategy, combat, and upgrades in an adrenaline-fueled monster defense world. Whether you enjoy casual auto-battlers or deep tactical RPG-style upgrades, this game provides the perfect mix of fun and strategy.
Download Lazy Apocalypse: Tower Defense now and build your legend in the ultimate undead tower defense adventure!

bluejetty:00022575:ios.description:
Want an easy way to stay active, lose weight, and build muscle? Home Workout helps you train with purpose through focused exercise routines designed for everyday life—from bodyweight workouts and light movement to strength training. Whether you prefer training with equipment or no equipment at all, you can work out at home, in the gym, or outdoors with flexible workout plans that adapt to you. With a smart AI coach and professional video guidance, each session delivers clear instructions to help you get fitter and stronger more easily.
Home Workout works like a personal trainer in your pocket. Based on your goals and experience level, it creates a workout plan that you can actually follow. With access to over 500 exercises, Home Workout offers a wide range of workout program options, including bodyweight workout sessions, stretching, quick workouts, and chair exercises. You can follow guided AI workouts or customize routines yourself—choose exercises you enjoy, adjust intensity, and train the way that feels right for you.
Stay consistent with a built-in workout tracker that automatically records key training data like completed exercises, workout duration, and training frequency. This smart workout progress tracker helps you review past sessions and see your progress over time, giving you the motivation to build a lasting fitness habit.
Plus, your workout data stays connected across Apple Health, Apple Watch, and iPad, so everything stays in sync across your devices.
Download Home Workout and see how easy fitness can actually be!
What You Get with Home Workout:
1. START ANYTIME & ANYWHERE
Exercise at home or in the gym with a personal workout plan that fits your schedule and available equipment. From quick sessions to longer workouts, you can train whenever it works for you.
2. EXPERT-TAILORED WORKOUT PLANS
Use our flexible workout planner to build a workout plan based on your fitness goals and level. Whether you want to stay active, get in shape, or build strength, each plan is easy to follow and simple to stick with.
3. 500+ Exercises
Explore 500+ exercises, including bodyweight workouts, stretching, chair workouts, and more. With options for different fitness goals and levels, there's always an exercise that fits you! Each exercise comes with clear video guidance and simple instructions for safe and effective training.
4. TRAIN SMART WITH AI SUPPORT
Enjoy AI workouts that adapt to your needs. Your AI coach adjusts your workout plan over time based on your performance and preferences, keeping training balanced and effective. As you customize routines or save your favorite exercises, the AI learns from your choices and refines future workouts.
Highlight Features:
- An easy-to-use workout planner and smart tracker that organize sessions, automatically log activities, and present clear data, helping you stay on track.
- A comprehensive exercise library with video guides and expert tips.
- Custom reminders to help stay consistent and never miss a session.
No Hidden Charges, say goodbye to unexpected "surprises". 
Your perfect workout is waiting—join millions already crushing their fitness goals with Home Workout! 
Subscription Terms and Details

- The account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period.
- Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication.

bluejetty:00067934:ios.description:
If you are looking for an awesome car parking simulator game then Car Parking is the very one to perfect your driving skills. Especially for some drivers, parallel parking can be particularly intimidating. Fear not – this parking game will help you become a parking master.
One simple rule: steer away from the barriers on the road to prevent your car from getting bumped or scratched, carefully drive and park it in the assigned parking lot. This task may seem as easy as pie, but it can be quite difficult even for professional drivers.

- Use the steering wheel to turn the car in the direction that you want.
Download Car Parking for free now. Let’s get in your dream car to begin the journey. And always remember safety first.

bluejetty:00121812:ios.description:
A cat running game! Take care of your dog, puppy, or kitten. Play virtual dog games with toys, decorate your pet’s house in this simulator, or dress up cute pets and adopt or rescue even more.
Pet Run is the best free running game where you can meet your new best friend and go for a run! Choose your pet pal and dash your way through the city and park for fun running adventures!
Who Let the Dogs Out? You Did!
Play as your favorite pet and choose from cute puppy, kitten, and rabbit breeds! Help Lucky the labrador, Ginger the cat, and their friends rush through city streets and park paths! Take your adorable pup for a walk and train your puppy by playing with them in the city and park. Dog walking? This is dog running!
Take Care of Your Pet!
Take care of your cat or dog. Fill the food bowl to feed your dog, or throw the ball to play. When your dog’s paws get dirty, give it a bath and a shower, then brush its fur to keep it happy. Switch rooms by tapping the speech bubble or arrows on the home screen. With three new rooms for your pets to explore, you’ll find loads of fun things to do—including the new games room with brand new mini-games.
Explore the City and Park!
Run, slide, and leap your way across the city, suburbs, park, and forest! Dash forward as fast as you can, dodge obstacles, and collect coins! Swipe past trees, slide under funky city birds, and jump over logs, broken fire hydrants, and even swimming baby ducks! Take a ride down a fun park slide to reach mega heights! The city is your dog show, and the obstacles are your agility course!
Game Features:
- Colorful HD graphics
- Run across the city or through the park
- Choose to run with a puppy, kitten, or rabbit
- Dodge obstacles and collect coins
- Use awesome power-ups
- Activate rainbow mode
- Collect coins to upgrade and earn boosters
- Come back every day for new rewards
- Beat your friends’ high scores
- Stay tuned for more content and pets
What You Get With Pet Run:
- Run across 4 cool locations
- Many obstacles to jump over and avoid
- Choose between 8 cute pets
- Use 6 power-ups and boosters
- Win daily prizes and rewards
- Feed, clean, bathe, brush, and play with your pet
- Explore 3 new rooms with fun games and activities

We love fun games at AceViral! Our mission is to create quality, fun games for boys and girls of all ages. You can find our mobile games by searching for “AceViral” on the App Store.
Send Us Your Feedback!
We really value your feedback as it helps us improve our games and make them even more fun for everyone. If you have a moment, please rate and review our app. We would love to hear your comments and suggestions.
Need Help? Talk to Us!
You can contact us anytime to share your comments or questions. If you need support or have a problem with any of our games, please get in touch with us at support@aceviral.com
For Parents
Pet Run is free to play but contains in-app purchases and items that can be bought with real money. You can disable in-app purchases on your device within your device settings. By downloading Pet Run, you agree to the AceViral Privacy Policy and Terms of Service, which you can find within the app.

bluejetty:00037892:ios.name: ไพ่แคง-รวมดัมมี่ ป๊อกเด้ง ไฮโล
bluejetty:00037892:ios.summary: ไพ่แคงเป็นเกมสุดฮิตที่มีคนไทยเล่นกันเยอะมาก จำเป็นต้องอาศัยทักษะและความจำด้วย ผู้เล่นเทียบแต้มกันด้วย ใครได้แต้มน้อย จะเป็นผู้ชนะ ไม่ว่าจะเป็นคนชอบเล่นไพ่เท็กซัส ไพ่เก้าเก ไพ่ดัมมี่ ป๊อกเด้ง ไฮโล หรือ SLOTS มั่นใจว่าลองเล่นเกมนี้แล้วจะติดใจ
bluejetty:00037892:ios.description:
ไพ่แคงเป็นเกมสุดฮิตที่มีคนไทยเล่นกันเยอะมาก จำเป็นต้องอาศัยทักษะและความจำด้วย ผู้เล่นเทียบแต้มกันด้วย ใครได้แต้มน้อย จะเป็นผู้ชนะ ไม่ว่าจะเป็นคนชอบเล่นไพ่เท็กซัส ไพ่เก้าเก ไพ่ดัมมี่ ป๊อกเด้ง ไฮโล หรือ SLOTS มั่นใจว่าลองเล่นเกมนี้แล้วจะติดใจแน่ๆ มาสัมผัสกับความสนุกตื่นเต้นที่เกมไพ่แคงสิ
1.โหลดมาเล่นฟรี สามารถรับชิปฟรีโดยล็อกอินเกทุกวัน ชวนเพื่อนและทำภารกิจ ไม่เสียเงินก็เล่นอย่างสนุก
2.ผู้เล่นที่สมัครเข้าใหม่ จะได้รับรางวัลมือใหม่สุดหรูต่อเนื่อง 3 วัน ชิปฟรีมากมายและของขวัญสวยเก๋รอท่านมารับอยู่
3.แค่ล็อกอินเกมทุกวันก็จะได้รับชิปมากมาย ล็อกอินด้วยบัญชี Facebook จะได้รับรางวัลเพิ่มอีก 50%
4.แรงกิ้งอัพเดททุกวัน ผู้เล่นสามารถเพิ่มเซียนมือเป็นเพื่อนแล้วติดตามเข้าไปเล่นในห้องเดียวกันได้
5.ชวนเพื่อนเฟสบุ๊คมาเล่นเกมกัน เชิญชวนปุ๊บรับรางวัลปุ๊บ ยังสามารถเพิ่มผู้เล่นอื่นมาเป็นเพื่อน แล้วส่งชิปให้ซึ่งกันและกันได้
6.ปั่นสล็อตฮอดฮิตและวงล้อนำโชคก็สามารถรับรางวัลชิปได้มากมาย ผู้ที่โชคดีๆรีบมาเข้าเล่นกันเลยค่ะ 
7.อิโม้น่ารักสนุก ห้างของขวัญได้เตรียมของขวัญที่คนไทยชอบ รอคุณมาติดตั้งเลย
8.นอกจากไพ่แคง ออนไลน์ แอพนี้ยังรวมเกมฮิตไทยแท้ๆหลากหลาย ได้แก ดัมมี่ไทย(รวมวิธีการเล่น2v2) ไพ่แคงปกติ ไพ่แคงห้องดับเบิ้ล ไพ่แคงห้องโจรสลัด เก้าเกไทย (ห้องวัดดวง ห้องเซียนมือ2+2) ไฮโลไทย ป๊อกเด้ง ไพ่ผสมสิบ ไพ่เท็กซัส SLOTS ฯลฯ รีบมาเล่นสนุกสุดมันส์กับเพื่อนๆในเกมส์นี้ได้เลย!

bluejetty:00089558:ios.description:
You’ve earned these benefits. Use your Medicare plan to get $0 grocery and health & wellness items, delivered to your door.
Most Medicare Advantage plans come with OTC credits. Monthly money to spend on health items like vitamins, toothpaste, groceries, and more. Chapter makes it easy to claim and use those credits.
Don't leave money on the table. Chapter's OTC Store is the easiest way to get wellness items covered by your Medicare plan, at no cost to you.
What can I get?
- Pain relief
- Personal care (toothpaste, shampoo, lotion)
- Vitamins & supplements
- Cold & flu care
- Groceries
- And more, delivered to your door
Who is this for?
Anyone with a Medicare plan can use Chapter to make the most out of their plan and find ways to save money.
How it works:
- Enter your Medicare plan
- Shop eligible items
- Confirm your shipping info
- Get $0 items delivered
Why Chapter?
- 87% of plans offer OTC credits—don’t leave them unused
- Easy-to-use app, no calls or confusion
- Trusted by tens of thousands of Medicare members
Is it really free?
Yes. No extra fees, no catch.
What are OTC credits?
OTC credits are money your Medicare plan gives you to purchase wellness items like vitamins, sunscreen, and toothpaste.

bluejetty:00156655:ios.description:
Please note this app is not for medical, dental, or vision insurance or Health Savings Accounts (HSA). This app is only for Flex/CDHP products including Health care and Dependent care Flexible Spending Accounts, Health Reimbursement Arrangements, and Mass Transit accounts. If you need assistance when logging in, please call 800-566-9305 and a member of our Customer Service team will be able to assist you. Representatives are available Monday-Friday 8am-6:30pm EST.
Save time by easily and securely accessing your Flex/CDHP benefit accounts. The mobile app features real-time access and intuitive navigation with summarized financial information and charts. 
Powerful features of the app:
- Check available balances
- File a claim
- Take or upload a picture of documentation and submit for a new or existing claim
- Scan product barcodes to determine their eligibility
- Setup various text alert notifications
- Setup Touch ID login
- View claims requiring receipts
- Click to call or email customer service
- No sensitive information is ever stored on your mobile device
- Add a bank account (if applicable)
- Update your banking (if applicable)
To login to the mobile app, follow the steps noted below. Please note that your ID is your SSN. If you have difficulty when logging in, please call 800-566-9305 and a member of our Customer Service team will be able to assist you. You can also access your account via the Meritain Health portal at https://account.meritain.com.
1. Open the app, scroll to the bottom of the page and select New User? Set Up Your Account.
2. You will be redirected to the User Identification page to begin step one of four.
3. Follow steps one through four to complete the set-up.
4. Once you have completed the set-up, you will be logged out. You will then be required to log back in using your new username and password.

bluejetty:00074320:ios.description:
iCoder – More Time for the Things You Love
Did you know most medical professionals who code their own procedures waste hours every week on repetitive, time-consuming tasks?
Nobody wants to stay late at the office hunting for codes when they could be with their family and friends. You shouldn't have to choose between your work and your life.
Like you, we hate wasting time on tools that are slow, confusing, or overpriced. We know how frustrating it is to search through two or three places just to find one code. That's why we built iCoder — to give busy medical professionals their time back.
We help busy medical professionals stop wasting time on repetitive tasks, reduce their workload, and get more time to do the things they love.
Trusted by thousands of healthcare professionals for over 10 years. Rated 5 stars.
What's New in Version 2.0
CPT/ICD-10 Cross-Coding (Premium) 
Stop guessing which code combinations will pass. Enter up to 5 CPT codes with up to 6 ICD-10 diagnoses and instantly see which pairings CMS approves — with history saved for fast re-verification.
Custom Formulas & Presets 
Calculate fees your way using Work RVU, GPCI values, and more. Choose from prebuilt presets or build your own from scratch — your formulas appear automatically on every code's detail screen.
Bookmarks 
Save any screen in iCoder for instant return. Stop navigating back to the same codeset or search results twice.
Custom Code Names 
Label the codes you use most in plain language. Your custom names show up in search and favorites — the right code is always one tap away.
Smarter Autocomplete 
Search now uses each codeset's medical vocabulary to guide your queries — fewer typos, more accurate results, faster lookups.
Everything You Already Love
Fast, Forgiving Search Find CPT® and ICD-10 codes instantly — even with typos or partial terms. Try "ten fing" or "elbow mass" and see how fast it is.
NCCI Edits Checker 
Verify up to 10 codes at once. See RVUs, GPCI-adjusted values, modifiers, DRGs, HCCs, and more in seconds.
Code Vision 
Snap a photo of any code and iCoder identifies it instantly — no manual entry needed.
NDC Lookup 
Search 11-digit NDC codes with HCPCS crosswalks and manufacturer details.
Favorites & Notes 
Save unlimited codes in custom folders with rich notes — headers, links, and more. Browse all notes by codeset right from the home screen.
Specialty Tools 
General Surgery, Anesthesia calculator, orthopedics, wound coding, lab fees, and more.
Works Everywhere iPhone, Android, Mac, and Web — synced automatically, with full offline support.
Your Faster Coding Plan
Download iCoder and start finding codes instantly — free for 15 days.
Organize your most-used codes and build the workflow that fits your day.
Subscribe with confidence only once your trial ends. No auto-renewals. Ever.
Our Promise to You
We'll only charge you when you choose to subscribe
Real human support — not bots
Not satisfied? Full refund, and iCoder is yours free — no questions asked
Always up to date with the latest CMS codes and rates
We listen to your feedback and act on it fast

bluejetty:00178651:ios.summary:
Duty calls: Experience an exciting strategy gameplay and master challenging military missions! Storm the beaches of Normandy with the Allied troops or take command of the Axis and defend the Atlantic Wall. History depends on you!
TOTAL WOR
bluejetty:00178651:ios.description:
Duty calls: Experience an exciting strategy gameplay and master challenging military missions! Storm the beaches of Normandy with the Allied troops or take command of the Axis and defend the Atlantic Wall. History depends on you!
TOTAL WORLD WAR
This is the decisive World War II battle between the Allied forces and the Axis powers! Choose your path and lead your army to victory!
TURN-BASED TACTICAL WARFARE
The right war strategy is the key to the ultimate victory! Plan your attacks and conquer or destroy connecting bridges, bunkers and roadblocks, to get yourself a tactical advantage!
DANGEROUS MISSIONS
Become the greatest general of all time and prove your tactical skills in plenty of different war campaigns! Unlock new missions, maps and scenarios!
DEADLY COMBAT UNITS
Take command of special units like paratroopers and bomber squadrons! Surprise your opponents from above and conquer strategic points in the enemy territory! 
MASSIVE WEAPON ARSENAL
Fight with tanks, warplanes, infantry, paratroopers and much more powerful combat units and weaponry! Heavy artillery, espionage balloons and flamethrowers included!
VARIETY OF BATTLEFIELDS
Battle your way through the enemy lines by land, by sea and in the air! Lead your soldiers into battle and crush your enemies on the historical battlefields!
MORE FEATURES
– FREE TO PLAY!
– Impactful WW2 strategy setting!
– Destructible and fixable bridges as tactical hot spots!
– Radar technology to detect enemy forces!
– Huge fortresses and fortified MG nests!
– Wide range of military vehicles like trucks, transporters and supply units!
– Detailed game graphics and epic sounds!
– Game Center support!
– A very own '1944 Burning Bridges' Facebook community!
You can play '1944 Burning Bridges' entirely for FREE, though various items are available via in-app purchase. If you don’t want to use in-app purchases, please deactivate them in your device settings.
Thank you for playing '1944 Burning Bridges'!
© www.handy-games.com GmbH

Elite Member Access offers a weekly ubscription, you will have a 3-days FREE trial period, after this period you will be charged $3.99. • The subscription is renewed unless you turn it off 24 hour before the end of the current period.
• The account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period at the cost of the weekly subscription. 
• The user may manage the subscription and auto-renewal have to be turned off by going to the user’s account settings after purchase in the Store.
• No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during the active subscription period.
Canceling a trial or a subscription: 
• If you want to cancel a subscription during its free trial, you have to cancel it through your account in the Store. This must be done at least 24 hours before the end of the free trial period to avoid being charged.
For more information, please visit https://support.apple.com/HT207865 for more informations
