bluejetty:00185974:ios.description:
-- #1 Game in over 40 countries! Over 13 million downloads worldwide! --
Follow us on Twitter @Synoptical for updates! 
Aerox is an innovative ball-rolling adventure for all iOS devices, packed with plenty of platforming action and physics-based puzzles! Dynamic and varied gameplay mechanics are complemented by stunning visuals for a blissful and engaging mobile experience.
Aerox includes full universal support for all iOS devices, including high-resolution artwork for capable devices. Unveil the full beauty of your Retina display! iPad users also benefit from additional graphical enhancements that really help showcase its power!
Features:
- 40 original levels
- Wide variety of puzzles, traps and obstacles.
- Simple yet precise tilt controls.
- Advanced engine technology (normal-mapped lighting, detailed shadowing, reflections, complex physics, etc)
- Enhanced effects for faster devices (realtime reflections, additional glow effects, improved shadows, 60fps gameplay).
- Universal support and graphical enhancements for iPad (Higher resolution reflections & MSAA)
- iCloud progress syncing between devices.
- Integrated support for LIVE gameplay streaming/broadcasting.
REVIEWS/AWARDS:
AppAdvice: "Aerox is a must buy." - 4.5 out of 5 stars
AppSmile: "Terrific marble-rolling platformer." - 4 out of 5 stars
AppSpy: "Aerox is definitely a title worth checking out." - 4 out of 5 stars
Brothersoft: Editor's Pick.
GameZebo: "..worth buying just to show off your phone's fancy 3D graphics, but luckily there is a real game in Aerox." - 4 out of 5 stars
iPhoneAlley: "As soon as I started playing, the game became an instant gem."
KnowYourMobile: "..a very polished package that keeps its simple and addictive entertainment rolling from start to finish." - 4 out of 5 stars
TouchArcade: "If you're one of the many people who always loved the Super Monkey Ball games on consoles, but never could really get in to the iPhone and iPad iterations... Aerox is worth checking out."

You can join or invite remote raids around the world anytime, anywhere. Select the raid boss you want to join and it will match automatically.

You can share the location of Pokestops, gyms, and Pokemon nests in Pokemon GO on the map.

*Matchup Matrix
This is a tool of quick checking that victory / defeat against opponent's Pokémon, charged moves with good damage efficiency, amount of received damage, etc. in PvP.

bluejetty:00169973:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00169973:ios.description:
Americans inadvertently donate 3X more to politicians and PACs through their purchases than they donate on purpose. Let's change that! 
Goods Unite Us is a women-led, Madison-Wisconsin based company with a well-established track-record of providing accurate data. 
Find out the political donations of thousands of brands! Search a company and we’ll tell you what we know about the political contributions made by the organization and its executives. Search a politician and see the companies that fund them. 
Our app exists to bring accountability and transparency to the political process. According to Congress and the Supreme Court, corporations are people and their money is speech. We want you to hear what corporations are saying. 
Simply put, when enough people factor political contributions into their purchase decisions, companies will change who and what they finance politically. We see this as the most powerful way to give you a voice in politics. After all, before the money is theirs to speak with, it’s yours.
What Users Are Saying
“Perfect for EVERYONE.”
Jordanschnee, iTunes review
“Right or left, this app provides intel…now I can better control the flow. Awesome!”
Mcmanus, iTunes review
“Love the app!”
Kim Doan, Facebook
“Excellent! Great way to make sure my money isn’t going towards the communist left!”
Aaharp1981, iTunes review
What The News Has Been Saying
“Goods Unite Us, a startup based in Madison, WI, is seeking to inform consumers
about the political leanings of corporations they buy products from.”
Jeff Buchanan, Xconomy
“One startup out of Wisconsin hopes to make our ethical purchasing decisions a little easier
by creating an app that gives full transparency towards corporations’ political donations.”
Sam Guia, Techli
“Users can search from a database of 3,000 entities on the app and see a company’s Goods Unite Us score. . . . The scorebreakdown shows the percentage of donations to each party and contribution level, assessed by dollar cutoffs.”
Sarah Hauer, Milwaukee Journal Sentinel
“Though the company says it doesn’t keep track of how its shoppers vote, Patagonia donates overwhelmingly to Democrats, according to Goods Unite Us, an app that shows consumers where their favorite companies’ political allegiances lie.”
Alexandra Mondelak, YahooNews
How We Vet The Political Donations
Our team has spent tens of thousands of hours vetting companies’ political contributions with the tools available to us, and we’re constantly working to ensure our data is timely.
Our privacy policy is located here: https://www.goodsuniteus.com/privacy-policy

listings.name: Goods Unite Us
listings.description:
Americans inadvertently donate 3X more to politicians and PACs through their purchases than they donate on purpose. Let's change that! 

Goods Unite Us is a women-led, Madison-Wisconsin based company with a well-established track-record of providing accurate data. 

Find out the political donations of thousands of brands! Search a company and we’ll tell you what we know about the political contributions made by the organization and its executives. Search a politician and see the companies that fund them.  

Our app exists to bring accountability and transparency to the political process. According to Congress and the Supreme Court, corporations are people and their money is speech. We want you to hear what corporations are saying. 

Simply put, when enough people factor political contributions into their purchase decisions, companies will change who and what they finance politically. We see this as the most powerful way to give you a voice in politics. After all, before the money is theirs to speak with, it’s yours.

What Users Are Saying

“Perfect for EVERYONE.”
Jordanschnee, iTunes review

“Right or left, this app provides intel…now I can better control the flow.  Awesome!”
Mcmanus,  iTunes review

“Love the app!”
Kim Doan, Facebook

“Excellent!  Great way to make sure my money isn’t going towards the communist left!”
Aaharp1981, iTunes review

What The News Has Been Saying

“Goods Unite Us, a startup based in Madison, WI, is seeking to inform consumers
about the political leanings of corporations they buy products from.”
Jeff Buchanan, Xconomy

“One startup out of Wisconsin hopes to make our ethical purchasing decisions a little easier
by creating an app that gives full transparency towards corporations’ political donations.”
Sam Guia, Techli

“Users can search from a database of 3,000 entities on the app and see a company’s Goods Unite Us score. . . . The scorebreakdown shows the percentage of donations to each party and contribution level, assessed by dollar cutoffs.”
Sarah Hauer, Milwaukee Journal Sentinel

“Though the company says it doesn’t keep track of how its shoppers vote, Patagonia donates overwhelmingly to Democrats, according to Goods Unite Us, an app that shows consumers where their favorite companies’ political allegiances lie.”
Alexandra Mondelak, YahooNews

How We Vet The Political Donations

Our team has spent tens of thousands of hours vetting companies’ political contributions with the tools available to us, and we’re constantly working to ensure our data is timely.

FindKeeper – Keep Your Devices Always Within Reach
FindKeeper is your all-in-one smart assistant designed to help you locate your devices, prevent accidental loss, and stay aware of your surroundings—effortlessly and intuitively. Whether your phone slips between couch cushions or your earphones wander off again, FindKeeper helps you stay in control with quick, reliable alerts and intelligent detection.
Why FindKeeper Makes Everyday Life Easier
1. Accessory Finder
Locate misplaced Bluetooth accessories with ease.
- Track connected Bluetooth earbuds
- Get instant alerts when the connection drops unexpectedly
- View distance and signal hints to guide you back
2. Sound Trigger Finder
Can’t remember where you left your phone? FindKeeper listens for simple everyday sounds to help you retrieve it instantly—no extra devices required.
- Responds to familiar sound cues
- Works even when the screen is off
- Fast wake-up and accurate audio recognition
3. Motion Notice
Stay informed whenever your device is moved or left untouched for too long.
- Movement detection alarms
- Long-idle reminders to avoid forgetting your phone
- Helpful in cafés, offices, libraries, or travel scenarios
4. Smart Reminder
Your personal mini-assistant for daily routines.
- Device forget-check checklist
- Tap-to-remind quick notes
- Convenient for travel, work, and on-the-go tasks
5. Multiple Alert Sounds
Choose from a variety of alert tones to match your style—subtle, sharp, or anything in between.
Designed for Precision. Built for Peace of Mind.
FindKeeper focuses on practical protection without complicated setup. Fast audio recognition, lightweight power usage, and seamless device compatibility make it simple to keep track of your essentials anytime.
Start your smarter, calmer, more organized digital life with FindKeeper today.

Easy, Convenient & Secure

•. View, contribute and distribute HSA transactions

•. Manage your expenses by entering medical expense information and supporting documentation
• View and Manage your HSA investments
• Retrieve your forgotten username/password
• Report a debit card as lost or stolen
Powered by WEX Health®

In Solitaire Tycoon, you’re not just flipping cards – you’re chasing glory and cash
bluejetty:00080726:ios.description:
Step into the world of Solitaire Tycoon – the ultimate real-money card game that blends strategy, skill, and a bit of luck for an adventure like no other! 
In Solitaire Tycoon, you’re not just flipping cards – you’re chasing glory and cash rewards in epic card battle tournaments.
Game Description
- If you like Spider Solitaire, Freecell, Patience, Pyramid Solitaire, Blackout, Big Run, or 21 Blitz, Then you’ll be LOVE Solitaire Tycoon!
- Play classic Solitaire and enter multiplayer tournaments where you can win real cash prizes!
- 100% Fair Play: All players get the same deck. Skill-based matchmaking ensures fair competition.
How to Play 
Ready to show off your Solitaire skills? Here's how the challenge unfolds:
- Tap to move 52 playing cards across a 7-column Solitaire board, arranging them in descending order and alternating colors.
- Found an Ace? Slide it up to the foundation piles to start building your suit from the ground up!
- Stuck? Tap the draw pile to find helpful cards and keep your card strategy flowing.
- Your mission: organize all 4 suits in ascending order – and fast!
- It’s not just solving the deck – it’s a race against time! The faster you finish, the higher you climb on the leaderboards, and the sweeter your cash rewards.
Skill-Based Competition
Unlike games that depend purely on luck, Solitaire Tycoon rewards real skill.
- Matched with players of your same skill level for a fair challenge.
- Everyone plays the exact same deck – it’s all about how smart and fast you are!
- Your score depends on completion speed and game strategy – the better you play, the more you win.
Win Real Money 
Compete in exciting cash games and real money tournaments.
- Join exciting real money tournaments backed by PayPal cash prizes!
- Feel the adrenaline of high-stakes card games where your strategy and speed lead to win real money.
- Score top ranks and withdraw your cash winnings instantly and securely – straight to your PayPal account!
Safe and Secure
- Play with peace of mind on a trusted and secure Solitaire platform.
- Your personal and financial information is fully protected – enjoy real money games with total confidence!
Thrilling Features You’ll Love
- Join multiplayer Solitaire tournaments with huge cash prizes!
- Multiple tournament modes including strategy, speed, and skill challenges
- Enjoy special challenges & surprises
- Grow your fortune and build your business empire!
- Invite friends to play together anytime, anywhere 
- Enjoy a smooth, ad-free Solitaire experience.
- Make secure deposits using PayPal and Apple Pay.
Exiciting New Events& Systems:
- Riches Road: Roll dice, collect letters, win big!
- Piggy Bank: More value with every deposit!
- Scratch Cards: Daily chances for instant cash!
- And many more!
Whether you're a longtime Solitaire fan or enjoy other classic card games like poker and blackjack, Solitaire Tycoon offers one of the most exciting cash game experiences available.
Cash games are not supported in the following states: AZ, DE, IN, LA, ME, SC and WA. If you live in these states, you can still enjoy free games through the virtual currency we provide.
Ready to play, earn, and win real money? 
Download Solitaire Tycoon now – it’s full of fun ways to win!

SpeakApp AI: Voice-to-Text
SpeakApp captures your voice with a single tap and transforms it into text.
Record and summarize meetings, take voice notes, write emails or create content with your voice. SpeakApp simplifies your workflow by seamlessly converting voice to text.
From a spontaneous brainstorm to a structured blueprint, your spoken ideas are transcribed swiftly and accurately, thanks to our cutting-edge AI.

• Share your notes directly from the app.

• We take your privacy seriously. Your data remains confidential and is never shared with third parties.
• Full Data Control: Easily manage and delete your data as needed.

bluejetty:00182404:ios.description:
[Time Travel to the Song Dynasty, run your businesses!]
[Business Simulation Game of Ancient China in Traditional Painting Style]
[Most Popular & Best Visually Designed Role-playing Mobile Game of the Year]
Pavilions are stacked upon each other. There is no end for all-day songs and dances.
In Bianliang, the capital city where business is encouraged, you will start as a common citizen. Get to know your neighborhood, open your own shop and eventually turn it into a business empire.
◆Bank
◎Adequate capital flow is the key to a business. Never let your money sleep.
◎Remember to deploy capable retainers to look after your business.
◆Inn
◎Update the menu daily and cater to customer tastes to raise the ratings of your restaurant.
◎Prepare all the ingredients for Bubble Tea, Minced Pork Rice etc..
◎Indulge yourself in the joyful lifestyle of Bianliang.
◆Infirmary
◎Learn about different traditional Chinese medicines and treatments.
◎Run your infirmary with mercy and honesty to gain reputation.
◎Study bizarre medicines and herbs to find cure for rare diseases.
◆Global Trade
◎In the ancient time, international trade can be full of risks. Join a guild to explore the Silk Road with your fellow merchants.
◎Hindu, Misr, Malla...visit these ancient countries and discover different local specialties.
◎Keep an eye on the price of goods, sell higher, buy lower is the golden rule.
◆Operate your estate
◎Farming, fishing, tea picking...Back to a primitive life with slow pace
◎Wine brewing, dyeing, silkworm breeding...Gain harvest with your labor
Official Info
* Facebook Homepage: https://www.facebook.com/gaming/game.tradinglegend
* Official Website: https://en.37games.com/dzgtl/index.html
[Notes]
Trading Legend is a free-to-play mobile game with in-app purchases. According to 37GAMES Terms of Use and Privacy Policy, this application is not intended for use by users under the age of 12.
A device with internet access is required.

Trading Legend provides subscription services. Become a subscriber to enjoy exclusive boosts and rewards!
1. Content: Subscribe to get various privileges.
2. Subscription duration: 1 week
3. Subscription price: $0.99
4. Payment: Via your iTunes account
5. If you are a subscriber, within 24 hours before your weekly subscription expires, the subscription will be automatically renewed UNLESS you manually cancel it before then.
6. To manage and cancel subscriptions, please head to Settings - iTunes Store & App Store - Check Apple ID - Account Settings - Subscription.

Do you need help?
Feel free to contact us via the in-game Customer Service or send us an Email at: global.support@37games.com

bluejetty:00157138:ios.description:
Compare car insurance quotes without calling around.

Auto Insurance Quote helps you shop smarter from your phone or tablet. Submit one short request in the app, then insurers and licensed agents can contact you with quotes you can compare. If you want a better rate, comparing multiple quotes is one of the simplest ways to find it.
WHY DRIVERS USE AUTO INSURANCE QUOTE
• Request quotes with one short in-app flow
• Free to use with no obligation
• Built for iPhone and iPad
• Helpful tools before you choose coverage
REQUEST QUOTES IN MINUTES
Enter your ZIP code plus basic vehicle and driver details, then submit your request. Insurers and licensed agents in your area can respond with quote options, so you can compare and choose what fits your budget and coverage needs.
CAR INSURANCE RATE CALCULATOR
Use the calculator to see how factors like age, vehicle type, driving record, and coverage level can affect premium range. It is a planning tool to help you understand price drivers before you buy.
DISCOUNT CHECKLIST
Review 14 common discounts, including multi-car, bundling, safe driver, good student, anti-theft, paid in full, and low-mileage savings. Know what to ask about so you do not miss easy ways to lower cost.
STATE MINIMUM COVERAGE GUIDE
Check minimum liability requirements for all 50 states + DC. Quickly understand baseline legal limits and compare liability-only vs fuller protection.
SMART SHOPPING TIPS
Get practical guidance on comparing offers, balancing price and coverage, and evaluating insurer service and claims experience.

bluejetty:00165865:ios.description:
The Crosshair for Valorant app is your ultimate guide to discovering and customizing crosshairs used by professional players in Valorant. With a comprehensive collection of over 150+ crosshairs, this app is designed to provide you with detailed insights into the most popular and effective crosshair settings used by top players worldwide. Whether you’re a seasoned Valorant player or just getting started, this app offers everything you need to elevate your gameplay experience.
With the information provided for each crosshair, you can easily replicate, customize, or use the exact settings used by your favorite pros. For those who enjoy experimenting or having fun, the app also includes a collection of troll crosshairs to add a playful twist to your gameplay. Whether you're aiming for competitive mastery or just looking to entertain yourself and your friends, this app has something for everyone.
Key Features
Crosshairs from Professional Players
The app showcases crosshairs used by some of the most famous professional Valorant players. Each crosshair comes with detailed information, including settings, style, and usage tips, so you can fully understand how to replicate it in your own game. This feature not only allows you to play like the pros but also helps you learn how crosshair settings can impact your gameplay.
Troll Crosshairs
Looking for a fun way to spice up your matches? The app includes a variety of troll crosshairs designed to add humor and unpredictability to your games. Use these unique crosshairs to challenge your friends or lighten the mood during casual play.
Search Functionality
Finding your perfect crosshair has never been easier. With the built-in search feature on the main view, you can quickly locate specific crosshairs by typing in a name or keyword. This ensures you spend less time searching and more time playing.
Reflex Game - Train and Improve
The Reflex Game mode is a dedicated feature designed to improve your reaction times and aiming accuracy. Engage in this interactive training experience to sharpen your reflexes, enhance hand-eye coordination, and rank up faster in competitive matches. The Reflex Game is tailored for players looking to climb the ranks all the way to Radiant.
Teams Section
The Teams section offers a curated list of popular professional Valorant teams. Explore brief information about each team and delve deeper into the individual crosshairs used by team members. This feature is perfect for fans who want to follow their favorite teams and players while learning from their crosshair setups.
Random Crosshair Button
The Random button adds an element of surprise by selecting one crosshair from the entire collection. Use this feature to discover new crosshairs, try out different setups, or create fun challenges with your friends. The Random button makes experimenting with crosshairs a seamless and enjoyable experience.
Detailed and Normal Views
Each crosshair comes with both detailed and simplified views. Toggle between these modes to access the level of information you need, from basic settings to advanced customization tips. This flexibility ensures that players of all skill levels can benefit from the app.
Favorites Section
Keep track of your favorite crosshairs by adding them to your personal Favorites list. This feature makes it easy to access your preferred crosshairs anytime without having to search for them repeatedly.
With the Crosshair for Valorant app, you'll have everything you need to take your gameplay to the next level. Whether you want to improve your skills, explore fun crosshair designs, or emulate the pros, this app is the ultimate resource for Valorant crosshairs. Explore, customize, and dominate the game like never before!

apple-itunes:484829437.name: Awesome Calendar Lite
apple-itunes:484829437.description:
Say goodbye to all the calendars and schedule planner apps you’ve ever used on your iPhone or iPad, as Awesome Calendar is going to change the game. This perfect time management app delivers everything you should expect from such planner apps and it even sets the bar to a higher level by offering fresh and intuitive user interface, ultimate customization options, detailed weather forecast, tons of emoji stickers to add to the calendar view and a lot more. 
With Awesome Calendar, you’ll have access to a multi-functional task manager app to organize your life. This personal planner app comes with a clean and neat design and the interface is so user-friendly that you’ll get the whole idea after browsing through the menus for a few times. You get to easily add a note, create an event or set a reminder right from calendar’s month view. To switch between different views (Week or Day view) you just need to double tap on the screen and to see available events for a specific day, you just need to tap on that date (a pop-up opens). 
So, if you care about being organized and want to never be worried about forgetting a meeting, missing a deadline or forgetting the long lists of your to-dos, then the Awesome Calendar is A Must Have App for you.
Download this calendar and planner app and start adding your agenda, to-do lists and your upcoming events to it. Awesome Calendar will automatically organize everything and will let you know as soon as there is a deadline, a meeting or an event to attend to.
Why Should I Install Awesome Calendar on my iPhone?
While there are so many calendar apps to download and use, including the default iPhone’s calendar app, why should I trust this planner pro app and use it as my organizer app? Well, this is a fair question to ask and here are just a few reasons for installing this wonderful app:
One. It’s extremely easy to use. This awesome app packs all the great features in a very well designed interface and you can easily track your events in different views.
Two. It syncs with all iPhone calendar apps. If you are already using old-fashioned calendar apps, you can easily bring all your data to this awesome app.
Three. It offers ultimate customization options. You get to easily set custom color for event and reminder, and change the font size and style in the notes and different views. There is also the option to add stickers to the month view.
Four. Detailed weather forecast. There is built-in weather app in the Awesome Calendar which helps you track the weather condition before deciding where to go and when to go. 
And there are tons of other great features waiting for you…
Awesome Calendar & Personal Planner Main Features at a Glance:
+ Natural Language Input
+ Clean and neat design with super user-friendly interface
+ Easy to navigate through different views and adding new tasks, to-dos or events
+ Syncs with all iPhone calendars
+ Ultimate customization options (change Color, Font, Style and more)
+ Holiday listings for 35 different countries
+ Month, week agenda, half-week, day and list views
+ Powerful search tool to look through your events, notes and to-dos
+ Current weather condition + 5-day weather forecast
+ Wide range of emoji stickers to be used in the month view
+ Add photos to your notes
+ Create recurring events (upgrade to full version)
+ Set priority and reminders for your events
+ Check your schedule at a glance in month view
+ No ads (upgrade to full version)
So, Awesome Calendar is here to organize your life and make sure you never miss an important date or a meeting. You just need to add all your tasks, events, and meetings to the app, and leave the rest to this awesome scheduler app. You get to easily create custom alarms and reminders for any event and be notified of your upcoming event. The weather forecast feature, helps you schedule your day easier and more efficient. 
Download Awesome Calendar and let us know about any bugs, questions, feature requests or any other suggestions.

• Open-source and completely free
• Up to 4K 120 FPS with HDR
• Stream games purchased from any game store
• Bluetooth keyboard and mouse support
• Support for MFi, PS4/5, and Xbox Bluetooth controllers
• Wake-on-LAN to wake your PC for streaming
• Local co-op with up to 4 connected controllers
Other Requirements:
• 5 GHz WiFi is highly recommended
• A physical gamepad is recommended for faster paced games
If you have any trouble, click our support link for help or look for the help links within Moonlight.

apple-itunes:6791324759.name: Blank Browser
apple-itunes:6791324759.description:
The web should work for you.
Blank Browser is a modern web browser built for people who value speed, privacy, and control without sacrificing the browsing experience they expect. Whether you’re reading the news, shopping online, researching a topic, or managing your daily workflow, Blank Browser gives you the tools to browse the way you want.
Choose between Standard Browsing and Private Browsing at any time. Standard Browsing saves your history, cookies, passwords, and website preferences for a familiar experience. Private Browsing uses an isolated browsing session that leaves no lasting website data behind when you’re finished. Switching between modes is quick and seamless.
Take control of online distractions with a powerful built-in content blocker. Block ads, trackers, unwanted domains, and other web content to create a cleaner browsing experience. Import public filter lists, create your own blocklists and whitelists, build wildcard or regular expression rules, and customize exactly how websites behave. Your browsing experience is yours to control.
Blank Browser also helps you better understand the websites you visit. View detailed page information including SSL certificate details, cookies, downloads, permissions, connection information, observed technologies, and other useful insights. Everything is presented in a clear and accessible way, making advanced information available without requiring technical expertise.
Your passwords remain protected with the built-in Password Manager. Credentials are securely stored using Apple’s Keychain, with an optional PIN available for an additional layer of protection before viewing or editing saved logins.
Additional features include:
• Built-in ad and tracker blocking
• Custom blocklists and whitelists
• Import public filter lists
• Regular expression and wildcard filtering
• Per-site permissions
• Popup blocking
• Mobile and desktop website switching
• Download manager
• Favorites manager
• Detailed page information
• Browsing statistics
• Modern tab management
• Password Manager with optional PIN protection
• Support for iPhone, iPad, and Mac
Unlike many browsers, Blank Browser does not require you to create an account before you can browse the web. There are no mandatory sign-ins or unnecessary barriers between you and the internet.
Blank Browser is actively developed with regular updates focused on website compatibility, browsing performance, stability, privacy improvements, and new features. Every update is designed to make browsing faster, more reliable, and more enjoyable while keeping you in control of your experience.

apple-macos:1093512676.name: iScribeHealth
apple-macos:1093512676.description:
iScribe cures physician burnout and allows physicians to focus on caring for patients rather than the computer screen.
iScribe is an easy-to-use app that gives providers anytime/anywhere access via iPhone, iPad, or Mac to view and enter clinical information for patients. We leverage industry leading speech-to-text technology to increase provider efficiency and productivity while eliminating expensive transcription costs.
With iScribe’s real-time speech-to-text dictation feature, users can visually see the dictated text directly on the screen as they are speaking. Users can dictate directly into the appropriate sections (CC, HPI, ROS, PE, A/P) on the mobile device and save their documentation immediately into their EHR. By using the real-time speech-to-text feature, transcription costs can be eliminated. iScribe users have saved $15,000 - $25,000 per provider per year in reduced transcription costs.
iScribe reduces the time that healthcare providers typically spend in the EHR allowing more time to take care of patients. Physicians can complete their encounter without having to wait until the end of the day or after office hours and there is no waiting for pending transcription. iScribe’s modern mobile user experience allows the clinical documentation to be completed at the point of care without taking away from the provider / patient experience. Healthcare provider time should not be undervalued and iScribe helps to maximize efficiency and productivity unlike any other solution available today.

apple-itunes:1035689743.name: BusyCal: Calendar & Tasks
apple-itunes:1035689743.description:
BusyCal is a calendar and task planner built for busy schedules. It connects to every account you already use, shows your events and tasks side by side, and bends to the way you work: pinch to see more days or weeks, type events the way you would say them, and keep everything in sync with BusyCal for Mac.
One-time purchase. No subscription.
YOUR CALENDAR, YOUR WAY
• Day, Week, Month, Year and List views, plus a dedicated Task list
• Pinch to zoom: 2 to 14 days per week and 2 to 8 weeks per month, with separate portrait and landscape layouts
• Customize colors, text size, weekend shading, week numbers and working hours, or show a Chinese, Hebrew, Islamic or Japanese calendar alongside
• Year view as a wall planner or heat map, with Highlights that reveal your busiest months, top calendars and meeting stats
TYPE IT THE WAY YOU WOULD SAY IT
• Type "Lunch with Sam next Tuesday at noon" or "Standup every weekday at 9:30" and BusyCal fills in the date, time and repeat as you type
• Understands alarms, time zones, calendars (/work) and links, in English, German, French, Italian, Spanish, Dutch, Japanese, Korean and Simplified Chinese
TASKS IN YOUR CALENDAR
• Dated, timed and undated tasks appear right in your calendar and carry forward until done
• Priorities, repeats, and a Task list you can sort by due date, priority, calendar, tag or by hand
• Works with Apple Reminders, iCloud, Google Tasks, Todoist and Fastmail
EVERY ACCOUNT, ONE APP
• iCloud, Google Calendar, Microsoft 365, Outlook.com, Exchange, Yahoo, Fastmail, Fruux and any CalDAV server, plus WebDAV subscriptions for holidays and sports
• Push updates where your server supports them, and accounts you add once are offered to your other devices
• Syncs with BusyCal for Mac, Apple Calendar and any other app on the same accounts
MEETINGS AND INVITES
• Invite attendees, and accept, decline or reply Maybe straight from the Inbox
• Zoom, Microsoft Teams, Google Meet, Webex and GoTo links become one-tap join buttons, and you can create Zoom and Teams meetings from inside the app
• Block time on a second calendar in a couple of taps, with or without the details
WIDGETS, WATCH, SIRI AND SHORTCUTS
• Home Screen widgets for what is next, your agenda, the week, two weeks, three weeks, and tasks you can complete from the widget
• Lock Screen widgets and Control Center buttons for new events and tasks
• Apple Watch app with calendar, today, up next and tasks views, plus complications for your watch face
• Siri: "Add lunch with Sam tomorrow at noon", "What's coming up", "When am I free"
• Shortcuts actions to find, create, move, defer and complete items, and a Focus filter that switches calendar sets
TRAVEL TIME, MAPS AND TIME ZONES
• Add travel time to an event and get a leave-now alert based on real driving or walking time
• Maps inside event details, with directions in Apple Maps, Google Maps, Waze, Citymapper or TomTom GO
• Favorite time zones, and events that start and end in different zones
TAGS, CALENDAR SETS AND PRIVACY
• Color-coded tags to track projects, people and priorities across calendars
• Calendar sets: named groups of calendars, each with its own default calendars and preferred view, synced across your devices
• Lock the app, or just certain calendar sets, with Face ID or Touch ID
AND MORE
• Weather and moon phases on your calendar
• Birthdays and anniversaries from Contacts, with age and years
• Search titles, locations, notes and tags across past and future
BusyCal has been trusted by Mac users for more than a decade. The iPhone and iPad app is its full-featured companion, made by the same team.
Questions? Visit busymac.com/docs or write to us from within the app.

apple-macos:6818919203.description:
Roam brings your travel plans and memories together. Organize each day, save useful guides, track expenses, and build a personal travel journal with photo stickers and text.
Plan each day
Organize sights, meals, stays, transport, and notes. See ongoing and upcoming trips on the home screen with a departure countdown.
Make a journal
Take or choose photos, create subject stickers on your device, and move, resize, rotate, or annotate them. New photos are placed without covering existing items.
Save guides and expenses
Keep web links and notes, record expenses by currency, and view places and routes. Currency totals are separate; no automatic exchange conversion is performed.
Automatic sync
Local planning and existing iCloud sync remain free and require no Roam account. Optional Account Sync membership uses email-code sign-in to sync itinerary text, journal metadata, and photo references. Photos remain in private iCloud, so accessing them across devices requires the same Apple ID. Purchasing and restoring the Apple subscription does not require email registration. You may choose email sign-in later to link your subscription and enable account cloud sync.
Account Sync is a one-year auto-renewing subscription. The China mainland price is CNY18/year; regional prices and the final price appear in the App Store purchase sheet. Payment is charged to your Apple account. Manage or cancel renewal in system subscription settings.
Privacy Policy: https://roam.iiife.com/
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
